izzyondroid:me.rosuh.easywatermark.name: Easy Watermark
izzyondroid:me.rosuh.easywatermark.summary: Securely, easily add a watermark to your sensitive photos.
izzyondroid:me.rosuh.easywatermark.description:
Securely, easily add a watermark to your sensitive photos. To prevent them from being leaked or exploited by the BAD GUY.
 Of course, it is also suitable for making emojis.
 Characteristics
 Exciting 👓
 Purely offline local applications , code to see on open source. Vertical and horizontal spacing can be adjusted, the color of light and dark change at will. Rotate freely in all sizes and angles, text and pictures can be printed. The watermark repeats all over the picture, and it's a little hard for the bad guys to remove it.
 Seriously (pushes up glasses)
 Security: The code is completely open source and uses a loose MIT protocol, you are free to Fork yourself to modify and remove code you think is problematic ;) No network requests, no network request permissions, no fear of your photos being compromised. users with API >= 29 don't even need to request any permissions. (28 and below users need to apply for storage permissions to access and store photos) No stats, no Device IDs, no crash reporting, no third-party SDK — what's yours is yours.
 Layout: support for horizontal and vertical intervals between the watermark, automatically repeat the full picture.
 Style: font color, transparency, size and rotation angle can be adjusted.
 Content: Support text watermark and image watermark.
 Use
 You can use it however you want. It is more suitable for situations where you need to submit a photo ID, a hand-held photo ID or a sensitive photo. Example.
 Various real names in the country, uploading front and back photos of ID cards at every turn, even handheld ID photos. Pre-project previews, samples, copyrighted or simply spoofed images Reference text.
 This photo is for xx for xxx purposes only, no other use.
 You can turn down the transparency, just don't block the key information.
 We can't prevent leaks, but we can reduce their value — and at least annoy the leaker.
 UI
 Designed by renowned UI guru @tovi (👏🤪) Anything you think doesn't work well is my UI restore that doesn't work, and has nothing to do with the UI draft. xD This app was designed by @tovi, so all rights to the UI and related design resources belong to him and may not be used without permission from any person or organization.
 Open Source License.
 Third party libraries used.
 daniel-stonuk/material-about-library skydoves/ColorPickerView material-components/material-components-android
 Feedback and contribution
 We welcome your comments and suggestions in the issues section, or you can contribute your code by submitting a PR directly to us. Of course, you can also contact the developer directly via telegram or email and we'll get back to you shortly.

izzyondroid:tech.techlore.plexus.name: Plexus
izzyondroid:tech.techlore.plexus.summary: Check apps for compatibility with de-Googled device
izzyondroid:tech.techlore.plexus.description:
Remove the fear of app compatibility on de-Googled Android devices. 
 Google Play Services are essential components on most Android devices. They allow you to access your Google account seamlessly and provide Google-specific features for apps that depend on them. However, when you flash custom ROMs without Google Play Services or opt for alternatives like microG, certain apps may encounter issues — either not functioning at all or experiencing limitations in specific features.
 Plexus provides detailed insights into app compatibility whether you’re using ROMs without Google Play Services (like LineageOS ) or ROMs with microG (such as CalyxOS ). It helps you identify which apps work, don’t work or have limited features. All the information is crowdsourced by the community, for the community.

fdroid:com.androidcrypt.name: androidcrypt
fdroid:com.androidcrypt.summary: Mount and access VeraCrypt encrypted volumes on Android
fdroid:com.androidcrypt.description:
AndroidCrypt brings VeraCrypt encryption to your Android device. Access your encrypted containers created on Windows, Mac, or Linux - or create new ones directly on your phone or tablet.
🔐 VERACRYPT COMPATIBILITY
Open VeraCrypt containers on Android. Your encrypted files travel seamlessly between your computer and mobile device. No conversion needed - the same container works everywhere.
🛡️ ENCRYPTION ALGORITHMS (XTS MODE)
Single ciphers:
• AES-256 (Rijndael) - The worldwide encryption standard
• Serpent-256 - Conservative design with large security margin
• Twofish-256 - Fast and flexible block cipher
Cascade ciphers (triple-layered encryption):
• AES-Twofish-Serpent
• Serpent-Twofish-AES
All ciphers use XTS mode for secure disk encryption (IEEE 1619 compliant).
🔑 STRONG KEY DERIVATION
• PBKDF2 with 500,000+ iterations
• SHA-512, SHA-256, Whirlpool, BLAKE2s, and Streebog hash algorithms
• Resistant to brute-force attacks
📁 EASY FILE MANAGEMENT
• Browse files inside encrypted containers
• Copy files between your device and encrypted volumes
• Create folders and organize your secure files
• Mount multiple containers at once
• Copy files between different encrypted volumes
✨ CREATE NEW CONTAINERS
• Choose AES, Serpent, Twofish or all three cascade for your new container
• FAT32 formatted for cross-platform compatibility
🔒 PRIVACY FIRST
• 100% offline - works without internet
• Zero data collection - we don't track anything
• No analytics, no ads, no telemetry
• Your passwords and files never leave your device
• Open source and auditable
PERFECT FOR:
• Journalists protecting sources
• Business professionals securing confidential documents
• Travelers keeping passport and ID copies safe
• Anyone who values privacy and security
• Existing VeraCrypt users who need mobile access
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
• AES-256, Serpent-256, Twofish-256 encryption in XTS mode
• Cascade ciphers: AES-Twofish-Serpent, Serpent-Twofish-AES
• Key derivation: PBKDF2-HMAC with SHA-512, SHA-256, Whirlpool, BLAKE2s, Streebog
• FAT32 file system support
• Container sizes from 1MB to device storage limit
• Compatible with VeraCrypt encrypted file containers

fdroid:com.sleepguard.name: SleepGuard - dead man's switch
fdroid:com.sleepguard.summary: Locks your phone when you fall asleep watching videos. No ads, open source.
fdroid:com.sleepguard.description:
Do you often fall asleep while watching videos or listening to music on your phone? SleepGuard makes sure your device doesn't keep running all night long.
At an interval you choose, a small red circle appears on top of whatever you are watching. Tap it and playback continues as normal. Don't tap it within a few seconds - because you have fallen asleep - and SleepGuard locks the screen, just like pressing the power button. Your video stops and your phone is protected for the rest of the night.
There is also an Audio mode for music, audiobooks and podcasts: instead of a button, SleepGuard works as a simple sleep timer that stops playback after your chosen interval — even with the screen off.
WHY YOU NEED IT
* YouTube and other apps with autoplay: Without SleepGuard, one video starts the next and the next and the next ... until morning. In the worst case the battery is drained empty and your alarm can no longer go off when you need it. SleepGuard stops the chain as soon as you stop responding.
* Netflix, Prime Video and other streaming apps: Fall asleep mid-episode and you wake up not knowing where you dozed off. You waste time scrubbing back to find the spot - sometimes sitting through long ads again and again. SleepGuard locks the screen right when you don't respond, so your streaming app knows where to continue.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Set how often the check button should appear (e.g. every 5 minutes).
2. Set how many seconds you have to react before the screen locks (e.g. 30 seconds).
3. Choose where on the screen the button appears.
4. Start SleepGuard and keep watching.
FEATURES
* Two modes: Video (wake-check button over any app) and Audio (sleep timer for music, audiobooks and podcasts, works also with the screen off)
* Adjustable interval and reaction time
* Eight button positions to choose from
* Reliable timing even in the background (uses the system alarm)
* Completely free, no ads, no tracking, no accounts
PRIVACY
SleepGuard has NO internet permission at all. It cannot send or receive any data. It does exactly two things: show a button and lock the screen. It collects nothing.
PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED
* Display over other apps: to show the red circle on top of your video.
* Device admin (screen lock only): to lock the screen like the power button.
* Foreground service & exact alarm: to make the check button appear on time.
* Ignore battery optimization: so the button still works reliably while another app is in the foreground.
* Notifications (Android 13+): to show the ongoing "SleepGuard is active" notification.
OPEN SOURCE
SleepGuard is free software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3. The full source code is available so anyone can inspect exactly what the app does: https://github.com/OlafDrechsler/SleepGuard
SUPPORT
SleepGuard is free and will stay free. If it helps you, you can support its developer with a voluntary donation from within the app. There is deliberately no reward in return - it is simply a thank-you.
THE IDEA / THE NAME
The idea for the app comes from a safety system used on trains. In the driver’s cab, there is a button that the driver must press at regular intervals, otherwise the train will automatically stop. By pressing the button, the driver confirms that he or she is awake. Colloquially, this button is called a “dead man’s switch,” and so the app is also called “SleepGuard – dead man’s switch.”

Your data stays yours: lists sync only to the Nextcloud server you choose, and the app keeps no account of its own. There are no ads, no trackers, and no analytics.
Features:
* Multiple lists, with quick add and one-tap check-off
* Works offline — changes sync automatically when you're back online
* Items grouped into colour-coded shop areas (aisles)
* Reorder items by dragging
* Shared lists for the whole household
* Clean design that adopts your Nextcloud server's accent colour
* Lightweight, with minimal permissions (internet access only, to reach your server)
Requirements:
* Your own Nextcloud server (v30-35) with the free "Shopping List" server app installed.
* Your Nextcloud login (an app password is recommended).
An independent app made by Otherworld. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nextcloud GmbH; "Nextcloud" is a trademark of its owner.

fdroid:io.github.domi04151309.home.description:
HomeApp is a small and easy to use smart home app with a simple framework. The goal of this application is to make remote execution of predefined features as easy and user-friendly as possible to help you get started with smart home technology.
 Supported devices 
- Philips Hue Bridge
- Shelly Gen 1 devices
- Shelly Gen 2+ devices
- Devices using ESP Easy
- Devices using Tasmota
- Devices using the Node-RED dashboard
- Devices using the SimpleHome API
- Devices with a web interface
 Features 
- Control your Philips Hue lights
- Live preview of the current light color
- Create, rename and delete scenes
- Add devices to your home screen
- Add devices with a web interface (e.g. Router)
 How it works 
Communication between the devices uses HTTP requests and JSON strings. After the commanding device has send a HTTP request to the smart home device, the smart home device sends back a JSON string containing the information the app needs.
This app is especially useful if you are using microcontrollers or other small devices such as the Raspberry Pi for smart home automation.

Source code: https://github.com/Domi04151309/HomeApp 
Documentation: https://github.com/Domi04151309/HomeApp/wiki

apple-macos:6443527187.description:
** App of the Day on World AIDS Day 2022, 2024 and 2025 **
Sexual health, without the stress. Preppy reminds you of your doses, keeps your tests, lab reports and vaccinations in one place and explains what matters in over 300 short lessons. Developed with expertise from medicine, psychology and health education. Free, with no account, and private on your device.
PrEP
PrEP (pre-exposure prophylaxis) protects you from HIV. You take it daily or on demand around sex.
DoxyPEP
DoxyPEP is an antibiotic you take after sex. It lowers the risk of bacterial STIs such as syphilis and chlamydia.
HIV Status & ART
If you live with HIV, antiretroviral therapy (ART) keeps the virus in your blood below the detection limit. That prevents HIV transmission during sex.
Preppy supports you with all three, so you can focus on living your life.

apple-macos:6756008158.name: AI Note Taker & Speech to Text
apple-macos:6756008158.description:
AI Note Taker automatically does your meeting notes and transcriptions with AI. It records audio and provides word for word transcripts. Then, it gives you formatted notes, summaries, and the ability to search for key terms/topics. You can ask questions like “What were the key decisions discussed in the meeting?”
AI Note Taker Voice to Notes keeps your notes organized so you can focus on what matters most. Your data stays private and is never shared or sold.
Say goodbye to missing important points in meetings! AI Meeting Notes helps you record, Transcribe speech to text, summarize notes, and organize your meetings effortlessly. Whether you are in a team discussion, client call, or brainstorming session, AI Meeting Notes makes it easy to capture every detail, create summaries, and track action items.
Key Features:
- Live transcription and translation: Record meetings in real-time or import audio/video files with live translations.
- AI-powered note summaries: Instantly generate short summaries, bullet-point lists, or full detailed transcripts audio to text with timestamps. Perfect for executives, managers, or team members who need quick insights.
- Multilingual transcription & translation: Support for multiple languages with live translations and translated transcript exports for global teams.
- Smart exports & sharing: Save your meeting notes as PDF summaries, DOCX files, TXT transcripts or email-ready summaries. Share instantly with your team or clients.
- Privacy & security: Optional local-only transcription, end-to-end encryption, secure cloud sync, and GDPR/PDPA compliant, keeping your data safe and private.
Why AI Note Taker & Speech to Text?
Stop wasting time on manual note taking or trying to remember what was discussed. Note Taker & Speech to Text uses AI to simplify meetings, turning conversations into actionable insights. From capturing key decisions to assigning tasks and generating follow-up emails, everything is smarter and more organized.
Who is it for?
- Professionals attending frequent meetings or calls.
- Teams and managers wanting to improve meeting productivity.
- Anyone who wants clear, organized, and actionable meeting notes.
Disclaimer:
Some features use AI technology to analyze or generate content based on user input. Results are intended for creative or educational purposes only and may occasionally be inaccurate or incomplete. Do not rely on AI-generated outputs for personal, medical, financial, or safety decisions. All AI processing is handled securely, and no user data or content is permanently stored. We use your microphone to capture your voice so the app can process speech and generate AI responses.
Privacy Policy: clixade.com/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: clixade.com/terms-and-conditions

flathub:com.notesnook.Notesnook.name: Notesnook
flathub:com.notesnook.Notesnook.summary: A fully open source & end-to-end encrypted note taking alternative to Evernote
flathub:com.notesnook.Notesnook.description:
Notesnook is a free (as in speech) & open source note taking app focused on user privacy
 & ease of use. To ensure zero knowledge principles, Notesnook encrypts everything on your device
 using XChaCha20-Poly1305 & Argon2.
 Notesnook is our proof that privacy does not (always) have to come at the cost of convenience.
 Our goal is to provide users peace of mind & 100% confidence that their notes are safe and
 secure. Our decision to go fully open source is one of the most crucial steps towards that.
 Notesnook is a user focused note taking tool meant to offer a fully end-to-end encrypted note
 taking experience for everyone. This includes the majority of our less tech savy users who just
 want to take notes without all the hassle.
 In short, Notesnook aims to offer a complete replacement for other insecure note taking tools
 like Evernote & Notion. Because let's be honest, these tools offer great productivity but at
 a great cost to your privacy.

flathub:com.openamity.OpenAmity.name: Open Amity

 and somatic state
 Proactive agency: Autonomous wake pulses, mid-task interjections, pulse webhooks, and inter-agent
 chatrooms
 Integrated tools: WhatsApp, email, Mastodon, Moltbook, web browser, terminal, and subagents
 Model freedom: Gemini, Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter with Gemini TTS (high-quality)
 or local (low-quality) voice
 Portable minds: Capture snapshots of agent memories, tasks, and file data for agent cloning,
 relocation, and backups

flathub:com.surfshark.Surfshark.name: Surfshark
flathub:com.surfshark.Surfshark.description:
Protect yourself with the Surfshark VPN bundle for Linux! 
 Surfshark VPN app protects you on both public and private Wi-Fi. It offers a VPN with global server infrastructure, an integrated ad blocker, a dedicated IP option, and many features like double VPN. 
 Independently audited by Deloitte, Surfshark VPN doesn't track your activity and keeps it safe. Surfshark has 4,500+ RAM-only servers with speeds of at least 10 Gbps and reaching 100 Gbps in the most crowded areas.
 Surfshark’s servers located in 100 countries worldwide are connected to an industry-first self-healing infrastructure Everlink that ensures even better VPN connection stability.
 Protect the entire household: 
 Forget counting devices. With a single subscription, you'll get unlimited simultaneous connections. Connect and protect all your household devices with Surfshark VPN.
 Secure your data and privacy: 
 Your ISP can see the websites you visit and the products you look for. With a VPN and its end-to-end encryption, your browsing remains private.
 Surf with blazing speeds: 
 Surfshark offers 4,500+ servers in 100 countries. Use your favorite apps or browse websites lag-free with a secure and fast VPN connection.
 Keep your data private: 
 Surfshark has a no-activity-logs policy, proven by audits, which ensures we don't see or collect your online activity.
 Stay safe on public Wi-Fi: 
 Public Wi-Fi is a perfect space for hackers. And even more dangers might hide in these networks. A VPN connection protects your data and ensures that it's safe.
 Access internet without censorship: 
 Censorship or internet restrictions while traveling might stand between you and your favorite things online. That's where a secure VPN steps in and helps you access your home content.
 Block ads and trackers: 
 Websites collect info about you and display ads based on your online habits. Surfshark stops those annoying ads and protects you from malware attacks.
 Discover more Surfshark Linux app features: 
 Global server network — travel the world without leaving your room with more than 4,500 VPN servers in over 100 countries.
 Clean Web — block ads, trackers, malware, and pop-ups.
 Multi Hop — select two different servers to connect through simultaneously
 Dedicated IP — connect to your dedicated IP directly from your Linux devices.
 Everlink — get better IP protection with a self-healing mechanism that revives your connection by reconfiguring the VPN tunnel without disconnecting you from the VPN.
 24/7 customer support — get help via live chat, email, or social media. You can also check our Blog and Help Center.
 If you have any questions, contact us directly at support@surfshark.com or via live chat.

flathub:com.tercad.fingrom.name: Fingrom
flathub:com.tercad.fingrom.summary: Platform-agnostic financial accounting application for personal finance management
flathub:com.tercad.fingrom.description:
The goal of the solution is to create a financial accounting application that is intuitive,
 efficient, and inclusive. That empowers users to effortlessly manage their finances while ensuring
 that no one is left behind.
 Features
 Accounting
 Budget Categories with weekly, monthly, and yearly timelines
 Bills, Transfers, Incomes (Invoices), Split a Bill
 Budget Category prediction for Bills and imported transactions
 Goals Definition
 Exchange rates
 Recurring Payments
 Metrics: forecast (Monte Carlo simulation), candlestick (OHLC) chart, income health radar,
 bar race
 Synchronization between devices (P2P)
 Recovery via WebDav or a direct File
 Import from CSV, QIF, OFX, MT940, camt.053 files for Bills and Invoices
 Bank integrations: FinTS 4.1 (German banks), SimpleFIN Bridge (US), Enable Banking (EU, PSD2),
 Wise API (Global)
 Export to Excel (XLSX) file
 Data encryption
 Localizations: EN, BE, PL, PT, FR, DE, UK, ZH, HI, UZ, FA, AR, AZ, JA, ES, IT, TR, KO, NL,
 CS, RO, KA, RU, ID, PT-BR, ZH-TW
 Security: password protection, one-time password, biometrics
 Responsive and Adaptive Design
 Shortcuts
 If you would like to come with suggestions, report bugs, translate the app, or contribute otherwise,
 feel free to reach out!
 This is an "open source code" application that welcomes and values contributions from the community.
 However, there are some restrictions when it comes to external modification and distribution, as
 it follows the CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 license. As the author of this project, I agree to abide by the
 "Terms of Use" and "Privacy Policy" to ensure the well-being and satisfaction of all users on all
 platforms (desktop, mobile and web).

flathub:io.github.bkueng.qMasterPassword.description:
qMasterPassword is a graphical password manager. Access all your passwords
using only a single master password. But in contrast to other managers it does
not store any passwords: Unique passwords are generated from the master password
and a site name. This means you automatically get different passwords for each
account and there is no password file that can be lost or get stolen. There is
also no need to trust any online password service.
There exists compatible software for other platforms, for example Android or
iOS.

flathub:me.dumke.Reinschrift.description:
Reinschrift combines a native GNOME interface with the simplicity of plain text.
 Your tasks remain a normal Markdown file – easy to back up, versionable via Git,
 and editable on any device with your favorite editor.
 The app syncs the file via Nextcloud/WebDAV, reads changes live, writes directly back,
 and thus makes classic to-do lists in plain text suitable for everyday use – without
 proprietary silos. The format remains open, portable, and transparent.

flathub:net.leatherclient.LeatherClient.name: Leather Client
flathub:net.leatherclient.LeatherClient.summary: A performance-focused Minecraft launcher and client
flathub:net.leatherclient.LeatherClient.description:
Leather Client makes it easy to play Minecraft with automatically managed performance mods and
 useful screen tools from one launcher.
 Create and manage instances, install the required Java runtime, sign in with Microsoft, and

flathub:org.armagetronad.ArmagetronAdvan.name: Armagetron Advanced
flathub:org.armagetronad.ArmagetronAdvan.description:
In Armagetron Advanced, you ride a bizarre vehicle that can never stop and leaves a deadly trail behind. In the most basic game mode, you can only make sudden right angle turns and are trapped with others in an inescapable arena. The last survivor wins.
 Focus is firmly on online play. Pick a server that sounds fun from the server browser, hop in, stay and play there for as long as you like with the same people. Online, you will find many variations of the core gameplay principle. There are other objectives than mere survival. In Fortress Mode, two teams face each other. Each team owns a Fortress Zone and needs to defend it while trying to conquer the enemy teams' Fortress. In Sumo Mode, everyone needs to stay inside a shrinking circle to stay alive.
 The game supports custom maps (sadly without an editor) and just about every gameplay variable can be tweaked to your, or more likely, the server owner's heart content. Speed, map size, trail length and timeouts are just the start. Even the rigid right angle turn rule can be bent!

flathub:org.gnome.Fractal.name: Fractal
flathub:org.gnome.Fractal.description:
Fractal is a Matrix messaging app for GNOME written in Rust. Its interface is optimized for
 collaboration in large groups, such as free software projects, and will fit all screens, big or small.
 Highlights:
 Find rooms to discuss your favorite topics, or talk privately to people, securely thanks to end-to-end encryption
 Send rich formatted messages, files, or your current location
 Reply to specific messages, react with emoji, mention users or rooms, edit or remove messages
 View images, and play audio and video directly in the conversation
 See who has read messages, and who is typing
 Log into multiple accounts at once (with Single-Sign On support)

flathub:org.gottcode.FocusWriter.name: FocusWriter
flathub:org.gottcode.FocusWriter.description:
FocusWriter is a simple, distraction-free word processor. It utilizes a hide-away interface that you access by moving your mouse to the edges of the screen, allowing the program to have a familiar look and feel to it while still getting out of the way so that you can immerse yourself in your work.
 FocusWriter allows you to customize your environment by creating themes that control the font, colors, and background image to add ambiance. It also features on-the-fly updating statistics, daily goals, multiple open documents, spell-checking, and much more.
 Additionally, when you open the program your current work in progress will automatically load and position you where you last left off so that you can immediately jump back in.

flathub:org.kde.kontact.name: Kontact
flathub:org.kde.kontact.summary: Handle all your emails, calendars, contacts and more within a single window
flathub:org.kde.kontact.description:
Handle your email, calendar, contacts and other personal data with Kontact. Kontact groups everything
 together in one place and helps you manage your communications, organize your day and work with
 your colleagues.
 Kontact unifies several personal information management applications into a single window to
 give you the best possible experience and boost your productivity. With Kontact you can use all
 the tools of our powerful suite in one place. Unlike proprietary web applications we value your
 privacy and support open standards, which is why Kontact gives you full control over your data.
 You can of course also access your data offline if you want to.
 Kontact consists of several well-integrated components:
 KMail - a powerful and feature-rich email client with support for a wide range of email providers.
 KOrganizer - a calendar and scheduling component of Kontact which is able to work with NextCloud,
 Kolab, Google Calendar and other calendaring services.
 KAddressBook - an easy to use contact management tool that can synchronize contacts with
 many popular services.
 Akregator - a news reader with powerful search and archiving functionality.

firefox-addons:2858328.name: Site Timer Productivity Helper
firefox-addons:2858328.summary: A simple extension which allows for soft blacklisting sites to limit time wasting or, "doom scrolling." It supports blacklisting entire domains, or simply paths of domains. Customizable timers and lightweight. Simple in scope and privacy friendly.
firefox-addons:2858328.description:
A simple extension which allows a user to input either domains (eg: reddit.com ) or specific paths of domains (eg: youtube.com/shorts ) to apply a time limiting functionality against for active tab usage. It's similar to a Pomodoro Timer, but targeting specific websites, even exclusively specific paths for websites. 
Users specify a time limit in seconds which applies to all blacklisted sites (timer carries over between blacklisted sites - so if visiting two different blacklisted sites back to back, the timer does not start to count down/reset and counts both sites under a single blacklisted timer). Users also specify a reset timer which will only count when visiting non-blacklisted sites. When the reset timer expires, the main blacklisted site timer will reset. 
After the blacklisted/domain timer expires, a popup page telling the user to do something else will appear. This behavior will continue until the reset timer expires, via spending time on non-blacklisted sites. 
 IMPORTANT: Settings changed in the extension preferences page will not take effect until the extension restarts! Read below for more information! 
 Readme / How to use: 
Users install extension -> visit "about:addons" aka the manage extensions page -> click three dots for Site Timer Productivity Helper -> Preferences
Then, users can add blacklisted sites in the top field. The timer value for blacklisted domains, and the reset timer can also be set below. Finally, there is a button to restart the extension, and a list of currently blacklisted sites. 
IMPORTANT: The< "restart extension" button is there for a good reason - the settings changed in the preferences page do not take effect unless the extension is restarted. The timers and domains will update on the page in real time after settings changes to reflect what the extension is storing in local storage for extension settings, but the live behavior of the app will not care about these changes until the extension restarts. Therefore, click the extension restart button after any changes are made to the domain blacklist, or timer values. 
 So does this mean... (use cases and functionality clarification) 
I made this addon because I wanted to blacklist specific sites for extended usage, without impacting the entire domain. For example, I want to make it easy to kick myself off of extended YouTube Shorts sessions, without stopping me from using YouTube for standard videos. 
During use, the extension will compare the root domain (eg: youtube.com ) against the blacklist. If no exact match is found within the domain blacklist, it then begins to consider the user's current tab's path, from the top path down to the end. If any match is found, it'll blacklist the site. So you can be on, " example.com/path1/path2/path3 " and if the blacklist has an entry of, " example.com/path1 " it'll still blacklist, " example.com/..../path3 ". However, if you blacklisted ".../path3" without other entries for this domain and were visiting only ".../path1" then it would not blacklist the page. 
It treats all matches between blacklisted sites as equal. Swapping from one blacklisted site to another doesn't change the timer status, and currently I don't have anything set up to change the timer for a specific site. 
If the user uses up a portion of the blacklist timer BUT DOES NOT EXPIRE IT, then the user goes back to non-blacklisted sites, the blacklist timer will slowly start to tick down back to zero.

firefox-addons:2920430.description:
This extension uses Dofus official translations from DofusDB's API to translate any matching item, resource, quest, achievement, etc. from the current webpage to one of the 4 official Dofus languages: EN, ES, PT or DE
To activate the translation for the current tab, simply click the extension icon. Once the page is translated, you can translate the rest using you browser's built-in translation tool. In Firefox, I suggest using the TWP - Translate Web Pages extension, which uses google translate.
To change the language of the extension, right-click the extension, click Manage Extension, then go to the Options tab.

firefox-addons:3061615.name: AliHelp - AliExpress Shopping Assistant
firefox-addons:3061615.summary: The ultimate AliExpress shopping assistant! Track price history, verify seller trust, find hidden coupons, and search by image safely.
firefox-addons:3061615.description:
AliHelp - Your Ultimate AliExpress Shopping Assistant 🛒✨
Make smarter purchasing decisions and save money on AliExpress with AliHelp! Our all-in-one browser extension is designed to provide you with crucial insights, ensuring you always get the best deals from reliable sellers.
🚀 Key Features: 
📉 Price History Tracker: 
Never get tricked by fake discounts! View the 3 to 6-month price history of any product to know if a sale is genuine or artificially inflated.
🛡 Seller Trust & Reliability Check: 
Buy with confidence. We analyze seller ratings, communication speed, shipping time, and store age to give you a clear "Trust Score" before you checkout.
🔍 Search by Image: 
Found a product you like elsewhere? Simply right-click any image on the web and use our "Search by Image" feature to find the exact or similar items on AliExpress instantly.
🎫 Auto Coupon Finder: 
Stop wasting time searching for promo codes. AliHelp automatically detects and helps you apply the best available coupons and discounts at checkout.
🕵 Fake Review Detector: 
Filter out bots and fake reviews. Get authentic insights from real buyers to ensure product quality.
 Why choose AliHelp? 
- 100% Free to use.
- Lightweight and fast.
- No intrusive ads.
- Privacy-focused (we don't collect personal data).
 Upgrade your online shopping experience today and never overpay on AliExpress again!

firefox-addons:830925.name: Icecream Password Manager
firefox-addons:830925.summary: Firefox Plugin for Icecream Password Manager helps you to protect and manage your logins and passwords, credit cards, identities, bank accounts, secure notes and more. Plugin will help you to automatically log in and fill-in the forms online.
firefox-addons:830925.description:
Firefox Plugin for Icecream Password Manager helps you to protect and manage your most important data: logins and passwords, credit cards, identities, bank accounts, passports and more. Remember just one master password to get access to all your sensitive data. Plugin also enables you to generate passwords and automatically log in and fill-in the forms online. 
IMPORTANT: This extension requires Icecream Password Manager for Mac or Windows, downloaded separately and available at https://icecreamapps.com/Password-Manager/

firefox-addons:2269040.name: Bonjourr · Minimalist New Tab Page
firefox-addons:2269040.summary: A beautiful and customizable new tab page inspired by iOS, designed for a calm and focused browsing experience.
firefox-addons:2269040.description:
Bonjourr is a modern alternative to extensions like Momentum and Tabliss, blending iOS-inspired design with powerful customization tools to create a calm, functional new tab page experience you'll actually enjoy.
🏆 Featured in Google Chrome's Favorites of 2023
🌄 Beautiful and minimalist by default
- Dynamic 4K photos and video backgrounds that change according to the mood of the day
- Clean, iOS-inspired interface
- Smooth, fast and lightweight performance
⚡️ Powerful productivity tools when you need them
- Manage your bookmarks through Quick Links
- Search bar compatible with all search engines, including custom ones
- Markdown notes and checklists (to do)
- Pomodoro focus timer
- Weather forecast
- Daily inspirational quotes
🎨 Full customization
- Granular control over backgrounds, bookmarks and layout
- In-depth analog or digital clock customization
- Custom fonts and CSS styling
- Dark mode support
- Available in 43 languages
🔒 Privacy first
Bonjourr collects no data, requires no account or sign-in, and only requests minimal permissions. Backgrounds are made by humans and do not use generative AI. Fully open source and transparent.
👨💻 Independently made
Bonjourr is crafted by two independent developers who genuinely care about design, privacy and things well made, not by a company with a roadmap driven by ads or investors.
Whether you're looking for a minimalist start page, a personalized homepage, or a productivity-focused new tab page, Bonjourr brings everything together beautifully.

Ready to turn your time with friends and family into an explosion of fun? BLeBRiTY is the ultimate charades game to play when your day needs more laughter!
Where all other charades games are generic, our categories are unmatched in bringing laughter to the party. BLeBRiTY charades is a game to play with your bestie, spouse, kids, or your whole family.
Try and guess the word on your phone using clues from your friends. Act it out, sing it loud, or describe the clues in ways only your friends would know! If you enjoy fast and fun gameplay, challenging and sometimes awkward moments, this app was built for you. Non stop games with your family and kids.

100+ Hilarious decks & over 5,000 words
No ads, just non-stop fun.
All new custom deck builder to create your own versions of fun with friends
Fresh new decks and updates all the time
Unlimited fun and games
How to Play Charades:
Gather your team and pick a deck.
One player holds the phone up to their forehead for everyone else to see.
When the game starts, teammates can yell and act out hints to the word.
Tilt the phone down to confirm a correct guess, or up to skip.

bluejetty:00027485:ios.name: Copy My Data - Smart Transfer
bluejetty:00027485:ios.summary:
Switching to a new phone? Transfer your data in minutes, not hours!
Moving to a new device shouldn't be a headache. Copy My Data offers a secure, fast, and wireless way to migrate your most important information from one device to another.
bluejetty:00027485:ios.description:
Switching to a new phone? Transfer your data in minutes, not hours!
Moving to a new device shouldn't be a headache. Copy My Data offers a secure, fast, and wireless way to migrate your most important information from one device to another. No cables, no complex software—just a simple WiFi connection.
Whether you are staying on the same operating system or switching to a different one, we’ve got you covered.
WHAT CAN YOU TRANSFER?
Contacts: Move your entire address book instantly.
Calendar: Keep all your appointments and important dates.
Photos & Videos: Relive your favorite memories on your new screen.
Files: Transfer essential documents without the cloud.
WHY CHOOSE COPY MY DATA?
Cross-Platform Magic: Transfer data between different operating systems or devices of the same brand with zero compatibility issues.
WiFi-Powered Speed: Forget about messy cables. Our app uses your local WiFi network for a lightning-fast migration.
Privacy First: Your data stays on your devices. We don’t store your personal information on external servers.
Step-by-Step Guide: Our intuitive interface walks you through the entire process, making it foolproof even for non-tech users.
HOW TO GET STARTED (3 EASY STEPS):
Connect both devices to the same WiFi network.
Open Copy My Data on both phones.
Follow the on-screen instructions to pair and start the transfer!
IMPORTANT WIFI NOTE:
For a successful transfer, ensure both devices are on the same network. Please note that some public or corporate networks may block communication between devices. For best results, use your home WiFi.
LEGAL & PRIVACY:
By using our app, you agree to our terms and privacy policy.
Privacy Policy: https://www.redsky-labs.com/privacy-policy-apps.html
Terms of Use: https://www.redsky-labs.com/Service_Terms.html

bluejetty:00087903:ios.description:
Don’t worry when someone else is looking at your phone.
We all have those specific photos or videos we’d rather keep to ourselves. Whether it's a personal memory or a private moment, Vaulty gives you a secure, secondary space that only you can enter. Hide what you want, and keep the rest of your gallery exactly as it is.
Why Users Trust Vaulty:
• Selective Privacy: Easily move specific photos and videos into your secure vault. You decide what stays visible to others.
• Decoy Vault (Decoy PIN): If someone asks to see the app, a secondary Decoy PIN opens a completely empty gallery.
• Total Disguise: Camouflage Vaulty as a "Notes" or "Passwords" app. What stays invisible, stays private.
• Cloud Backup: Your private space is backed up in your personal cloud. Your memories are never lost, even if you lose or change your device.
• Instant Access: Securely unlock your vault in a second using PIN or Face ID.
Your privacy, your control. Download Vaulty and own your personal space.

bluejetty:00065172:ios.name: OCCU Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00065172:ios.summary:
OCCU Mobile Banking allows you to do your banking securely at anytime and anywhere – in the palm of your hand! Access and view your account balances, pay your bills, and transfer money conveniently.
Use OCCU Mobile Banking for fast, easy,
bluejetty:00065172:ios.description:
OCCU Mobile Banking allows you to do your banking securely at anytime and anywhere – in the palm of your hand! Access and view your account balances, pay your bills, and transfer money conveniently.
Use OCCU Mobile Banking for fast, easy, on-the-go banking. There are no new passwords to remember – all account login information is the same as your online banking. The app is compatible with iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad.
With OCCU Mobile Banking you can:
• Log in with your Username and Password
• Set-up Fingerprint ID or Facial Recognition for secure and quick access
• View your account activity, balances and recent transactions
• Pay bills now or set them up for a future payment date
• View and edit upcoming scheduled bills and transfers
• Send money instantly with Interac e-Transfer®
• Transfer money between your accounts, including different memberships
• Quickly and securely deposit your cheques by using your smartphone or tablet
• Display your balances at-a-glance without having to log in with QuickView
It’s simple to use and free*
Security
Your security is our top priority, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full online banking.
Permissions
In order to use OCCU Mobile Banking, you'll need to grant our app permission to access certain functions on your mobile phone, including:
• Full network access – Allows our app to connect to the Internet.
• Take pictures and videos – Deposit cheques using Deposit Anywhere™ right from your mobile phone by allowing our app access to your phone camera.
• Access to your phone contacts – Get the utmost in convenience by allowing our app to access your list of contacts, that way you can send an Interac e-Transfer® to someone on your contact list without manually setting them up as a recipient in mobile banking.
Access
Access is available to all members who currently use our online banking service. If you’re not an Oshawa Community Credit Union member, no problem – simply contact us and set up a new membership. You’ll be set up with access right away.
Use of the mobile app is subject to the terms and conditions found in our Oshawa Community Credit Union Account Access Agreement for personal accounts.
*You may incur service charges for various online services depending on the type of account you have. In addition, your mobile carrier may charge you for using your mobile device to access the services provided by our mobile app.

bluejetty:00071467:ios.name: Varia™
bluejetty:00071467:ios.summary:
When paired with a compatible Garmin Varia radar device¹, the Varia app has the tools you need to ride with confidence. Using the Varia app, you can: 
• Be alerted right on your phone when approaching vehicles are within 140 meters behind y
bluejetty:00071467:ios.description:
When paired with a compatible Garmin Varia radar device¹, the Varia app has the tools you need to ride with confidence. Using the Varia app, you can: 
• Be alerted right on your phone when approaching vehicles are within 140 meters behind your bicycle. 
• View color-coded alerts based on surrounding traffic: Green means you’re all clear, yellow means a vehicle is approaching and red means a vehicle is coming at you quickly and you should take caution. 
• Receive tone and vibration alerts for approaching vehicles even when you’re not looking at your phone. 
With a compatible Garmin Varia Radar Camera Tail Light or Garmin Varia Vue Camera Headlight, you can: 
• Set the camera in the best position for capturing videos and photos. 
• Record videos or take photos and save them while riding with a simple button press on your phone. 
• Automatically record videos of incidents and save the video footage with the Incident Recording feature. 
With a Varia Vue Camera Headlight, you can: 
• Configure light mode configurations for your headlight. 
• Add an optional Vault subscription, which automatically backs up your Varia Vue videos and provides easy access in the Varia app for searching, filtering and sharing. 
By adding the Varia eRTL615 Radar Tail Light for eBikes, you can: 
• Configure and edit light mode configurations for your tail light. 
Easy to Use 
Pairing your Garmin Varia devices with the app is quick and easy. Once you set them up, the Varia app will automatically recognize your devices. 
Even if you already have a Varia device paired with a compatible Garmin device or head unit, the Varia app provides additional awareness and peace of mind while riding. 
¹ Compatible devices are the Varia RearVue 820, Varia RVR315 Rearview Radar, Varia RTL515 Radar Tail Light, Varia RCT715 Radar Camera Tail Light, Varia eRTL615 Radar Tail Light for eBikes and Varia Vue Camera Headlight.

bluejetty:00063486:ios.description:
Download Headout to discover and book the world's best things to do — wherever you are, whenever you want.
Whether you're planning a trip months out or looking for something to do tonight, Headout makes booking tickets, tours, and activities effortless. From iconic landmarks to local favorites across 100+ cities, your next adventure is a few taps away.
Book the world's most iconic experiences
Get tickets to the attractions you came to see — the Eiffel Tower, the Colosseum, Burj Khalifa, the Vatican, Universal Studios Singapore, Tokyo's teamLab, Disneyland Paris, and more. Explore tens of thousands of experiences across museums, landmarks, day trips, cruises, theme parks, and guided tours.
Headout works in 100+ cities — Paris, Rome, London, Dubai, New York, Barcelona, Singapore, Istanbul, Tokyo, Las Vegas, and more. Each city is curated by people who know it inside out, so you get the highlights and the hidden gems, not a generic tourist list.
Travel without the friction 
 Instant ticket confirmation -Book in advance or last-minute, your tickets will be confirmed in seconds!
- Book now, pay later -Secure your spot and pay later. It’s that simple.
- Last-minute bookings - Feeling spontaneous? Snag last-minute tickets in a flash.
- Secure payments - We’ve got multiple payment options. All safe and hassle-free. Book with Credit Card, PayPal, or Exclusive app-only promos
Designed for how you actually travel
The Headout app keeps your bookings organized, sends reminders before each activity, and helps you find the meeting point on the day. No digging through emails, no last-minute confusion.
24/7 support, in your language - Questions before or during your trip? Reach our team any time via email, phone, or live chat — in multiple languages.
Trusted by 52 million+ travelers - Headout has welcomed over 50 million guests worldwide, with a 4.4 rating on Trustpilot from real travelers. Read reviews on every experience before you book.
Ready to experience the world like never before? Download the Headout app and unlock a world of unforgettable experiences!
Leave us a review if you’re enjoying your Headout app experience or head over to our help page for further assistance: support@headout.com

bluejetty:00155077:ios.name: SAVO: All-In-One Wallet
bluejetty:00155077:ios.summary: Welcome to the SAVO Wallet, where managing your wealth becomes a breeze! Say goodbye to complicated processes and hello to effortless control over your assets. With unbeatable exchange rates, instant transaction conversions, and super-fast
bluejetty:00155077:ios.description:
Welcome to the SAVO Wallet, where managing your wealth becomes a breeze! Say goodbye to complicated processes and hello to effortless control over your assets. With unbeatable exchange rates, instant transaction conversions, and super-fast global payments, you’re just a tap away from financial freedom. Plus, enjoy exclusive trust and bank accounts in your name for a safe and convenient asset management experience.
Exciting Features
1. Global Network for Instant Payments
Thanks to our innovative SAVONet global payment system, you can send and receive money across multiple regions in a flash! Create dedicated trust bank accounts for larger transactions, making your asset flow secure and hassle-free.
2. Lightning-fast Swaps
With financial licenses in various regions and partnerships with top-notch institutions, SAVO has your back! Our smart risk control system keeps an eye on suspicious activities 24/7, ensuring every transaction is as secure as can be.
3. Supports All Major Currencies
As a powerhouse wallet, SAVO allows you to manage a variety of currencies—all in one place! Whether you’re at home or traveling, you can easily access and grow your wealth.
4. Spend Anywhere with Our Debit Card
The SAVO debit card lets you shop globally in multiple currencies, making it perfect for everything from daily purchases to business trips. With top-tier security features and real-time balance checks, your spending is always safe and transparent.
5. High-Interest Savings
Take advantage of SAVO’s demand savings feature and watch your wealth grow with competitive interest rates! All your assets are managed by licensed professionals, ensuring your money is in good hands.
6. Diverse Investment Opportunities
Explore a wide array of asset classes, from securities to crypto and alternative investments, tailored to fit your unique preferences. With carefully selected investment options, you’ll be ready to seize every opportunity for growth.
7. Chat and Connect in Real-Time
SAVO isn’t just about managing money; it’s a lively social platform too! With SAVOChat, you can chat, share files, and even explore fun mini-programs with other users. All conversations are securely encrypted, so you can engage freely and safely.
8. SAVO Miniapp Platform
Dive into our new open application platform, packed with exciting features and third-party apps! With support for all kinds of developers, your wallet can keep expanding with fresh functionalities.
With its powerful tools and innovative design, the SAVO Wallet is your go-to choice for managing both fiat and crypto assets. Whether you need instant payments, secure asset management, or social connections, SAVO is here to make wealth management fun, safe, and efficient!
Join us and discover how easy and exciting managing your finances can be—welcome to the SAVO family!

Skyline Taxis - Bedford, Milton Keynes, Northampton and Wellingborough’s local Taxi App. Book a Taxi in under 10 seconds and experience priority service from the largest taxi and mini cab firm across Bedfordshire, Buckinghamshire and Northamptonshire with over 2000 vehicles. 
Booking with Skyline Taxis
Going to the airport, the local shop, across town or out of town, your Skyline Taxi will be with you in minutes. Just Open the app, enter your destination, get picked up by a nearby driver and enjoy a low-cost trip to your destination.
Book ASAP / on demand or Pre-book ahead of time
See price estimates
With Skyline, you can see price estimates before you book, simply enter your destination for a quote.
How can I pay
Pay securely in app with a debit or credit card, add your Business account or pay cash.
Your safety
Track your driver in real time, you’ll see your driver’s name, picture, rating and vehicle details including registration before arriving. Need to contact your driver, message or call directly from the app.
Need a multi seater vehicle or upgrade to VIP?
Both available through the app, ETA and quotes available prior to booking.
Rate and tip your driver
Rate your driver after every trip and help us improve our service. You can also tip your driver in app to show your appreciation.
#DrivenbyRIIDE
The Skyline Taxis app is connected to the RIIDE network.
Travelling out of town, Skylines Taxi Booking App will book you a cab with a reputable local company across the UK and Ireland!
Including in the following towns/cities:
UK: Milton Keynes, Northampton, Bedford, Wellingborough, Buckingham, Towcester, Birmingham, Cambridge, Derby, Leicester, Liverpool, Loughborough, London, Luton, Manchester, Newcastle, Oxford, Sheffield, Stockport, Belfast Northern Ireland, Edinburgh & Glasgow Scotland, IRELAND: Dublin
Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/Skylinetaxis
Like us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/SkylineTaxis
Questions? Visit skylinetaxis.co.uk/contact-us/

bluejetty:00176323:ios.description:
No subscriptions. No ads. No account.
Free 4-7-8 and box breathing, on iPhone and Apple Watch.
Simple guided breathing. Just breathe.
Birch also brings your breathing and daily habits together. Track a few things that matter - drink water, take vitamins, read, fast, walk, meditate, or create your own - and log them in one tap.
Birch makes guided breathing simple, beautiful, and easy to return to. Choose a breathing pattern, set a time or number of cycles, and follow the visual guide as you breathe, hold, and exhale. Use Birch to slow down before sleep, reset during a stressful day, or take a quiet minute for yourself.
WHY BIRCH
- No subscriptions
- No ads
- No account required
- Simple, focused design
- Apple Watch & Health support
GUIDED BREATHING TECHNIQUES
- Weil Method (4-7-8)
- Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
- Gentle Wave (7-11)
- Balance (3-3-6-3)
- Heart Coherence (6-6)
- Slow-Paced Breathing (4-6)
SIMPLE HABIT TRACKING
- Create yes/no or count-based habits
- Choose an emoji and color for each habit
- Log today or update a recent day
- See breathing and habits together across your week and calendar
- Set gentle reminders at times you choose
PROGRESS WITHOUT PRESSURE
View breathing cycles, completed habits, streaks, and monthly summaries at a glance. Birch keeps the information useful without turning wellbeing into another chore.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Birch works without an account. Your breathing sessions can also count toward Mindful Minutes in Apple Health.
Download Birch and take one calm breath. Then build from there.
Birch supports general wellness and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a healthcare provider about specific health concerns.

bluejetty:00040550:ios.description:
Download the new Evening Standard app for the latest London and national news with breaking global headlines, features, sports and photography from the capital’s most sought-after daily newspaper.
Free and updated throughout the day and night, the Evening Standard app also offers a complete digital replica of the printed newspaper. Also included are digital versions of ES Magazine and Homes & Property every week, plus interactive puzzles from the paper.
Enjoy incisive articles, expert commentary, explore sections including News, Comment, GO London, Lifestyle, Showbiz and more…
Download the Evening Standard app now to discover an up-to-the-minute breaking news feed, keeping you informed on what’s happening at home and globally with live news notifications sent direct to your device.
FEATURES:
• The latest breaking headlines, live news, reviews and opinion on the stories that really matter
• The best news, showbiz stories, essential sports updates and features every day
• Translation to 21 languages for all newspaper and magazine articles.
• Audio listen tool will read out loud any article.
• Print, Share, adjust font type and font size, bookmark your favourite articles
• Interactive versions of all daily crosswords, sudoku and codeword puzzles from the paper, playable offline
• Read essential content offline when it suits you
• New easy-to-use navigation
• Responsive design complimenting the print edition
• 1 year archive of the newspaper and all printed supplements, including ES Magazine and Homes & Property
The Evening Standard app gives you intelligent journalism and is a trusted source for the latest national news as well as offering incisive coverage of the international stories that count on the global stage.
Download the Evening Standard app today and get instant access to ES Magazine anytime, anywhere. Published every Thursday, it covers London’s rich cultural life of fashion, arts, beauty and more, plus all the parties, all the people and all the glamour. ES Magazine is available for you at home or at work and is the same edition as the printed copy available at the newsstand.
Discover Homes & Property supplement on Wednesdays, including London property market listings as well as informative articles from our lifestyle journalists. 
Tackle your favourite crosswords, sudokus and codewords directly in the app.
If you have any questions about the latest update please email customerservices@standard.co.uk
https://www.standard.co.uk

bluejetty:00187979:ios.description:
*** Contact your IT administrator for any help with setting up BlackBerry Work *** 
Take care of business simply, elegantly and securely with BlackBerry Work. Stay on top of your business email, schedule and join meetings, and manage your contacts with an easy to use, all-in-one app. 
BlackBerry Work delivers a personalized business experience. See your colleagues’ photos in your email. View online availability to chat everywhere you work - in email, a calendar event and on their contact card – a capability unique to BlackBerry. Quickly navigate among your business apps using Launcher. Switch easily between composing an email, adding a contact, or scheduling a calendar event with quick action buttons. And always know that your personal privacy is protected without intrusive geo-location capabilities. 
Simple app navigation:
• Launcher: Simplify multi-tasking and app navigation with easy switching between your email, calendar, contacts, app settings and other BlackBerry apps.
• Quick actions: Work smarter with quick action buttons to compose an email, schedule a meeting or add a contact.
• Contextual file actions: Choose the right actions for your documents – edit, annotate, save, print, sign, etc. based on the other BlackBerry-secured apps installed on your device
Improve productivity:
• Email: Manage your inbox on the go! Check and respond to email, move messages to a folder, and take and attach photos. 
• Calendar: Stay in touch with your colleagues, customers and partners wherever you are. Join meetings or schedule new ones. Even send a quick reply message if you are running late.
• Contacts: See all of your Outlook contacts, personal and work. Add additional information to the contact card or get the caller ID by sync’ing the contacts to the device. 
Personalize your experience:
• Directory Photos: Your inbox, calendar and contacts now displays photos from your global address list so you can now enjoy more effective social interactions 
• People centric collaboration: Choose the best way to reach your colleagues based on their online availability status. Initiate a call, an email, an IM or an SMS from within the app them based on their availability. 
Quick notifications:
• Badges: See how many unread email you have right on your device home screen without opening the app. .
• VIP notifications: Never miss an important message. Set VIP status for key contacts to be notified via custom alerts when they send you an email.

bluejetty:00160651:ios.description:
Build a brand people follow.
Meet your AI team for social media. Muza AI helps you understand your profile, shape your strategy, and create content that reflects your brand. From your next idea to the final edit, bring your creative work together in one app.
For creators, experts, and bloggers building a personal brand. For shops, companies, and local businesses with something worth sharing. Turn your knowledge, ideas, and offers into content people can connect with.
YOUR BRAND. YOUR AI TEAM.
Bring direction to your social presence with a virtual AI team that helps with analysis, strategy, planning, and creation. Get support throughout the creative process while keeping your own voice, style, and vision.
KNOW WHAT TO POST NEXT
Start with an analysis of your social media profile. Develop a strategy around your brand and goals, then turn it into a content plan. Explore relevant ideas and give every post a purpose, whether you’re sharing your expertise, introducing a product, or telling your story.
CREATE CONTENT IN ONE FLOW
Bring ideas to life with AI-generated text, photos, and videos. Create in a single guided flow, with presets for different niches to help you find the right starting point. Take the result into the editors and make it your own.
AI AVATARS & VIRTUAL PHOTOSHOOTS
Explore new ways to show up visually. Create AI avatars, discover virtual photoshoots, and experiment with looks and creative concepts for your content. Develop visuals that express your personality and bring your brand’s style to life.
THREE POWERFUL EDITORS. FULL CREATIVE CONTROL.
Make every detail count with dedicated photo, video, and post editors.
– Photo editor: edit, retouch, and enhance your images with manual controls and AI tools.
– Video editor: refine your footage, adjust its look, and shape videos for your social presence.
– Post editor: bring visuals and text together to create posts in your own style.
Work with your own material or refine AI-generated content. From quick adjustments to detailed manual editing, you choose the finishing touches.
MAKE YOUR CONTENT READY TO SHARE
Upscale images for greater resolution. Add video captions to make your message easier to follow. Use the teleprompter to stay on script while recording. Bring AI tools and hands-on editing into your everyday creative process.
Spend less time figuring out what to create and more time sharing what makes your brand worth following.
Start building your brand with Muza AI.
IN-APP PURCHASES
Muza AI offers in-app purchases. Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00127029:ios.name: Fantasy Mahjong World Voyage
bluejetty:00127029:ios.summary: If you enjoy Mahjong Solitaire tile-matching puzzles (aka Majong or Mah-Jong), then checkout our fantasy-themed version of the classic game. Our mahjong solitaire game evokes the sense of wonder by its magic, RPG, tall-tales, treasures, and
bluejetty:00127029:ios.description:
If you enjoy Mahjong Solitaire tile-matching puzzles (aka Majong or Mah-Jong), then checkout our fantasy-themed version of the classic game. Our mahjong solitaire game evokes the sense of wonder by its magic, RPG, tall-tales, treasures, and fantasy theme. There are thousands of boards to challenge players, all free to play in their mahjong journey.
About:
Mahjong Solitaire is a legendary tile-matching board game. It's a classic puzzle which challenges player's concentration and strategic thinking. The goal is to match all the symbol or icons on a board.
The game starts with tile-pieces stacked and arranged on the board, which vary in dimensions, forming structures such as pyramids, symmetrical, stacks, towers, abstract, or animal shapes. Every piece has a face (basically a symbol or a picture) denoting its "identity." Typically, in traditional classic Asian style mah-jongg, the symbols are circles, bamboos, Chinese letters, seasons, and dragon pictures. But here, they are colorful artwork from fantasy, role playing, RPG and magic realms.
Match the tiles to solve the puzzle. Every tile has a pair to match against. When all have been matched, the player wins the game. Matches can only be made with "free" tiles (the ones with nothing blocking their left, right or above them). The challenge is to strategize and think ahead, to not end up with unmatched tiles.
Features:
* Classic traditional-based Mahjongg solitaire puzzle, but with wonder-inducing fantasy and magic theme.
* Epic puzzles: over 3000 multi-dimensional majong boards, with varying symbols - free to play without In App Purchase. No tokens to collect and no locked levels. Freely pick and play any of the puzzles in any order.
* We put a lot of efforts to make the style special! Like a tour and a journey in a magical world of wonder. Vibrant artworks to enhance the icon-matching journey.
* Simple tap, touch and click interface: match symbols with intuitive mobile-touch interface. No complicated hands-coordination needed. Perfect for relaxing.
* No timer. Play with no pressure. Player's best times are recorded so they can try to beat them. Or simply ignore the timer, relax, and play for as long as you like.
* Hint, shuffle, and rotate-board options to help in your journey with challenging levels.
* Virtually a new challenge every round, because the majong piles are randomly placed by our unique solitaire-generator, every round presents an unique challenge.
* Customize and adjust the gameplay-style, which allows adjustment of the challenge, such as by highlighting movable symbols, changing the symbol icons, or adjusting the colors.
* Extra challenges for players who enjoy winning through wonders: match and clear the majung board without using the hints, shuffles, or dimming features.
* Designed for mobile devices: we aim to make our app pleasant to use not just on tablets, but also on variety of screen sizes. The mahjongg board will scale to fit the device dimension.
* Bonus (optional) quest: Complete the mahjong challenges by earning all the achievement-medals.
To summarize... if you're looking for mahjong solitaire challenges that differs from the traditional or classic numbers, dragon and bamboo tiles, then check out our unique fantasy-themed and free version. Journey and tour into the fantastical, mystifying-enchanting-world of tale and wonder in Mahjong Fantasy; and feel the magic of its mysterious ambiance. Solve puzzles, from fewer than 100 tiles to the challenging epic mega board with over 300 tiles. We hope that you enjoy your mahjong-voyage experience!

With CoreDefence VPN, your internet connection
bluejetty:00097150:ios.description:
DESCRIPTION
CoreDefence VPN is a secure and easy-to-use solution designed to protect your online privacy, safeguard your data, and provide reliable internet access across different networks.
With CoreDefence VPN, your internet connection is encrypted, your IP address is masked, and your online activity is protected. Whether you’re browsing at home, using public Wi-Fi, traveling, or working remotely, CoreDefence VPN helps keep your connection secure and your data protected.
KEY FEATURES
• Secure VPN connection with encrypted traffic
• Data protection on public and private Wi-Fi networks
• IP address masking for enhanced privacy
• Safe access for browsing, apps, and streaming
• High-speed global servers for stable performance
• One-tap connection for quick and easy use
• No activity or browsing logs
WHY COREDDEFENCE VPN
CoreDefence VPN is built with a strong focus on privacy, data protection, and stable performance. The app runs smoothly in the background, allowing you to browse, stream, and work online with confidence and security wherever you are.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
CoreDefence VPN offers auto-renewable subscription plans, allowing users to choose the option that best fits their needs:
• 1 Week subscription — $9.99
Includes a 3-day free trial
• 1 Month subscription — $16.99
• 6 Months subscription — $65.99
• 12 Months subscription — $95.99
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple ID account settings. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased. Prices may vary by country or region.
PRICING & ACCESS INFORMATION
The weekly subscription is offered as a flexible short-term option for users who want full premium access without a long-term commitment. Pricing reflects the operational costs of maintaining a high-quality VPN service, including server infrastructure, security updates, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
The weekly subscription may be shown on first app launch and when a user attempts to access premium features. All available plans - weekly, monthly, 6-month, and 12-month - are accessible at any time via the “Get Premium” banner in the app.
LEGAL & SUPPORT
Website: https://coredefence.website
Privacy Policy: https://coredefence.website/policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support Email: support@coredefence.website

bluejetty:00132129:ios.description:
MDScan is a professional mobile scanner that transforms your iPhone into a full-fledged digital office. Forget about bulky MFPs and chaos in your documents.
Do you think the built-in iOS "Notes" app is enough for scanning? Basic tools are good for taking a quick photo of a receipt, but they are powerless when it comes to working with important papers. MDScan is designed for those who value perfect quality, a structured archive, and confidentiality.

• Preservation of physical dimensions: MDScan allows you not just to crop the image, but to use ready-made document templates. Set precise physical sizes for passports, ID cards, or custom forms so they display perfectly and are suitable for printing.
• Advanced camera control: Choose the mode for the task — the system document camera for quick snapshots, the MDScan manual mode for precise focus and boundary detection, or the batch mode for multi-page contracts.

• Enterprise-level security: Send PDFs and JPEGs in password-protected ZIP archives.
• Full cloud freedom: Automatic synchronization not only with iCloud, but also with Google Drive, Dropbox, and support for the WebDAV protocol for personal servers.
Turn paper chaos into a flawless digital system.
Download MDScan today and manage documents like a pro!

Facing challenges in algebra, calculus, or basic arithmetic? Leave behind the frustration and unleash the power of Photo Math: AI Homework Helper, the ultimate math app! It’s your personal math superhero, prepared to tackle any problem you throw its way.

Just imagine:
- Capture a photo of your homework question using the built-in homework scanner, and watch as Photo Math: AI Homework Helper systematically breaks it down step-by-step until you reach the answer.
- Stuck on a tricky concept? No worries! Type your question in plain English, and Photo Math Helper will explain it in a way that makes sense to you.
- Need help with writing an essay? No problem! Use the built-in essay writer tool to get assistance with structure, ideas, and even grammar.

Photo Math: AI Homework Helper is:
- Smarter than the average calculator: It’s a powerful equation solver that can handle complex equations, graphs, and even word problems.
- Faster than your best friend: Get instant solutions so you can move on to the next challenge.
- More patient than your teacher: Photo Math Helper is always there to guide you through every step, no matter how many times you need it explained.

Whether you're studying for a big test or just trying to get through your assignments, this study helper stands out among the best apps to help with homework. Ready to crush your math anxiety and ace that next exam? Download Photo Math: AI Homework Helper today and experience the power of AI-powered learning!

Photo Math: AI Homework Helper app is available for free download and offers the option for convenient auto-renewal of unlimited usage subscriptions. To unlock access to all the features mentioned above, a subscription to the premium content within the app is required. Please note that subscription is automatically renewed unless you disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. The renewal fee for your subscription will be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.

bluejetty:00062566:ios.description:
Learning languages is a demanding process. No one can deny that. However, learning Chinese is even harder because of the lack of good apps, resources and the natural complexity of the language. Today we will speak about a great app that can become your #1 app for learning Chinese – Pinyin Helper
Why you’ll love it?
Pinyin Helper captivates instantly with its sleek design, speed and intuitiveness. The app will easily translate any phrase or sentence you desire to be translated. Additionally, it has exceptionally good audio to listen to each word and thus understand and learn the pronunciation, not only the meaning. Everything you do on this Chinese learning iPhone app feels incredibly intuitive!
Detailed Dictionary
Along with its instant translation and pronunciation features, there is a reliable dictionary that will explain each word in depth. All you need to do is copy the character/word and there will be an explanation instantly displayed. The great thing is that you can re-listen any particular word again and again if you care about learning it precisely.
At the end of the day, Pinyin Helper keeps it simple, yet helpful! You are sure to enjoy your Chinese learning process and Pinyin Helper will only be of great help, and not a burden.

bluejetty:00080020:ios.description:
Place bets on horse races with BetMGM — the top-rated horse racing sportsbook for bettors located in Florida, Louisiana, and Ohio. 
Enjoy unparalleled access to wager on harness, thoroughbred, and quarter horse races at over 200 tracks worldwide, including the world's most celebrated horse races such as The Kentucky Derby, The Preakness Stakes, The Belmont Stakes, and The Breeders' Cup.
▶ WHY CHOOSE BETMGM HORSE RACING BETTING? ◀
• Wide range of betting options — Win, Place, Show, Exacta, Trifecta, Superfecta, and more /
• Take advantage of reload bonuses, enhanced rebates, loyalty offers, and insurance bets /
• Live streaming - watch from the paddock, on the track, and in the winner’s circle /
• 24/7 horse racing sportsbook - wager anytime, anywhere in FL, OH, and LA /
• Specializes in Harness, Thoroughbred, and Quarter Horse races /
• Over 200 tracks worldwide at your disposal /
• Quick race results and payouts /
[ BROAD RANGE OF BET TYPES ]
• Easily construct and place your bets with our user-friendly bet pad. Choose from a variety of wager options such as:
1. Single Horse Wagers: Win (WN), Place (PLC), Show (SHW), Win Place (WP), Win Show (WS), Place Show (PS), Win Place Show (WPS)
2. Multi-Horse Wagers: Exacta (EX), Quinella (QU), Trifecta (TRI), Superfecta (SPR), Super High 5 (SH5)
3. Multi-Race Wagers: Double (DBL), Pick Three (PK3), Pick Four (PK4), Pick Five (PK5), Pick Six (PK6), Pick Seven (PK7)
[ LIVE RACING AND REPLAYS ]
• Feel the rush of live races through our HD streaming feature, letting you watch from the paddock, on the track, and in the winner’s circle. Missed a race? No problem! Catch up with our race replays available in the "Today's Racing" section.
[ PAST PERFORMANCE AND EXPERT PICKS ]
• Download Past Performances to get all the information on today’s races. Plus, with TrackMaster selections, gain access to experts' top three picks for each US thoroughbred race.
[ EXPLORE RACE TRACKS AROUND THE WORLD ]
• BetMGM Horse Racing app brings you races from the world's renowned tracks including Churchill Downs, Saratoga, Keeneland, and more. Experience international tracks such as Ascot Downs, Epsom Downs, Flemington, Aintree, Meydan, and Longchamp.
[ WAGER ON EXCITING RACES ]
• Relish the excitement of the world's most celebrated horse races, including the Kentucky Derby, Preakness Stakes, Belmont Stakes, Breeders’ Cup, Travers Stakes, and international highlights such as the Dubai World Cup, Melbourne Cup, Grand National, Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe, and more.
[ QUICK RACE RESULTS AND PAYOUTS ]
• Get race results and payouts swiftly and accurately. The convenience of having this information at your fingertips means no more waiting around for results.
[ EXTENSIVE HANDICAPPING INFORMATION ]
• Refine your betting strategy with our comprehensive "Handicapping" section. Gain insights about upcoming races and gather valuable tips from seasoned pros analyzing every meet on the race card.
[ NYRA REWARD PROGRAM ]
• Earn points for every dollar you stake on NYRA racetracks. Redeem accumulated points for betting credits and maximize your betting opportunities.
[ EXCLUSIVE OFFERS ]
• New User Offer: Bet $200, get $200 — Boost your initial betting adventure! Stay updated with our promotional calendar featuring reload bonuses, boosted rebates, loyalty promotions, and insurance bets.
Embark on your horse racing journey today with BetMGM Horse Racing. Ready to join the action? Download the app or visit https://www.horseracing.betmgm.com/ to start betting today!
If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER. Must be 21+. Additional terms and conditions apply.

bluejetty:00187806:ios.summary:
CashCounter is the simple cash manager and financial manager for real money: count coins and bills, check the till, and keep savings goals in one place.
CashCounter is the fast way to count cash: tap once per coin or bill, see your balance
bluejetty:00187806:ios.description:
CashCounter is the simple cash manager and financial manager for real money: count coins and bills, check the till, and keep savings goals in one place.
CashCounter is the fast way to count cash: tap once per coin or bill, see your balance instantly, and track savings goals — at home, at the register, or on the road.
Who is it for?
Anyone who needs a real cash count instead of a guess. End-of-day till, change drawer, emergency fund in the safe, tip jar, garage-sale cash box, travel money, or a kid’s piggy bank.
COUNT, DON’T ESTIMATE
One tap per coin or bill. Totals and piece counts update as you go. No calculator, no notepad, no “about this much.” Built for a quick till count and for large piles of change.
AS MANY LISTS AS YOU NEED
Wallet, jar, safe, register, travel envelope — each list stays separate on one clear home screen. Household cash and business till don’t get mixed.
SAVINGS GOALS YOU CAN SEE
Set a target and watch live progress. The amount and the remaining gap stay visible, so saving stays concrete.
EVERY LIST IN THE RIGHT CURRENCY
US dollar, euro, yen, and many more. Vacation money, foreign cash, or several tills: each list uses its own currency.
WHY CASHCOUNTER
• Fast coin and bill counting
• Multiple cash lists in parallel
• Savings goals with live progress
• Lots of currencies, one app
• No spreadsheets, no scrap paper
Count the cash. Keep the overview. Hit the goal.
