bluejetty:00120532:ios.name: Reverso Context Translator
bluejetty:00120532:ios.summary:
Translate and learn millions of words and expressions and express yourself as if you were a native speaker.
Reverso is the best tool for those who seek quality translation, looking to master a foreign language: reading, writing or speaking
bluejetty:00120532:ios.description:
Translate and learn millions of words and expressions and express yourself as if you were a native speaker.
Reverso is the best tool for those who seek quality translation, looking to master a foreign language: reading, writing or speaking, and it's free.
Students, teachers, business professionals or others, whether beginners or advanced, use Reverso to learn new words or expressions, and eliminate the risk of being mistaken.
It provides you instant translations of the selected text when reading content on your browser, on Safari or any other app.
Reverso Context is based on data gathered from millions of real-life texts (official documents, movie subtitles, product descriptions) in both languages. These texts are processed with powerful "big data" algorithms and machine learning to provide you the best results. 
What do we mean by context? The search results (translation) of a specific word or expression are weaved within real-life sentences, so you will be sure to understand and learn exactly how the word can be used, and make no embarrassing mistakes. 
Just type or say the word or expression you wish to translate and the results will appear instantly: relevant translations, presented with examples of how words are used in sentences.
The app offers flashcards and quizzes based on your search history and favorites to help you memorize them and to improve your language skills. Unlike standard learning tools, it focuses on words and expressions that you really need and want to learn.
The bits and bytes: 
* Instantly translate selected text when reading content on your browser, iBook or any other app, with no need to exit the app you are using. Click on the familiar "Share" option and select the Reverso option. 
* Translation in 17 languages: Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Polish, Dutch, Arabic, Russian, Romanian, Japanese, Turkish, Hebrew and Chinese, Korean, Swedish, Ukrainian and we are working on more.
* Advanced features include pronunciation, history, phrasebook of your favorites and more.
* Create vocabulary lists based on your personal selection of examples and translations. Lists remain available even when you’re offline. 
* Enjoy natural pronunciation of complete example sentences.
* One click to get translations, frequency details, and conjugation when applicable.
* Search history, also available offline.
* Suggestions: words and expressions will be suggested to you as you type.
* Share your findings via email or social media.
Auto-renewable subscription terms:
Choose a subscription that fits your needs:
- Monthly subscription (with a 7-day free trial) for €4.99 EUR;
- Annual subscription for €39.99 EUR;
These prices corresponds to the same price tier that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines in other currencies.
Please note:
-Your free trial subscription will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period. 
-Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when a premium subscription is purchased during the free trial period.
The free trial or the subscription can be canceled anytime by turning off auto-renewal in the iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free version.
Privacy policy:
http://www.reverso.net/privacy_app.aspx?lang=EN
Terms of use:
http://www.reverso.net/disclaimer.aspx?lang=EN
* Join us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Reverso.net and follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.reverso.net/ReversoEN to discover new content, languages and features.

bluejetty:00183942:ios.description:
Investtech is a research based stock analysis & recommendation app that gives you daily stock market recommendations & updates based on advanced mathematical research & technical analysis. Use our daily Top 20 best buy candidates to make smart investment decisions.
Investtech is your investing guide with the best quantitative analysis available in the market. You can get independent and objective analysis on the Indian stock market & 9 more countries, track 29000+ stocks, get stock market analysis updates based on mathematical patterns, & market trends. 
Advanced stocks analysis & share market updates, along with buy & sell signals make Investtech the best stock market research app. Download now & get 1 week free with all premium features unlocked.
*KEY APP FEATURES*
STOCK EXCHANGE BAROMETER- Get an overview on share prices & stock market trends. Use this stock market new app to understand stock exchange & get signals on the most positive & negative stocks. The analysis helps you decide when to trade stocks & which stocks to invest in based on the behavioural finance & statistical analysis of the market trends. Use Investtech - a research based investment app with investing tips before you buy stocks or sell stocks.
PERSONALISED FEED- Track daily market changes & add stocks to your favourites list. Invest smart, get insights on investor psychology & stock analysis on your phone. Customize your feed according to which shares, indices, analysis & charts you’d like to see first.
INDICES ANALYSIS- Get recommendations for major indices. Get an overview through stock charts & stock market graphs in various indices including BSE SENSEX, NIFTY etc.
ADVANCED CHARTS- Before investing in the Indian stock market or other stock markets, use the app to study market trend. See stock chart analysis, track patterns in share prices to get the market forecast.
TOP 20 BEST BUYS- Quantitative Analysis System gives you a list of the Top 20 best buy stocks from stock market statistics, daily. The stocks analysis & advanced stock charts let you to plan the investment from short, medium & long-term perspectives. Based on the app’s technical analysis you can decide which stocks to buy now!
TODAY’S CANDIDATE- The daily candidate is selected by Investtech based on detailed analysis & study of factors like Volum, RSI & seasonal variations in the stock exchange. Look at the stock chart analysis for the selected share & study its performance in detail. 
MARKET COMMENTARY- The App’s stock chart analysis is time saving & user friendly. The Market Commentary section breaks down all changes in the stock exchange. Based on analysis & computer algorithm the app shows the best stocks with the most lucrative price movements. 
With over 21 years of experience, Investtech stock market new app makes stock trading smarter & more convenient with its detailed stock exchange analysis.

bluejetty:00130980:ios.name: Wood Match - Wood Block
bluejetty:00130980:ios.summary: Welcome to the world of Wood Match - Wood Block, where strategy and puzzle-solving come together in a relaxing yet challenging game. Inspired by classic block puzzles, Wood Match offers a fresh twist with its wooden block design and multipl
bluejetty:00130980:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Wood Match - Wood Block, where strategy and puzzle-solving come together in a relaxing yet challenging game. Inspired by classic block puzzles, Wood Match offers a fresh twist with its wooden block design and multiple game modes that will test your brain and keep you entertained for hours.
If you love games like Tetris and Sudoku, you'll feel right at home with Wood Match - Wood Block Puzzle. The gameplay is simple yet deeply engaging: drag and drop wooden blocks onto the grid, clear rows and columns, and score points with every strategic move.
Key Features:
Multiple Game Modes: Choose from four different modes for a unique puzzle experience:
Classic Mode: Enjoy the timeless challenge of block puzzles with no pressure.
Time Mode: Race against the clock and clear as many blocks as possible before time runs out!
Bomb Mode: Keep the board clear and avoid the bombs, or it's game over!
Advance Mode: Test your puzzle-solving skills with more challenging and intricate puzzles.
Stunning Wooden Design: Enjoy the calming visuals of wooden blocks with smooth gameplay that enhances your puzzle experience.
Relaxing and Rewarding: Each move you make helps train your brain, improve concentration, and keep your mind sharp. 
Easy to Play, Hard to Master: The blocks can't be rotated, so you'll need to carefully plan your moves to fit the pieces perfectly on the board. Simple to pick up, but challenging to master!
How to Play:
Drag and Drop Blocks: Place wooden blocks onto the grid.
Clear Rows and Columns: Match full rows or columns to remove blocks from the board.
Think Ahead: Plan your moves wisely! The blocks can't be rotated, and if you run out of space on the grid, it's game over.
Score Points: Every row and column cleared will earn you points. Keep pushing yourself to beat your high score!
Challenge Yourself in Different Modes: Switch between Classic, Time, Bomb, and Advance modes to test different puzzle-solving skills.
Ready for a Puzzle Challenge?
Whether you're looking to relax or engage your mind, Wood Match - Wood Block Puzzle is the perfect game to enjoy in your downtime. Sharpen your skills, strategize your moves, and become the ultimate wood block master.
Download Wood Match - Wood Block today and embark on a journey full of satisfying puzzles and endless fun!

Show off your excellent kickoff skills in this live soccer game, and get the title of soccer
bluejetty:00140138:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate soccer action! Master your kicking skills, dominate the field, and become the real champion in exciting football matches!
Show off your excellent kickoff skills in this live soccer game, and get the title of soccer hero. Soccer star game will madden you and take you to the heights of a winning streak. Get ready to hustle and win all the league matches. Aim, and start kicking. Your dream to become the best soccer manager starts now.
Build your dream team based on skills that will help you defeat the opponents. Invent new kick styles that will help you become a world star at soccer cup games. Challenge yourselves at being a PRO futsal player. Compare your score & goal to know who is a real kick master at a street soccer game. Celebrate your victory with a team player and be a futsal star.
Strengthen your soccer superstar skills and play against the national teams of your choice. Head with your team players to the stadium and guide them how to kick fast. Play this live football sports game, and hit the goal and kick to get points. Pass the ball to friendly players doing the match and set your score match straight by taking an excellent strike with these master league matches. Become a pro player through real world soccer that will provide you with realistic gameplay.
Football game has three different playing modes, select a model you like and enter the world of an excellent world soccer game. This 1v1 game will not disappoint you, get your team united and build the strongest national team by scoring a goal.
- Soccer Cup Career Mode:
Set your sports career straight with this kick star game. Cross hurdles and reach the goal. Do not come in line with the hurdles or you will lose!
- Friendly Team Match:
Play against the popular national teams and take a strike to win and score a goal. Victory is just a flick & kick away. This kicking mode has a victory shot replay, so celebrate it and let the crowd cheer for you. A realistic crowd will keep you motivated to win. Build your dream team to strengthen yourself.
- Penalty Shots kickoff:
Take penalty shots to score match points and win. Get a closer view of the realistic stadium and cover up your goals through the penalty kicks. These shots will help you set the scores right missed in the top soccer match.
Customize your player according to your liking. Unlock new jerseys, clothes, and players through coins. Complete levels to earn more coins. Spinning wheels will add up to your coins so that you can change your player or their kits. Play with national teams and lead your country to victory. This 1v1 soccer strike will not let you get bored with its excellent graphics and realistic environment.
Get an on-screen score display during 1v1 matches and try to beat your opponents to make it to the global leaderboard. Bring out your inner sports dream champion and start playing! Stand out from the other players and take control of your soccer career. Your new life starts now. The unique gameplay will help you improve your kick strategy during the match.
Soccer Games 26: Real Champion Game Features:
-Realistic gameplay with awesome stadium shots to keep you interested.
-Player customization available to have a more personalized experience.
-Goal celebration and the realistic crowd cheering to show you what real victory feels.
-Awesome background music with smooth gameplay, to make the game easy to play.
-Realistic 3D environment and easy to use UI controls.
-Three different playing modes available, pick the one you like and start playing.
-On-screen score display and free spins to get rewards and unlock players.

bluejetty:00033860:android.name: Valefor: Roguelike Tactics
bluejetty:00033860:android.summary:
Assemble your team of heroes, unlock synergy buffs, and craft rare artifacts. Choose powerful combat perks to enhance your builds, then challenge other players and conquer new lands!
TEAM BUILDING
In Valefor, you fight with a team equippe
bluejetty:00033860:android.description:
Assemble your team of heroes, unlock synergy buffs, and craft rare artifacts. Choose powerful combat perks to enhance your builds, then challenge other players and conquer new lands!
TEAM BUILDING
In Valefor, you fight with a team equipped with powerful items. The heroes you choose matter, as each has unique abilities and belongs to a specific class and race. The smarter you equip and position your heroes, the better your chances of victory.
SUMMON AND CRAFT
Collect fragments from loot or buy them in the shop, and use them to summon units and craft equipment. Combine them to create even stronger heroes and artifacts.
RANKED PVP
Fight against real party builds, made by real players, in our PVP Arena. Ascend the ranks in true roguelike fashion, with a new team built from scratch every run. Analyze the strategy used by your opponents, press advantages and try to counter them. Take your time experimenting with the vast array of heroes, perks and items at your disposal because - with Asynchronous PVP - there is no turn timer.
SOLO CAMPAIGN
Valefor is a Roguelite Strategy Auto-Battle RPG that is lightweight enough for portable play, and deep enough for tactical gameplay. Step into a rich dark fantasy world and follow the fragmented story in a single player campaign building your Kingdom along the way.
EXPAND YOUR KINGDOM
Every class and faction in the game has its own unique Building that can be constructed and upgraded to unlock powerful synergy buffs, give heroes class specific starting equipment and can even increase max party sizes. Defeat the dungeons that have taken hold of the land to unlock more space to grow your Kingdom.
EPIC SOUNDTRACK AND LORE
On top of Valefor’s sleek visuals- we’ve also included a soundtrack and story to match. Whether it’s an epic score, a mournful ambience, or an action-packed battle scene- our music and lore seek to immerse you in our world and enhance your gaming experience.
ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT
Here at Valefor, we are constantly working to make this game the best we can- and we can’t do that without you. Have ideas, critiques, bug reports or just want to chat? Check out our Discord - we are incredibly active there. You can also visit our site, join our newsletter for development updates- or check out our many social accounts. We appreciate your support!

bluejetty:00029482:ios.description:
Know your family made it — to school, to work, back home — without a single "where are you?" text.
Family Nest shows the people you choose on a private, real-time map. Trusted by thousands of families with a 4.7-star rating. (Formerly Family360 — same app, new name, and Circles are now called Nests.)
FREE FOR EVERYONE
• Create private Nests and chat with the people who matter most
• See your family on the live map — always with their consent
• Share your live location on trips and commutes so loved ones know you're safe
• Place alerts for Home, School, and Work — know the moment someone arrives or leaves
• Overspeed alerts to help guide safer driving habits
• Phone locator — find your own lost or misplaced phone
PREMIUM — FOR MORE CONTROL
• Real-time tracking with ETA — accurate updates with routes and arrival times
• 365 days of location history — look back at daily routes and movements
• Statistics view — understand travel patterns and activity trends
• Unlimited places with entry/exit alerts
• Priority customer support
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE FAMILY NEST
Your location is shared only with people you trust, inside your Nest. We don't sell your data — Premium subscriptions are our only revenue. Ever.
MADE FOR REAL LIFE
Parents & kids: know they reached school or practice safely. New drivers: overspeed alerts encourage better habits. Couples: share the drive home. Elderly care: gentle arrival and departure alerts. Travel groups: stay together in new places. And when your own phone goes missing — find it instantly.
PRIVACY FIRST
Family Nest is not a spying tool. Location sharing always requires consent and can be paused anytime. Our mission is keeping families connected without compromising trust.
Try it free, or unlock Premium for the full experience.
Terms of Service: https://www.familynestapp.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.familynestapp.com/privacy-policy

Stay on top of your money with customisable tools that help you keep track of your day-to-day spending and stay ahead of your bills.
 EASY AND SIMPLE ACCESS
• Use your face or fingerprint to log in faster and more securely.
• Just open the app and explore your spaces to get quick access to everything you need, from balances and savings to pensions and investments.
CONTROL FOR YOUR CARDS
• Whether your card is lost, stolen, or simply misplaced, relax knowing you can freeze it, order a new one or look up your card details.
BE IN THE KNOW
• Stay ahead of your bills - your upcoming payments summary lets you know what’s being paid and when.
• Spending insights helps you understand where your money goes every month.
• Check your credit score and get personalised hints and tips to help you stay in control of your money and move closer to your big dreams, like getting a new home.
• Never miss important updates again: personalise your notifications to stay on top of everything.
IN FOR A PENNY
• Make every penny count with Save the Change. It rounds up what you spend on your debit card to the nearest pound and moves the change into a savings account.
• Get cashback from your favourite retailers with Everyday Offers.
HOW WE’LL CONTACT YOU
Using our app won’t affect how we contact you. Our emails will address you by your title and surname and include the last four digits of your account number, or the last three digits of your postcode. Any text messages we send you will come from BANKOFSCOT. Be aware of any message that differs from this – it could be a scam.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
We don't charge you to use our services, but your mobile operator might charge for some things, such as downloading or using the app, so please check with them. Services may be affected by phone signal and functionality.
When you use this app, we collect anonymous location data to help combat fraud, fix bugs and improve future services.
The app is available to customers with a UK personal account and valid registered phone number. IOS14 or above required. Device registration required. Terms and conditions apply.

bluejetty:00123159:ios.description:
Sheetlet has all you need for a Spreadsheet. Its data capturing and calculation technology saves you a lot of time and difficulties.
It has the ease of touch with no setup time for data scanning, calculation, visualizing data in charts, and exporting reports into different formats.
On an iPhone, you can scan data, text and numbers, and perform calculations directly on the data. There is no need to type symbols and formulas into small cells. You can simply drag and drop what is needed to calculate values.
USERS USE SHEETLET TO:
• Scan receipts to spreadsheets
• Convert images to texts
• Scan numbers to calculate
• Make budgets
• Track expenses
• Add charts for data
• Make analytical reports incl. sales analysis, scientific modelling 
• Make weekly to-do lists
• Make work calendars 
• Add memos and notes
• Perform math calculation
• Do almost everything
UNIQUE FEATURES:
• Scan all kind of data to the spreadsheet
• Easy drag and drop features for calculations, charts and text
• Interactive Visual Analyses through many graph types
• Intuitive & smooth User Interface
• Fast recalculations
• Duplicate tables 
• Undo/Redo
• Exports to Excel
• Exports to PDF
• Exports to JPG
• Share on social media
• No registration is required!
WHY SHOULD YOU USE SHEETLET?
Sheetlet is easy to use. There is no need to write formulas and to select tiny cells on the mobile device anymore. Your workflow, no matter it is sales, logic, memos, products, supplies, BI, or anything else that you want to work on an iPhone can never be so efficient.
In Sheetlet you can make budgets, split costs, manage your travel expenses, do "what if" scenarios by simple drag and drop. It has never been more easy and secure to enter data into a spreadsheet app and more easy to make calculations. It is your perfect expense tracker & calculator.
Sheetlet is a feature-rich app specially designed for iPhone and iPad users.
By downloading this app, you agree to the Apple Standard End User License Agreement (EULA), available here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Check out the film-inspired frames and effects available in the app and control watermark size and placement with just a tap. 
Edit your videos with one tap using Filmm’s Looks! With 100+ filters and effects, there’s sure to be a combination that captures your aesthetic. Mix, match and stack all the filters and effects to find the look you want. 
Add captions or text overlays with over 30 fonts and text animations to choose from. Filmm has tons of royalty free music options for you to mix and match, letting you create the perfect soundtrack to back your Day in the Life or Get Ready With Me videos. Add audio effects and clips with the tap of a button, all from Filmm’s library. 
Start editing like a pro today with Filmm! Download and subscribe today!
MULTIPLE EFFECTS AVAILABLE
• One-tap full featured Looks let you edit your videos quickly and easily
• Filmm packs over 100 filters and effects for presets you’ll love
• Realistic film-inspired frames and complete control over watermarks
• 30+ modern font and text animations let you customize captions
• Crop detection, pre-ready for social media dimensions
PROFESSIONAL EDITING FEATURES
• Multi-clip editing with professional transitions let you make videos like the pros
• Advanced adjustment tools including curves give you complete control over tone and color
• Choose from tons of audio and music options, including custom royalty-free music
• Story splitting save options let you save Instagram and Snapchat stories in timed increments
• Clip trim, cut, reverse and duplicate your frames, clips or videos to fit perfectly
Unlock all Filmm packs, frames, transitions, text, music, watermark control and all upcoming features with Filmm+!

bluejetty:00086687:ios.description:
Generate and export custom PDF reports of photos with textual and graphical annotations all on your phone
 1. Add your own logo, company name, email, phone and contact name
 2. Capture photos with your camera or insert them from your gallery
 3. Add textual descriptions to photos, like measurements
 4. Draw arrow and circle annotations on photos using simple gestures
 5. Organise photos by group and location -- so that you can generate sub-reports
 6. Customise the reports: landscape or portrait, number of rows and columns etc...
 7. Generate the PDF report on your phone and email it on-site
 8. Export single images
 9. Share editable reports with co-workers
Our goal with this release is to offer a complete, polished, user-friendly mobile image reporting tool. Initially, this tool was designed for a construction manager to generate and send professional photographic reports from the field. But, it can be used to generate photographic reports for any line of work.
This is our initial no-cost and ad-free offering. However, we will be taking reporting to the next level with our future releases. Report and Run is aimed at real estate, construction, insurance, logistics, inspections and education to name a few.

bluejetty:00087281:ios.summary:
Private cloud storage for your photos, videos, files and folders.
Back up your important data, free up space on your devices, and keep your files under your control. Built for privacy and data sovereignty.
Private & encrypted
Your files
bluejetty:00087281:ios.description:
Private cloud storage for your photos, videos, files and folders.
Back up your important data, free up space on your devices, and keep your files under your control. Built for privacy and data sovereignty.
Private & encrypted
Your files are encrypted on your device before they leave it and can only be decrypted with your private key.
Your private key stays under your control. Neither DeNet nor Datakeepers can access or decrypt your files.
Decentralized
Your encrypted files are split into multiple parts and distributed across a decentralized network of independent storage providers called Datakeepers.
No single Datakeeper stores your complete file, creating a storage system without a single point of failure.
Automatic backup
Automatically back up photos, videos, files and folders from your devices.
Keep important data protected and free up space without deleting the files you want to keep.
One account across your devices
Use the same private key across mobile, Windows, macOS and Linux.
Access and synchronize your files across devices with one account.
Flexible storage, not a fixed subscription
You pay for the storage you actually use — not for a fixed subscription period.
Your storage balance is consumed based on the amount of data you store. If you don't store data, your balance isn't consumed.
Store more, and your balance is used faster. Store less, and it lasts longer.
Free to install. No ads.
DeNet is free to install and contains no third-party advertising.
Explore the DeNet ecosystem
The DeNet app gives you access to more than storage. You can also run a Watcher Node directly from the same app and participate in the ecosystem built on the DeNet Storage Protocol.

TaleGenie – Your AI Story Generator & Creative Writing Companion
Bring your imagination to life with TaleGenie, an intuitive AI Story Generator that helps you write captivating stories, build unique characters, and create effortlessly — whether you're a beginner or a seasoned storyteller.
TaleGenie removes creative friction and replaces it with inspiration, structure, and speed.
Key Features:
Explore Ready-Made AI Stories
Browse a rich collection of pre-generated AI stories across genres like Mystery, Sci-Fi, Romance, and more. Instantly dive into creative inspiration — even before you start writing your own.
AI-Powered Story Generation
Generate personalized stories based on your chosen genre, cover style, character, audience, and preferred ending.
Fully Customizable Story Builder
Choose your own settings — from story length and tone to language and theme. Control every element to match your vision.
Edit, Manage & Revisit Stories
Rename stories, change fonts, or make edits. All your created stories are saved and easily accessible in the “My Stories” section.
Clean Library & History Management
Access your previously generated stories or explore new ones — everything is neatly organized for a smooth experience.
Themes & Personalization
Switch between Light, Dark, or System theme for a personalized reading and writing environment.
Multiple AI Models
Select from GPT-4o, GPT-4, or GPT-3.5 depending on your writing speed and quality preferences.
Stay Updated & Inspired
Enable notifications to get writing prompts, feature updates, and reminders to keep your creativity flowing.
Upgrade to Premium
Unlock access to powerful models, unlimited story generation, and more customization options with TaleGenie Premium.
Whether you want to overcome writer’s block or just explore creative storytelling, TaleGenie is the perfect AI Story Generator to turn your thoughts into compelling stories.
Download TaleGenie now and start writing your next masterpiece in minutes.
You can get unlimited access to all the advanced functionality by subscribing to a weekly or a yearly plan inside the app. There's also a free 3-day trial period to get a taste of what TaleGenie Premium has to offer. Once expired, the trial period automatically changes to a paid weekly subscription.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00044935:ios.name: Caddy - Business Phone App
bluejetty:00044935:ios.summary: Every missed call is a job your competitor wins. Caddy is a business line with an AI receptionist that answers when you can't, finds out what the caller needs, and books them onto your calendar while you keep working. Finish the job you're
bluejetty:00044935:ios.description:
Every missed call is a job your competitor wins. Caddy is a business line with an AI receptionist that answers when you can't, finds out what the caller needs, and books them onto your calendar while you keep working. Finish the job you're on, check the app, and the next one is already scheduled. 
CATCH AND BOOK THE JOBS YOU'D MISS 
When you can't pick up, Caddy answers, greets the caller, collects their info, what they need, and when they're available, then books them into an open slot on your calendar. You get a summary of every call, full transcript, and recording so you know what's coming without stopping work. 
- Works with Google Calendar, Outlook, and Calendly
- Books the appointment during the call, so nobody waits for a callback 
- Choose the details your AI receptionist collects before it confirms 
- Checks your real availability and follows your booking rules 
- Available only on Unlimited + AI 
A REAL BUSINESS LINE IN MINUTES
Pick a local area code and your business number is live on the phone already in your pocket. Calls and texts come into Caddy, so clients reach your business line and never your personal cell.
- No second phone, no hardware 
- No separate texting registration fee — competitors charge $19 to $24 
- Block numbers and filter your inbox 
YOUR AI LEARNS YOUR BUSINESS 
Give Caddy your website or Google Business profile and it learns your services, hours, location, and FAQs. There's no script to write and it re-checks your website, so if you make changes, Caddy updates details for you to review and approve. It can answer in your own voice, and you decide who it answers: everyone, unsaved numbers, or contacts only. 
PRICED FOR A BUSINESS OF ONE 
A flat monthly price. No seats, no contracts, no minute caps on the AI. 
Unlimited + AI Receptionist — $19.99/month or $199.99/year 
Everything in Unlimited, plus: 
- An AI receptionist that answers, captures details, and books 
- Appointment booking to your calendar 
- A knowledge base built from your website or Google profile 
- Voice cloning 
- Call summaries, full transcripts, and recordings 
- Custom ring count before the AI picks up 
- Answer rules per number
Unlimited — $9.99/month or $99.99/year 
- Unlimited inbound and outbound calling 
- Unlimited SMS and MMS 
- Voicemail with transcription 
- Calls, texts, and voicemail in one inbox 
- Add more numbers as you need them 
One booked job covers the cost of Caddy for a year. Every plan includes a 7-day free trial. No contracts. Cancel anytime through the App Store. 
WHO CADDY IS FOR 
- Home services and trades — plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, roofers, painters, landscapers, inspectors 
- Auto services — independent mechanics, detailers, body shops 
- Real estate agents and property managers 
- Health, wellness, and beauty — trainers, stylists, massage therapists, estheticians 
- Freelancers and creatives — designers, photographers, videographers, writers 
WHILE YOU WERE UNDER THE SINK, YOUR NEXT JOB CALLED SOMEONE ELSE 
Most callers don't leave a voicemail. By the time you hear it, they've already hired someone else. Caddy answers that call, finds out what they want, and puts them on your calendar before they move on to the next listing. 
Questions? Reach us at support@caddy.com 
By using Caddy, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. 
- https://caddy.com/privacy 
- https://caddy.com/terms 
* Real phone number required for sign-up 
*** Messaging within Caddy adheres to all Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and 10DLC requirements.

• Use Touch ID or Face ID to log in on supported devices
• Enroll in Enhanced Login for an extra layer of security

bluejetty:00168234:ios.description:
This is the one you've seen... The ONLY solitaire with a Peek Button :)
Why waste all your time guessing and undo-ing? Make your moves strategic by planning ahead with Peek... It's better brain training!
No more wondering where that one card is hiding! With Peek, you can take a quick look, just like playing at your kitchen table :)
What's more, The Original Solitaire+™ has the most responsive cards in the App Store! You won't feel like you're stuck in the mud like other solitaires!
And you know who else loves quick cards?? Your kids and grandkids! They'll love trying to beat your fastest times :)
After trying the unparalleled features, stunning graphics, and responsive gameplay, any other solitaire game will feel... lacking.
THE PEEK FEATURE: the best innovation in solitaire games in over a decade... and it's patent pending!
Unlike traditional solitaire games that force you to guess between cards of the same rank and color—leading to frustrating trial and error—the Peek Feature lets you plan ahead strategically. No more guessing, no more endless undos! Peek at the face-down cards to make informed decisions and add a layer of strategy to every move. This makes The Original Solitaire not just relaxing, but a true way to train your brain :)
Ever found yourself at the brink of victory, only to be held back by that one elusive card? The Original Solitaire lets you peek at all the cards on the table, reducing unnecessary undos and enhancing your solitaire experience.
It's the kind of innovation that sparks conversations and turns heads, making it the feature everybody's talking about :) Trust us, you'll want to show your friends.
CRAFTED BY THE BEST FOR THE BEST
Behind The Original Solitaire is a team that's been crafting mobile solitaire games since 2003! The Original Solitaire is the culmination of decades of expertise, passion, and player feedback, designed to deliver the ultimate solitaire experience.
What's more, The Original Solitaire runs on the Unity Game Engine, which powers 70% of top games, guaranteeing the highest quality and performance.
UNMATCHED FEATURES THAT STIMULATE THE MIND
• Responsive and Intuitive Controls: Smooth, quick solitaire gameplay that makes others seem sluggish.
• Daily Challenges: New challenges every day to test your skills and earn rewards.
• Crystal Clear Card Fronts: Optimal visibility on iPhones and iPads keeps your focus on the game.
• Eye-Friendly Night Mode: Play comfortably at any hour with exclusive dark cards and backgrounds.
• Unlimited Undos and Hints: Play with confidence knowing you can always take a step back or get a nudge without triggering ads!
• Customization: A vast selection of cards, cardbacks, and backgrounds to personalize your solitaire game.
• Visually Stunning: Serene backgrounds inspired by our National Parks and detailed card designs make every aspect a treat.
• Stats and Daily Tips: Track your progress with detailed statistics. Enjoy daily tips, winning streaks, and win percentages.
• No In-App Purchases: Dive into the full solitaire experience without extra costs.
• No Pressure: Play with no timer for a stress-free solitaire day :)
• Classic Solitaire Gameplay: Play Klondike Solitaire, the game you know and love, but with added features to make it the best!
• Peek into Your Future Moves: Use the Peek button to plan your moves instead of relying on guesswork. Make confident decisions without endless undoing—it's the ultimate brain exercise for true card game lovers.
• Microsoft Solitaire Nostalgia: Reminiscent of classic Microsoft Solitaire, The Original Solitaire brings timeless gameplay with modern twists.
The Original Solitaire goes beyond traditional solitaire, offering an experience that's both familiar and thrillingly new.
Rediscover your love for solitaire! Peek into the future of mobile card games with The Original Solitaire™. Download now from the Apple App Store and elevate your solitaire experience.

To provide a more consistent experience, Bé Yêu has been updated with a new brand identity.

SUPPORTIVE PARENTING COMMUNITY
- Ask your concerns about pregnancy & baby care, breastfeeding, ovulation, baby’s feeding schedule and more. Get the answers from other experienced parents within minutes!
- Share your parenting journey to the community. Guide and help a fellow parent based on your own experiences.
TRACKING PREGNANCY & BABY DEVELOPMENT
- Pregnancy tracker to ensure a healthy, happy pregnancy.
- Pregnancy calendar so you’ll know what to expect day by day until the due date - the aches and pains as well as the joys like experiencing a baby’s first kick!
- Baby tracker to track his/her growth and milestones day-by-day until age 7.

- Find out delicious recipes that are suitable for pregnancy, postpartum, and breastfeeding. You start weaning your baby? We have many weaning food recipes ready for you!

- Keep a track of your baby’s movements and record it with our new baby kick counter.
- Having 3 sessions of kick counting a day is advised to know your baby’s activeness & health.
- Had a miscarriage or stillbirth? We got your back, Mothers, supporting you with our healing mode.
FAMILY & PARENTING ARTICLES
- Parenting articles full of useful tips, based on the most advanced parenting research, to make life easier.
- Nutrition guides, expertly crafted scientific parenting advice and what’s happening around you - we cover it all.
- All motherhood needs in the most amazing feed of articles that will keep you engaged for hours.
- Baby guides and articles for each month of your baby’s development, so you can stay informed about milestones, diet, activities, vaccinations, as well as red flags.

- Share photos in a parent network, away from the nagging eyes of your frenemies!
- Add stickers & frames to your photos and share to your loved ones!
- Enjoy informative videos and popular songs that you can play in the background with your little one!
- More kid-safe videos here help parents avoid the danger of other video streaming services.
JOIN CONTESTS & WIN GREAT PRIZES!
- Parenting should be rewarding, that’s why you can win really cool gifts on our app.
- Contests and giveaways with practical and awesome gifts like strollers, staycations, and much more!
- Join many exciting games held within the community. Grab the prizes & enjoy your parenting journey in a more fun way.
Download Webtretho: Mẹ và Bé app today and be a part of the largest parenting community of Asian Parents in the world.

bluejetty:00064057:ios.description:
No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions. Uncover cards by moving them between 10 cascading stacks and 4 free cells so they fly up and complete the suit stacks. A standard deck is dealt in 10 cascading stacks. You can move the top card of a cascading stack to either an empty free cell or to the top of another cascading stack with top card same suit and one higher value. For example, 3 of clubs can be moved to a stack with top card 4 of clubs. Any value card can be moved to an empty free cell. Only Kings can be moved to an empty cascading stack. 
NOTES: Not all games are winnable. You can reject a newly-dealt hand that looks unwinnable by clicking New Game again. If you click New Game before moving any cards, the game is not counted as a loss. Click Undo to undo one move at a time, or Start Over to undo all moves in the current game.

bluejetty:00179686:ios.description:
Imaging Edge Mobile allows images/videos to be transferred to a smartphone/tablet, enables remote shooting, and provides location information to images captured by a camera.
■ Transfer images from a camera to a smartphone
- You can transfer images/videos. 
- The selection and transfer of images after shooting are no longer needed as the automatic background transfer function allows images to be transferred to a smartphone as they are captured. *1
- High bit rate video files including 4K can be transferred. *2
- You can view and transfer images in your camera from your smartphone even when the camera is turned off. *2
- After transferring, you can immediately share your high quality images on social networks or through email. 
*1 See here for supported cameras. Files are imported in 2MP size when using this function. 
https://www.sony.net/dics/iem12/
*2 See here for supported cameras. Availability of video transfer and playback varies depending on smartphone in use. 
https://www.sony.net/dics/iem12/
■ Remote shooting of a camera using a smartphone
- You can capture photos/videos remotely while checking the live view of a camera on a smartphone. *3
This is convenient for capturing night views or water flowing scenes which need long-exposure, or macro shooting in which you need to avoid to directly touch the camera.
*3 Models that support PlayMemories Camera Apps can use this feature by installing "Smart Remote Control" (in-camera app) on your camera in advance. 
http://www.sony.net/pmca/
■ Record location information
- With cameras that have a location information linkage function, the location information acquired by the smartphone can be added to the captured image in your camera. 
For supported models and detailed operation methods, see the support page below. 
https://www.sony.net/dics/iem12/
- Even with cameras that do not have a location information linkage function, it is possible to add location information acquired by your smartphone to the photos saved on your smartphone during remote shooting.
■Save and Apply Settings
- You can save up to 20 camera settings in Imaging Edge Mobile.
You can also apply a saved setting to a camera. *4
*4 See here for supported cameras. Save and Apply Settings are supported only for cameras with the same model name.
https://www.sony.net/dics/iem12/
■ Notes
- Supported operating systems: iOS17.7-26.6
- This app is not guaranteed to work with all smartphones/tablets. 
- Features/Functions available for this app vary depending on the camera you are using. 
- For supported models and information on features/functions, see the support page below. 
https://sony.net/iem/

bluejetty:00130844:ios.description:
Tracing Projector Draw Easy helps you create beautiful drawings using camera-assisted tracing technology. Simply display an image on your screen and trace it onto paper with precision and ease.
Whether you're a beginner learning proportions or an experienced artist refining your technique, this app makes drawing more accessible and enjoyable.
How It Works
Choose from our built-in image library or upload your own high-quality photo
Adjust transparency and contrast to make the image easy to trace
Position your phone on a tripod or stable surface above your paper
Trace the outlines and start creating instantly
 Key Features
• Camera-assisted tracing
• AI Sketch image generation
• Import images from your gallery
• Multiple categories: Anime, Animals, Nature, Food, Portraits, and more
• Record your drawing process
• Save and organize your artwork
Designed for artists of all levels, Tracing Projector Draw Easy provides a simple and effective way to practice sketching, improve accuracy, and explore creativity.
Start tracing and bring your ideas to life today.

bluejetty:00131792:ios.description:
EasyQuit - Stop Smoking App helps you quit your smoking habit for good.
It has a quit smoking slowly mode that works flawlessly, scientific health statistics, money saved by quitting smoking, personal diary, motivational badges and many more features.
---- Motivational Health Section ----
- Countdown timer to watch all aspects of your health improve as a result of your great decision to stop this bad habit of smoking.
---- Stop Smoking Slowly Mode ----
- You cant quit smoking now because the nicotine dependance is too strong? no problem!
Our EasyQuit Stop Smoking app has an entire "Slow Mode" to help you quit the habit of smoking.
Our app will create a customised quitting plan for you that works flawlessly and make you smoke free with no pain or stress.
---- Money Statistics ----
- Watch your pockets grow and see how much money you saved by not smoking any cigarettes.
- Set a nice treat for yourself let the app help you see how long until you reach it. This will motivate you and help you stay smoke free.
---- Cravings & Trigger Statistics ----
- Pie Chart showing you the breakdown of your top triggers to help you eliminate your cravings fasters (Pro Version).
---- Memory Game ----
- Have an urge to smoke a cigarette? Let EasyQuit help you by providing a cool game of Memory with beautiful icons to pass the scientifically proven 3 minute mark & beat your urge to smoke a cigarette.
---- Badges ----
- Earn up to 62 different badges as rewards and use them as a motivational tool. They can also help you stay strong against the nicotine addiction if you share your progress with your friends through the screenshot option provided by EasyQuit.
---- Themes ----
- Personalize EasyQuit by choosing any of the 28 beautiful themes provided.
---- Amazing Widgets ----
- Our quit smoking app offers you two widgets full of statistic, showing your current progress of quitting smoking.
The widgets show the time you have been smoke free, the money you saved by quitting, total progress of the scientific health statistics, the personal treat progress and the cigarettes passed since you quit smoking (pro version).
---- High Level of Privacy ----
- No log in, no collection or selling of your sensitive data like email, password or contacts. Your data is saved locally on your phone.
---- Relapse Assistant ----
- Let the app help you decide your next step after a relapse by recommending a certain action based on your previous quitting data (Pro Version).
--- Diary ---
- Add your thoughts and moods daily to keep a clear head and remain strong during this journey (Pro Version).
---- Modern Design ----
- Modern & original design consistent with the modern design guidelines.
I hope my quit smoking app helps you become a non smoker forever and free you of this bad habit. So don't wait, quit now or use stop smoking slowly mode and let EasyQuit help you become a healthier and happier person :)

BROW
bluejetty:00200065:ios.description:
Plezy is a modern client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, built for high-quality playback, effortless discovery, and offline access. Connect multiple servers at once and enjoy your media in one clean, native app—no subscription required.
BROWSE & DISCOVER
- Browse libraries, collections, playlists, folders, extras, and personalized recommendations
- Search across every connected Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby server
- Explore trending, popular, watchlist, and recommendation rows from Plex Discover, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Simkl, and Seerr
- Match catalog titles back to your own libraries and request movies or shows through Seerr
- See resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision, and audio-format badges at a glance
PLAYBACK
- Wide codec support including HEVC, AV1, VP9, and more
- HDR playback, direct play, and configurable transcode quality
- Switch between media versions with detailed file and stream information
- Full ASS/SSA subtitles with styling controls and online subtitle search
- Auto-play the next episode with skip intro and skip credits
- Chapter navigation, thumbnail scrubbing, playback speed, audio sync, sleep timer, and video zoom
- Picture-in-Picture, loudness normalization, and stereo downmix with center-channel boost
- Resume progress and remembered audio/subtitle choices
MUSIC
- Browse artists, albums, and tracks with rich artwork
- Gapless playback with a reorderable queue, Play Next, and Add to Queue
- Synced lyrics, a persistent mini-player, and sleep timer
- Background playback with lock-screen and media controls
- Offline albums and tracks, plus selectable streaming quality
LIVE TV & DVR
- Browse and tune live channels with favorites and a full program guide
- See what's on, browse show schedules, and manage DVR recording rules
- Use Live TV across multiple supported servers
DOWNLOADS & OFFLINE
- Download movies, shows, albums, and tracks
- Pause or resume the background queue
- Create automatic download rules, including optional show specials
- Browse offline and sync watch state when you reconnect
PROFILES & INTEGRATIONS
- Use multiple profiles with per-profile settings, downloads, and watch state
- Switch Plex Home users with optional PIN protection
- Discover Jellyfin and Emby servers locally and use Quick Connect
- Sync watchlists, ratings, watched state, and scrobbles with connected services
- Watch together with synchronized play, pause, and seeking
- Control desktop and TV devices with Plezy Remote
- Available in English plus 21 translations
Some features require a supported server, media format, or connected service.

bluejetty:00135737:ios.summary: Learn jewelry making step by step and create your own handmade necklaces, bracelets, rings, and earrings from home. This app teaches real techniques through hundreds of video tutorials, so you can go from your first simple piece to designs
bluejetty:00135737:ios.description:
Learn jewelry making step by step and create your own handmade necklaces, bracelets, rings, and earrings from home. This app teaches real techniques through hundreds of video tutorials, so you can go from your first simple piece to designs you are proud to wear or give away.
JEWELRY MAKING TUTORIALS
Watch step-by-step video tutorials that cover the core techniques of handmade jewelry: wire wrapping, bead stringing, metal stamping, resin casting, and gemstone setting. Each tutorial breaks a technique into clear steps with close-up demonstrations from working jewelry designers, so you can follow along and pause whenever you need to.
Browse designs by style -- bohemian, minimalist, vintage, modern, statement, and everyday -- and filter tutorials by skill level. Every tutorial lists the materials and tools you need and an estimated time, so you know what to gather before you start.
LEARN PROFESSIONAL TECHNIQUES
Build proper skills as you go: tool handling, accurate measurements, secure clasps, knot tying, clean finishing, and quality checks on every piece. Alongside the hands-on technique, the lessons cover jewelry terminology, metal types, and gemstone grading, so the words a jeweler uses start to make sense and you can pick the right materials for what you want to make.
Tutorials are grouped by what you want to make -- earrings, statement necklaces, stackable rings, charm bracelets, pendants, brooches, and anklets -- with beginner, intermediate, and advanced versions of each so you can keep advancing.
JEWELRY YOU CAN GIFT
Handmade jewelry makes a personal gift for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, and other milestones. Learn how to add birthstones, simple engraving, and custom charms to give a piece extra meaning, and find project ideas organized by occasion when you want inspiration.
Start with one simple piece today and learn jewelry making at your own pace.

Privacy Policy - https://thecookbk.com/privacy.php?appname=jewellery.maker.making.tutorial

bluejetty:00073637:ios.name: JusTalk - Video Chat & Calls
bluejetty:00073637:ios.summary: JusTalk is a powerful app for voice and video calls and instant messaging. It aims to provide users with a high-quality, secure, and convenient experience for communication through voice and video calls and messaging. JusTalk offers rich fe
bluejetty:00073637:ios.description:
JusTalk is a powerful app for voice and video calls and instant messaging. It aims to provide users with a high-quality, secure, and convenient experience for communication through voice and video calls and messaging. JusTalk offers rich features for individuals, families, and professionals to meet their needs. Users can connect with family, friends, and colleagues worldwide, breaking the limits of distance.
• High-Quality Voice and Video Calls
JusTalk supports ultra-high-definition voice and video calls with low-latency communication channels. This ensures clear communication with family and friends. Center Stage keeps users naturally centered during video calls, making family chats and group calls feel more focused.
• Dual Capture Video Calls
Share every moment with Dual Capture. Show yourself and the world around you at the same time to share activities, explore new places, celebrate special occasions, and create unforgettable memories together, without missing a thing.
• Video Call Effects
Make every video call more fun and expressive with creative backgrounds, stylish filters, and playful appearance effects. Blur or transform your surroundings, add a signature visual style, or bring out your personality with face effects such as glasses, hats, animal ears, and more. Save your preferred effect for future video calls.
• High-Quality voice and Video Call Recording
During real-time ultra-high-definition voice and video calls, users can easily record essential moments with a single tap. Whether capturing precious family moments or critical business decisions, all recorded files maintain lossless voice and video quality, preserving memorable moments for users to revisit.
• Group Polls
When group members need to choose a time, make a plan, or decide together, polls help collect everyone’s opinions quickly and keep group conversations organized.
• Sticker Store & Custom Stickers
Discover fun sticker packs in the Sticker Store and add custom stickers to make family chats more personal, playful, and expressive.
• Walkie Talkie (Push-to-Talk)
JusTalk supports instant voice messaging through a simple push-to-talk Walkie Talkie feature. Users can send real-time voice messages by just pressing and holding—no need to start a call. It’s perfect for quick updates in both one-on-one and group chats.
• Real-Time Interactive Games
While engaged in voice and video calls, users can play built-in interactive games in real time. Whether in one-on-one or group calls, this feature enhances bonding and adds fun to the communication experience.
• Fun Doodling
Users can engage in real-time collaborative doodling on the screen during voice and video calls. Each stroke is synchronized in real time on both screens.
• Feature-Rich IM Chat
In addition to voice and video calls, JusTalk supports instant messaging (IM) chat with various features such as text, images, videos, voice messages, emojis, stickers, GIFs, doodles, and file sharing.
• Quick Message Replies and Reactions
Users can use the "Reply" feature to respond conveniently to messages from family, friends, or group members in one-on-one or group chats.
• Sharing Life Moments
By posting "Moments," users can share unforgettable moments of their lives with friends and family on JusTalk. Moments support text, images, videos, and more.
• Family-Centric Features
Together with JusTalk Kids, JusTalk provides a safe and convenient communication platform for children, parents, and family members. It enables family members to communicate anytime, anywhere, making sharing messages, photos, videos, or discussing family matters more convenient.
• Real-Time Location
Real-time location sharing allows close friends to know each other's whereabouts at any time, enhancing a sense of security. It enables friends to create closer friendships.
Customer Service: support@justalk.com
Terms: https://justalk.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00100595:ios.description:
Caresweep Cleaner:phone clean
Caresweep Cleaner is a calm and lightweight app designed to help you bring order to both your mind and your digital space.
By reducing noise and simplifying everyday actions, Caresweep Cleaner makes your phone feel lighter and your days more intentional.
Mind
The Mind section focuses on mental clarity and daily rhythm.
It offers simple tools that support focus, reflection, and balance without overwhelming you.
• Focus timers help you stay present and work with a clear sense of time.
• Lightweight to-do lists keep tasks organized in a clean, distraction-free way.
• Mini meditation moments invite you to pause, breathe, and regain calm in just a few minutes.
Everything in Mind is designed to be quick to use, gentle, and easy to return to throughout the day.
Space
The Space section helps you maintain a lighter digital environment.
Instead of complex tools or technical details, Caresweep Cleaner focuses on simple actions that reduce digital noise and keep your phone feeling organized and easy to navigate.
It’s not about constant cleaning, but about making space for what matters.
Easy Mode
Caresweep Cleaner includes an Easy Mode with larger text and fewer steps.
This mode is designed for comfort, clarity, and accessibility, making the app easier to use for seniors and anyone who prefers a simpler interface.
Designed for calm
Caresweep Cleaner avoids unnecessary complexity.
There are no loud visuals, no pressure to optimize, and no complicated settings.
Just a thoughtful balance between mental order and digital space.
Whether you’re organizing your thoughts, focusing on a task, or keeping your phone easy to use,
Caresweep Cleaner helps you slow down, feel clearer, and make space — inside and out.
Subscription & Terms
Access all features through one of the following plans:
• Weekly subscription
• Yearly subscription
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Any unused trial period will be forfeited when a subscription begins.
Privacy Policy

User Agreement

bluejetty:00175602:ios.description:
Solitaire 3D Fish is a BRAND-NEW & CREATIVE solitaire card game with UNIQUE 3D graphics and interfaces. It provides you the MOST vivid and lively 3D effects on the scenes and fish when you play this classic solitaire game (also known as Patience or Klondike game). 
You can collect dozens of different ocean fish (Clownfish, Blue Tang, Guinean Angelfish, Bannerfish, Powder Blue Tang, Azure Damselfish, Anglerfish) by the "Gashapon Machine" in the game. More fishes are coming in the next updates. 
HIGHLIGHTS
- CREATIVE SOLITAIRE GAME
Based on the classic solitaire (also known as Patience or Klondike), we've added a CREATIVE aquarium world with the unique "Star Chest" feature.
- BEAUTIFUL UNDERSEA THEMES

Together with Daily Challenges, there are over tens of thousands of classic solitaire challenges for you to play anytime and anywhere!
- SURPRISING BOOSTERS & ANIMATIONS
If you get stuck, you can use the "Magic Wand" for help to continue the game. And there are different kinds of animations when you win certain deals.
HOW TO PLAY
- Up to 10 top records
- Klondike Solitaire Draw 1 card or 3 cards
- Standard or Vegas Casino scoring
- Single tap or drag&drop to move cards
- Daily challenges with different levels
- Auto-collect cards on completion
- Feature to Undo moves
- Feature to use Hints
- Timer mode available
- Left-handed mode available
- Offline game! No wifi required
Like playing Patience or Klondike solitaire games? It must be the BEST classic solitaire game with CREATIVE 3D fish themes for you! Download and enjoy it NOW!

bluejetty:00043927:ios.name: Wheel Size
bluejetty:00043927:ios.summary:
This handy app allows you to look up the correct wheel fitment data for your vehicle using the world’s largest wheel fitment database at Wheel-Size.com.
You can retrieve information about wheel sizes for rims and tires, including OE and af
bluejetty:00043927:ios.description:
This handy app allows you to look up the correct wheel fitment data for your vehicle using the world’s largest wheel fitment database at Wheel-Size.com.
You can retrieve information about wheel sizes for rims and tires, including OE and aftermarket replacement options, as well as plus-minus sizing fitment information.
The information about fitment data is updated on a daily basis. Wheel-Size.com provides frequently maintained data with over 110 car makes including 3800+ models for 12 global markets. The coverage of wheel size data for vehicles manufactured since 2000 is nearly 100%.
App features:
• Regularly updated with new vehicles in real-time
• Your recent searches and favorites are fully available offline
• Articles, top tire lists, and rankings from tiresvote.com
• Easily share your search results
• Imperial (US) and metric systems are supported
Start by entering the make, year, model, and trim of your vehicle to provide a complete listing of wheel fitment info for your vehicle.
Data that are presented in the application:
- Tire Size (tire/tire width, aspect ratio, rim diameter)
- Load Index
- Speed Rating
- Rim Size (rim width and rim diameter)
- Offset
- Bolt Pattern, Pitch Circle Diameter (PCD)
- Generation
- Market
- Power
- Trim
- Engine type, fuel type, engine code
- Trim Options
- Center Bore
- Wheel Fasteners (lock type: lug nuts/bolts)
- Torque
- Thread Size
- Production Years
- Tire Pressure
- Photo of the vehicle
List of markets* we are covering:
- US domestic market (USDM) - the key market
- European domestic market (EUDM) - the key market
- Japanese domestic market (JDM)
- Southeast Asian Market (SAM)
- Australian Domestic Market (AUDM)
- Latin American domestic market (LADM)
- Middle East Domestic Market (MEDM)
- Mexican domestic market (MXNDM)
- South Korean Domestic Market (SKDM)
- Canadian domestic market (CDM)
- South African Domestic Market (SADM)
- Chinese Domestic Market (CHDM)
* Market is the region where the car was sold or is still being sold.
If you have been unable to find the information on the requested market, try using the car’s details taken from the key markets.
------------- 
If you have any doubts, problems, or suggestions concerning our app, please email us at info@wheel-size.com, and we will do our best to fix whatever you think could be improved. 
If you enjoy Wheel Size, please leave a review on App Store!

bluejetty:00084751:ios.summary:
Care Health – Customer App is your one-stop digital platform to manage all your health insurance needs seamlessly. Whether it’s accessing your policy, locating a network hospital or filing a claim – everything is now just a tap away.
Key F
bluejetty:00084751:ios.description:
Care Health – Customer App is your one-stop digital platform to manage all your health insurance needs seamlessly. Whether it’s accessing your policy, locating a network hospital or filing a claim – everything is now just a tap away.
Key Features:
· Instant Policy Access
View and download your health insurance policy documents anytime.
· Cashless Hospital Locator
Search and locate from over 21000 healthcare providers offering cashless treatment.
· Easy Claim Intimation & Tracking
Intimate a claim, upload required documents and track your claim status in real time.
· Health & Wellness Services
Book online doctor consultations, schedule health check-ups and access curated wellness tips. Explore a wide range of wellness tools and services, including:
- Health Risk Assessment (HRA)
- Quizzes and expert-written blogs
- Kiddo Vaccination Tracker
- Electronic Health Records (EHR)
- Step Tracking and BMI calculator
- Face Scan for Health Insights
- Cashless OPD and E-Pharmacy Access
- Discount Connect for wellness offers
- Ambulance Services
· Policy Services
Download your policy certificate and 80-D certificate, request changes in policy details and track request status.
· Policy Renewal
View and download your renewal notice, renew your policy instantly and make secure online premium payments.
· e-Health Card Access
Download and use your e-health card for cashless treatment in empanelled hospitals.
About Care Health Insurance
Care Health Insurance is a specialized health insurer offering products in the retail segment for Health Insurance, Top-up Coverage, Personal Accident, Maternity, International Travel Insurance and Critical Illness along with Group Health Insurance and Group Personal Accident Insurance for Corporates, Micro Insurance Products for the Rural Market and a Comprehensive Set of Wellness Services. With its operating philosophy being based on the principal tenet of ‘consumer-centricity’, the company has consistently invested in the effective application of technology to deliver excellence in customer servicing, product innovation and value-for-money services.
Apart from numerous awards since inception, in March 2025, Care Health Insurance (CHI) was awarded ‘Best Claim Settlement Company of the Year’ at the 9th Annual India Insurance Summit & Awards 2025; in December 2024 CHI was conferred the ‘Overall Achievement Award’ (SAHI category) at the ASSOCHAM 16th Global Insurance Summit & Awards, and ‘Smart Insurer’ and ‘Sales Champion’ awards in Health Insurance category at the 11th ET Now Insurance Summit & Awards 2024. The company was also awarded ‘Best Health Insurance Plan – Care Plus' at the Global Financial Planner’s Summit 2024 held in October’24.
Download the Care Health – Customer App today!

bluejetty:00063301:ios.description:
Enter a mesmerising trance of co-dependence in Duet. The rules are simple: control two vessels in sync, survive against all odds and keep calm.
Best, Most Elegant iPhone Games of the Year 2013 - The New Yorker
Grand Prize Winner, Best Action, Best Audio - Intel Level Up
Best Design, Best Audio - Australian Game Developer Awards
Best Design - IGF China
PAX 10 & PAX East Indie Showcase Selection
Mobile Game of the Year 2013 - Kotaku
4.5/5 - Touch Arcade
4.5/5 - 148 Apps
4.5/5 - App Smile
"...few other games are as fun when you succeed." -- The New Yorker
"It feels as designed as a raindrop, and just as perfect." -- Ben Kuchera, Polygon
"Duet does what the best video games do." -- Kotaku
"Highly Recommended." -- Penny Arcade Report
"Duet looks hard as nails. And I love it." -- Touch Arcade
"Duet is a must-have." -- 148 Apps
"Shiel's soundtrack ... is as innovative as the game it scores." -- Jake Cleland, The Vine
"Your eyes, ears, and thumbs were built to perform this Duet together." -- Indie Games
"...Duet's plaintive and melancholic aesthetic imbues it with a sense of the profound." -- CVG
"But while the aesthetic of Duet is familiar, the gameplay is all new." -- Pocket Gamer
"It is fantastic." -- Tim Rogers
"Duet on iOS. Instant love. Instant." -- Mark Serrels
Your survival is dependent on protecting two vessels - they are devices in sync, a dance and song between two entities tethered together in symbiosis. Feel edge of your seat terror where the world around you becomes quiet and numb as all that matters is the game living between your palms -- that is Duet.
% NINE CHAPTERS
Experience nine chapters of deceptive narrative and nerve-twisting gameplay. Unlock the bonus Survival chapter for endless score chasing delight. Replay any stage to perfect your movements and unlock over 25 Game Center achievements. This is a game that will test you.
% EIGHT NEW EPILOGUE CHAPTERS
Explore a whole new narrative with all-new game mechanics in our new “epilogue” to Duet. Including over 40 new stages, new narrative and new remix tracks. You will need a new state of mind to complete this experience.
% PERFECT GAMEPLAY
With air tight controls and gameplay that’s tuned to perfection Duet provides the perfect balance between challenge and pure gaming satisfaction. Touch either side of the screen to twist your vessels and avoid everything in your path. Remember: even that which begins simple can end complex.
% HYPNOTIC AUDIO
An outstanding handcrafted soundtrack by Melbourne composer and Gotye multi-instrumentalist Tim Shiel. Nine unique and mesmerizingly beautiful compositions ensure an immersive experience for you at every step of your journey, complemented by full in-game vocal narration by Jojo Petrina.
% FULLY FEATURED
- Full iCloud support - sync your progress across all your devices.
- Universal App - play on your new iPhone, iPod touch, iPad and iPad mini.
- Compete with Game Center on the leaderboards.
% ABOUT KUMOBIUS
Selected for the Indie Showcase at PAX Aus and a finalist in both Game Design and Audio for the Freeplay Festival. This is another award-winning title from the team behind Time Surfer & Bean’s Quest. We call Duet a “Hex-like” in honour of Terry Cavanagh’s contribution to the medium of games and exploration of genres.
% ABOUT TIM SHIEL
Tim Shiel is a composer/producer based in Melbourne. Tim is known to some as Faux Pas, the moniker under which he released a steady stream of constantly shifting electronic music for many years. He is also known for his work as a broadcaster at Melbourne independent radio station 3RRR FM, and for his recent role as multi-instrumentalist in Gotye's live band. 
% SUPPORT 
Say hello@kumobius.com we’d love to hear from you! And follow us on Twitter: @kumobius

bluejetty:00022872:ios.description:
Unleash the Power of Vintage Synths with Synth Pro
Dive into the world of rich, analog sounds with Synth Pro, the ultimate synthesizer app designed for musicians, producers, and sound designers. Whether you're looking to recreate vintage classics or craft new, unique sounds, Synth Pro delivers an expansive library of iconic analog synths, powerful editing tools, and studio-quality effects—right from your iOS device.
From the deep, warm tones of analog oscillators to the versatility of modern sound design, Synth Pro is perfect for both beginners and pros alike.
Key Features:
• Explore Authentic Analog & Vintage Synth Sounds:
Experience the authentic warmth and depth of analog synthesis. Synth Pro features a curated library of classic synth sounds inspired by legendary hardware—Moog, Juno, Prophet, and more. Perfect for recreating retro vibes or exploring new sonic landscapes.
• Full Synthesizer Editing Section:
Take complete control of your sound with our powerful built-in synthesizer editor. Adjust oscillators, filters, LFOs, envelopes, and modulation for precise sound shaping. Whether you’re tweaking existing presets or designing from scratch, Synth Pro gives you the creative freedom to craft your ideal sound.
• Professional-Grade Effects:
Enhance your sounds with studio-quality effects like reverb, delay, chorus, phaser, distortion, and more. Add depth, texture, and polish to your music with ease. Perfect for live performances or studio sessions.
• Layer & Split Sounds:
Combine multiple synths or split them across the keyboard for complex, layered compositions. Ideal for live performances or creating rich, multi-textured tracks in the studio.
• MIDI & AUv3 Support:
Connect your MIDI keyboard or controller for full hands-on control over your sounds. Use Synth Pro as a powerful plugin in your favorite AUv3-compatible DAWs for seamless integration into your production workflow.
• Vintage Meets Modern:
Synth Pro blends the timeless beauty of analog with the flexibility of digital. Enjoy the best of both worlds with a modern interface designed for intuitive sound creation, whether you're after retro nostalgia or cutting-edge new sounds.
• Save, Share, & Record:
Save your favorite custom sounds and presets for future projects. Record your live performances or studio sessions with ease, and share your creations with the world or back them up to the cloud.
Go Premium:
Upgrade to unlock the full potential of Synth Pro. Get access to an expanded library of exclusive synths, more advanced editing tools, and additional effects. Perfect for pro-level musicians and sound designers who want unlimited creative possibilities.
Subscription Plans:
• 1 Month: $5.99
• 1 Year: $29.99
Prices may vary based on region.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage subscriptions and auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
Why Synth Pro?
Whether you’re performing live, producing in the studio, or exploring new creative ideas, Synth Pro delivers the rich analog sound and flexibility you need. From vintage recreations to modern experimental sounds, Synth Pro is your all-in-one synthesizer solution.
Download Synth Pro today and start creating with the best analog and vintage synth sounds on iOS!

bluejetty:00120383:ios.name: My Town : Bakery
bluejetty:00120383:ios.summary: There is a tasty new addition in My Town and it’s time to put your favorite characters to work! In this game, you will get to open your very own My Town : Bakery! There will be customers coming in, so you’d better get baking! Perhaps there
bluejetty:00120383:ios.description:
There is a tasty new addition in My Town and it’s time to put your favorite characters to work! In this game, you will get to open your very own My Town : Bakery! There will be customers coming in, so you’d better get baking! Perhaps there is a birthday party coming up and you will need to bake an extra special cake for someone. Maybe someone would like to have a pizza party – grab your delivery driver and make sure it gets there on time!
My Town : Bakery has SEVEN new locations to explore! There is the bakery, a pizza shop, a park to hold birthday parties in and even an apartment! No matter where you choose to start your adventure, there are HOURS of fun ahead!
FEATURES
* New Characters – If you have any of the My Town dollhouse games, you can bring your characters from those games over to My Town : Bakery to join the fun! 
* If you are just starting out with My Town, no worries! You can create your own characters inside My Town : Bakery
* We update our older games every month, so please wait for the updates to connect these games to My Town : Bakery
* The ability to save your progress and pick up where you left off next time you open the app
* Multi-touch Feature: Play with your friends and family on the same device!
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Town : Bakery!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. Younger kids will enjoy playing together with there parents while the older kids can play alone or with a friend using our new multitouch feature!
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com or visit us on the MY TOWN Facebook page and twitter!

bluejetty:00187157:ios.summary:
Tangem - Non-Custodial Crypto Wallet & Hardware Wallet
Tangem is a self-custody, non-custodial crypto wallet that combines a hardware wallet with a mobile crypto wallet app. Designed for secure cold storage, Tangem keeps your private keys o
bluejetty:00187157:ios.description:
Tangem - Non-Custodial Crypto Wallet & Hardware Wallet
Tangem is a self-custody, non-custodial crypto wallet that combines a hardware wallet with a mobile crypto wallet app. Designed for secure cold storage, Tangem keeps your private keys on dedicated hardware — not on company servers.
Private keys are generated and stored on your Tangem Card or Tangem Ring. Tangem does not store, access, or control your funds or private keys. You approve every transaction using your NFC-enabled smartphone.
Hardware Cold Wallet with Secure Chip
Tangem functions as a hardware wallet and cold wallet, isolating private keys on a secure element chip certified to Common Criteria EAL6+.
Security features include:
Secure element chip (EAL6+)
Private keys generated and stored on the card
NFC-based secure communication
No server-side custody
Users can connect up to three Tangem cards to one wallet setup for backup and recovery.
Bitcoin Wallet, Ethereum Wallet & Multi-Chain Crypto Wallet
Tangem supports multiple blockchain networks and thousands of digital assets.
Use Tangem as a:
Bitcoin wallet (BTC wallet)
Ethereum wallet (ETH wallet)
Multi-chain crypto wallet
Web3 wallet for decentralized applications
Send and receive cryptocurrencies, view balances and transaction history, and manage supported assets in one crypto wallet app.
Web3 Wallet & dApp Access
Tangem acts as a Web3 wallet, allowing connections to decentralized applications (dApps) via secure wallet connectivity standards.
You can:
Connect to decentralized exchanges
Access token swaps
Interact with NFT platforms
Use blockchain-based services
All blockchain transactions are initiated and approved by the user.
Some features connect to independent third-party providers. Tangem provides the wallet interface only and does not offer exchange, brokerage, investment, custody, or payment services. Availability of third-party services depends on provider terms and user location.
Important
Tangem is a non-custodial crypto wallet provider. Tangem does not hold user funds or private keys. Users are responsible for managing access to their hardware wallet devices.
Learn more at [tangem.com](http://tangem.com/).

bluejetty:00153166:ios.description:
uBO Lite (uBOL) is a reliable and efficient content blocker.
The default ruleset corresponds to uBlock Origin's default filterset:
- uBlock Origin's built-in filter lists
- EasyList
- EasyPrivacy
- Peter Lowe’s Ad and tracking server list
You can enable more rulesets by visiting the options page -- click the _Cogs_ icon in the popup panel.
uBOL is entirely declarative, meaning there is no need for a permanent uBOL process for the filtering to occur, and CSS/JS injection-based content filtering is performed reliably by the browser itself rather than by the extension. This means that uBOL itself does not consume CPU/memory resources while content blocking is ongoing -- uBOL's service worker process is required _only_ when you interact with the popup panel or the option pages.
