bluejetty:00154136:ios.name: Sushi Land: ASMR
bluejetty:00154136:ios.summary: Step into the cozy, mouthwatering world of Sushi Land, where satisfying sounds and endless sushi creations come together for the ultimate foodie experience! Roll up your sleeves (and your sushi) as you become a master chef serving up delect
bluejetty:00154136:ios.description:
Step into the cozy, mouthwatering world of Sushi Land, where satisfying sounds and endless sushi creations come together for the ultimate foodie experience! Roll up your sleeves (and your sushi) as you become a master chef serving up delectable bites to a crowd of adorable, always-hungry fans. Roll, slice, and serve sushi while livestreaming your creations to a growing fanbase of adorable mukbang viewers! Watch the chat explode with hearts, comments, and funny reactions as you serve up the perfect sushi rolls. 
Go viral by crafting creative sushi combos, completing fun challenges, and interacting with your audience in real-time. The better your sushi, the more likes, followers, and virtual gifts you’ll earn! Use your earnings to upgrade your kitchen, unlock quirky ingredients, and decorate your stream setup.
HOW TO PLAY:
Select Your Ingredients: Start by choosing fresh ingredients—sticky rice, seaweed, fish, veggies, and fun toppings! Drag and drop them onto the sushi mat.
Roll & Slice: Swipe, tap, and hold to roll the sushi perfectly. Use precise slicing motions to cut your rolls into bite-sized pieces. Listen to the satisfying slice and crunch sounds!
Serve to Fans: Feed your adorable mukbang viewers and watch their happy reactions. The better your sushi, the more likes, comments, and views you’ll earn!
Upgrade & Unlock: Use your earnings to unlock new ingredients, fun kitchen gadgets, and stylish outfits. Level up to become the ultimate Sushi Master!
Complete Challenges: Take on exciting mini-games and challenges to earn extra rewards. Can you roll sushi against the clock or match ingredients in tricky combos?
Why you will love Sushi Land?
Create & Customize: Craft everything from traditional nigiri and sushi rolls to wild, over-the-top creations! Mix fresh ingredients, slice fish with precision, and experiment with quirky toppings to keep your mukbang audience drooling.
Satisfying ASMR Sounds: Feel the squish of sticky rice, the crisp snap of seaweed, and the soft chop of sashimi—all with immersive ASMR sounds designed to melt your stress away. Every slice, roll, and bite is pure audio bliss!
Grow Your Mukbang Channel: Start small and grow into a sushi superstar! Unlock fun tools, unique ingredients, and cute kitchen upgrades as your fanbase grows. The more creative (and delicious) your sushi, the more views and likes you’ll rack up!
Dress Up & Decorate: Customize your sushi chef with adorable outfits and personalize your cozy sushi bar. From minimalist zen to colorful kawaii vibes, make your space as delightful as your dishes!
Fun Challenges & Mini-Games: Compete in sushi speed challenges, ingredient-matching puzzles, and special mukbang events. Can you handle the pressure of a viral sushi trend?
Whether you're here for the satisfying sounds, the endless creativity, or just to chill and roll some sushi, Sushi Land is your perfect escape. So grab your chopsticks and let’s make some magic—one delicious bite at a time! Can you become the next mukbang superstar? Start streaming, roll with style, and let the sushi show begin!

bluejetty:00023794:ios.name: Code Scan - QR Barcode Scanner
bluejetty:00023794:ios.developer: KURZ Digital Solutions GmbH & Co. KG
bluejetty:00023794:ios.summary: Scan and create every common 1D and 2D barcode - one at a time or continuously in Batch Scan. Export your history as CSV or automatically send scans to your own server. Unlike an ordinary scanner, Code Scan also verifies the cryptographic s
bluejetty:00023794:ios.description:
Scan and create every common 1D and 2D barcode - one at a time or continuously in Batch Scan. Export your history as CSV or automatically send scans to your own server. Unlike an ordinary scanner, Code Scan also verifies the cryptographic seals on official documents.
WHAT IT READS
• QR, MicroQR and rMQR (rectangular MicroQR)
• DataMatrix, including DMRE
• Aztec, PDF417, MaxiCode
• EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E
• Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, Codabar, ITF / ITF-14
• GS1 DataBar and DataBar Expanded
• VDS, VDS-NC and IDB document seals
Codes are decoded on your device: from the live camera, from a photo in your library, or from an image you share into the app from somewhere else.
DIGITAL SEALS ON OFFICIAL DOCUMENTS
This is what sets Code Scan apart: it does not just read the seal, it checks the cryptographic signature.
• VDS (Visible Digital Seal, BSI TR-03137) in DataMatrix
• VDS-NC (ICAO) and IDB (ICAO Datastructure for Barcode) in QR codes
• Signatures verified against X.509 certificates, kept up to date automatically
• Import your own X.509 certificates for closed ecosystems
• MRZ data contained in a seal is parsed and shown in readable form
This app supports reading and verification of (among others) VDS Profiles:
- Social Insurance Card
- Residence Permit Document
- ICAO Visa Document
- ICAO Emergency Travel Document
- German Arrival Attestation Document
- Address Sticker for German Identity Card
- Place of Residence Sticker for German Passports
VDS-NC Profiles:
- ICAO PoT and PoV (ISO/IEC JTC1 SC17 WG3/TF5)
CREATE YOUR OWN CODES
• QR, DataMatrix, Aztec, PDF417 and Code 128
• Live preview while you type
• Choose the QR error correction level (L / M / Q / H) or the PDF417 level (0-8)
• Keep your codes in a library, mark favorites, share any of them as an image
FASTER IN EVERYDAY USE
• Camera light in four brightness steps and 1x / 2x / 4x zoom - for tiny print, dark rooms and laminated documents
• Share a screenshot from any app to read the code inside it, or share a link to turn it into a code
• Batch Scan: capture multiple codes without a result screen and save them straight to your history
• Siri and Shortcuts: create a code or open the scanner by voice, or build both actions into your own shortcuts
• Recreate a scanned code in a single tap, with the content already filled in
A HISTORY THAT STAYS ORGANIZED
• Grouped into Starred, Today, This Week and Before
• Scanning a code again updates the existing entry instead of piling up duplicates
• Export and share your scan history as a CSV file
• Stored seals are re-verified in the background against the current certificates, so an expired signature stops showing as valid
FOR PROFESSIONAL USE
• GS1 application identifiers parsed and labelled
• Open recognized links immediately, skipping the result screen
• Copy and share the raw code data instead of the interpreted content
• Optionally send scans automatically to your own HTTPS endpoint (off by default)
• Play a confirmation sound after successful transfers
• Native iPad layouts
PRIVACY
Decoding happens entirely on your device, and your history stays there. There is no account and no tracking. To verify seals, the app downloads the public signer certificates from our certificate service. The optional face comparison against a document portrait is the one feature that sends an image to a KURZ Digital service, and only when you start it yourself.
For wishes and suggestions just contact us at info@kurzdigital.com

• Camera light in four brightness steps and 1x / 2x / 4x zoom - for tiny print, dark rooms and laminated documents
• Share a screenshot from any app to read the code inside it, or share a link to turn it into a code
• Batch Scan: capture multiple codes without a result screen and save them straight to your history
• Siri and Shortcuts: create a code or open the scanner by voice, or build both actions into your own shortcuts
• Recreate a scanned code in a single tap, with the content already filled in

A HISTORY THAT STAYS ORGANIZED
• Grouped into Starred, Today, This Week and Before
• Scanning a code again updates the existing entry instead of piling up duplicates
• Export and share your scan history as a CSV file
• Stored seals are re-verified in the background against the current certificates, so an expired signature stops showing as valid

FOR PROFESSIONAL USE
• GS1 application identifiers parsed and labelled
• Open recognized links immediately, skipping the result screen
• Copy and share the raw code data instead of the interpreted content
• Optionally send scans automatically to your own HTTPS endpoint (off by default)
• Play a confirmation sound after successful transfers
• Native iPad layouts

PRIVACY
Decoding happens entirely on your device, and your history stays there. There is no account and no tracking. To verify seals, the app downloads the public signer certificates from our certificate service. The optional face comparison against a document portrait is the one feature that sends an image to a KURZ Digital service, and only when you start it yourself.

For wishes and suggestions just contact us at info@kurzdigital.com

- Discover workout buddies who share your fitness passions.

- Find companionship in fitness, from yoga partners to running mates.

bluejetty:00140772:ios.summary:
This is a life-simulation game lovingly created by the BUD team. Whether you enjoy decorating, dressing up, or simply relaxing, you can freely build your ideal lifestyle here. Join the town now and experience the beauty of everyday life!
【
bluejetty:00140772:ios.description:
This is a life-simulation game lovingly created by the BUD team. Whether you enjoy decorating, dressing up, or simply relaxing, you can freely build your ideal lifestyle here. Join the town now and experience the beauty of everyday life!
【New Version】
The Wawadoll collab is live! The Wawadoll Naptime Room scene bundle is now available, along with the Wawadoll Style Pack NPC bundle (Xiaowei, Yunyun, Wanwan, Bunny, Doudou Bear). Merge gameplay is now open—merge to earn Sweetheart Coins and unlock more scenes, with an improved beginner guide to help you get started. The Pass and Monthly Energy Card are also live (includes a limited bonus “BaoBao Cutie”—buy now and get it instantly, once missed it’s gone). New ad features have been added (watch ads to get Energy, or pop Resource Balloons for extra rewards). Plus, the new scene “Jirai-kei DIY House” is here, along with four free NPCs.
We’ve also improved the login screen and town layout presentation, refined parts of the UI and interactions, fixed known issues, and boosted overall stability and performance.
【Game Features】
Design every corner freely — DIY your dream home!
From wallpaper to flooring, from furniture to ornaments, hundreds of decorative items let you create a cozy space that’s truly your own.
Express every style — Endless dress-up fun!
Enjoy a highly customizable face and outfit system with thousands of looks and styles—sweet, trendy, vintage, or magical—become the brightest presence in town every day.
Immerse in every moment of comfort — Adorable art style!
Soft colors and chibi characters create a relaxing, storybook world—from sunrise streets to the evening café, every scene feels warm and healing.
Discover every surprise — Rich town stories!
Beyond decorating and dressing up, you’ll meet mysterious visitors, hidden surprises, and fun side stories waiting to be uncovered.
Experience every place — Diverse themed buildings!
Elegant courtyards, fan-themed houses, cozy milk-tea shops, dye studios, and more—explore, decorate, and encounter delightful moments across BUD Town!
Support
If you encounter any issues in the game, feel free to contact us at:
support@budcreate.xyz
We’d love to hear your feedback and help you out!

bluejetty:00152473:ios.description:
ATI TEAS PassFast Pro by Solvely 2026 — Built to Pass, Faster
Get ready for your nursing school entrance exam (ATI TEAS 7 / TEAS V7) with exam‑aligned practice questions, a realistic exam simulator, and a Study Plan that adapts to your test date and weak spots. Start today for free.
► Why Students Choose PassFast
1. Skip the long study guides → short, targeted TEAS practice that sticks.
2. TEAS 7–aligned coverage → Reading, Math, Science, and English & Language Usage.
3. Know when you’re ready → a clear Readiness Score shows your pass probability so you can book with confidence.
► Power Features (built for future nurses)
1. Study Plan: daily plan that adapts to your weak areas & schedule.
2. Smart Explanations (Rationales): plain‑English step‑by‑steps for every question.
3. Missed Questions: drills only what you got wrong.
4. Exam Simulator & Mock Exams: timed, pressure‑matched practice like the real ATI TEAS exam.
5. Readiness & Progress Analytics: watch your pass probability climb by topic.
6. All in One App: TEAS practice test, question bank (Qbank), study guide, TEAS review, Question of the Day, reminders, streaks, build‑your‑own quiz, timed & untimed modes, formula & grammar cheat sheets.
► Built for Passing
Our questions follow the official TEAS 7th edition style, our simulator matches real pacing, and your Readiness Score makes timing clear. We can’t guarantee results—but we give you everything to walk in confident on test day.
► TEAS V7 Subjects & Topics
1. Reading: Key Ideas & Details; Craft & Structure; Integration of Knowledge & Ideas.
2. Math: Number & Algebra; Measurement & Data (ratios, proportions, percentages, equations, graphs, conversions).
3. Science: Human Anatomy & Physiology; Biology; Chemistry; Scientific Reasoning.
4. English & Language Usage: Grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, spelling, vocabulary in context.
► Programs & Pathways
For pre‑nursing students aiming at RN, LPN/LVN, ADN, BSN, ABSN and allied‑health programs (dental hygiene, radiography, sonography, respiratory therapy, medical assisting). Works for schools that require the Test of Essential Academic Skills (ATI TEAS).
► Compatibility & Coverage (new 2026 update)
Designed to complement popular TEAS prep books, courses, and question banks, this app includes realistic, exam-style TEAS questions, free sample tests, and pre-test drills that mirror both the ATI TEAS 7 and TEAS 6 formats.
Updated for the latest TEAS 7 blueprint but still effective for TEAS 6 learners, it’s designed for nursing exam preparation and nursing program entrance exams—ideal for RN, LPN, ADN, and BSN candidates aiming to pass the TEAS with confidence.

► Download now—get your Readiness Score and start your fast path to a TEAS pass.

Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of 3D matching like never before! Blitz Busters is a brand new match 3D game with stunning objects and incredibly fun gameplay that will keep you hooked for hours.
Have absolute fun with diverse, charming, and varied combinations of objects!
Challenge your cognitive skills by finding and matching 3D items in complex boards, all within a limited time period. Blitz Busters is not just a game, it’s a workout for your brain.
As you progress through the game’s amazing and original levels, you’ll have the chance to build and complete beautiful cities worldwide.
► Match 3D Objects - Challenge yourself and train your brain with exciting levels that will test your matching competence
► Compete Against Time – With limited time introduced for every level, improve your find & match skills while racing against the clock
► Sharpen your Mind – Find the objectives and clear the board in a complex environment filled with surprises and challenges
► Relax – Enjoy your spare time by indulging in some stress-relieving gameplay. Clear the board to solve puzzles and unwind
►Discover– Explore towns all around the world as you progress through levels, immersing yourself in their unique charm
►No need for WiFi - Play Blitz Busters anytime anywhere! No internet connection is required.
Blitz Busters brings joy to fans of 3D puzzles and match-3 games and those who love mahjong, delivering endless excitement and fun. Start your Blitz Busters journey today!

Find information using images instead of text:

Search any product name and instantly compare prices across major marketplaces. See which store offers the best deal, check product availability, and save more money with a single tap.
- Detailed, Easy-to-Read Results:
DeepSearch AI displays information in a clean, structured format. View links, photos, articles, product details, and more—presented neatly for quick understanding.

 Smart, multi-engine search results with broader coverage and higher accuracy.

 See combined results from top search engines in a single view.

 Identify objects, verify image sources, find products, explore similar visuals, and more.

 Structured, multi-type search results—images, articles, products, websites, news, and more.

bluejetty:00066402:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00066402:ios.description:
Zwift: Indoor cycling made fun
Join millions of people on the app that makes indoor cycling fun for everyone. Whether you’re a seasoned athlete or just starting, jump into virtual bike rides in immersive 3D worlds, challenge yourself on epic climbs, and explore endless roads. With racing, group rides, cycling workouts, and structured training plans, Zwift can deliver serious fitness results.
Connect Your Bike
Seamlessly connect your smart bike, like Zwift Ride, or your bike and smart trainer – including ones from Zwift, Wahoo, Garmin, and more – to your smartphone, tablet, or AppleTV, and start chasing your fitness goals from the comfort of your home.
Immersive Virtual Worlds
Explore over a hundred routes in 12 immersive, virtual worlds. Whether it's the epic climbs in Watopia or the serene beauty of the Scottish highlands, every ride is a new chance to explore.
Join a Global Community
Join a global community pulsing with energy and enthusiasm. Connect with friends, make new ones, and immerse yourself in group rides, races, and events. Track your stats and stay connected with friends, clubs, and the community—on and off the bike— with the Zwift Companion app. Zwift even connects to Strava, ensuring a seamless fitness tracking experience. 
Indoor Training Plans, Tailored to You
Our world-class coaches and champion cyclists have crafted plans and workouts for every level. Whether you’re starting out or stepping it up, find your perfect plan. With flexible options, from quick 30-minute burns to long endurance rides, Zwift also has 1000s of on-demand workouts that fit your schedule and goals.
Race Any Time Of Day
Racing riders from around the world is one of the most effective ways to get fit. But don’t be intimidated! Zwift is home to the world’s largest community of competitors—from first-time racers to elite athletes—guaranteeing there’s a friendly challenge for everyone.
Ride and Run!
Not just for cyclists, Zwift welcomes runners too. Sync your smart treadmill or footpod device — you can get our RunPod directly from Zwift—and step into the worlds of Zwift, where every walk or run gets you one step closer to your goals.
Join Zwift Today
There’s never been a better time to combine fun with real results. Download Zwift now and start from wherever you are with a free trial for first-time users.
Download today
Please see the Terms of Use at zwift.com/terms, and EULA at support.zwift.com/en_us/end-user-license-agreement-rymuiTZr

bluejetty:00081650:ios.name: Purrrr-Feed&Rescue Stray Cats
bluejetty:00081650:ios.summary: The idea behind Purrrr! originated from a story of feeding stray cats in a Chinese community. Inspired by a group of young animal lovers, we decided to use internet technology to involve more people in caring for stray animals, promoting ha
bluejetty:00081650:ios.description:
The idea behind Purrrr! originated from a story of feeding stray cats in a Chinese community. Inspired by a group of young animal lovers, we decided to use internet technology to involve more people in caring for stray animals, promoting harmonious coexistence between humans and animals.
【Harmonious Interaction between Humans and Animals】
In the Cat House livestream, you can remotely feed stray cats, dogs, hedgehogs, squirrels, and other small animals. Those lovely createures and a group of compassionate volunteers will be expressing gratitude to every angelic feeder on camera.
【Sharing and Communication among People】
In the livestream, you'll meet many cat lovers with whom you can exchange ideas on feeding, sterilization, rescue, and share experiences. Everyone here contributes to community development, creating captivating cat snapshots, participating in cat rescues, and praising those who love cats. Breaking geographical and background barriers, people connect over topics ranging from TNR to life philosophy, bonded by their shared interest in cats.
【Scientific Philosophy – Advocating Sterilization】
Purrrr! independently developed the Cat House equipment, considering various factors during design. With features like 24-hour monitoring, wide-angle recording, automatic alarm systems, and bowl-empty reminders, the Cat House ensures optimal functioning. Supporting small animal tagging management lays the groundwork for future health monitoring and sterilization management.
"The world is truly beautiful; thanks to the development team for creating the intelligent Cat House."
"Well done! Not only feeding but also promoting sterilization; that's the right path."
"Not only do cats get food, but dogs, hedgehogs, squirrels, and weasels have something to eat too."
...
These are genuine voices from Purrrr! users, providing the Purrrr! team with unparalleled motivation in exploring the path of intelligent management of stray animals.

Chat and play mobile poker with friends. As simple as making a call. 
Challenge players across the globe for great prizes and enjoy the best mobile poker experience. 
SOCIAL POKER
Fancy a game of poker with friends? Look no further. PokerUp is the only poker application that lets you play with you friends from your contacts. Chat before, during and after the game. Share emotions like in real life using our unique instant video feature during the game. 
MOBILE POKER
Designed with attention to detail to give you the best mobile poker experience. Play poker holding your phone in one hand. Gameplay has never been cooler with all the controls in the palm of your hand.
SIMPLE POKER
No complications, variations or other endless settings. Simply a game of holdem poker with highly intuitive user interface and clean design. 
GLOBAL POKER
Challenge players all over the world in PokerUp Duels and win prizes. Unlock more levels to compete for bigger prizes and challenge new players. 
PREMIUM POKER
Enjoy our premium account feature to enhance your poker experience with extras like unique table themes, hand strength meter and gameplay features such as showing off your bluff of chasing the rabbit. 
OTHER FEATURES AND BENEFITS:
- Multiplayer Games: challenge up to 3 players from your contact list
- Messenger: use PokerUp as any other messenger to chat with your friends;
- Leaderboard: challenge your friends and rise up in the friendly leaderboard
- Night Mode: choose our beautiful night theme to enjoy poker at night
- Left-Handed Mode: play with your left hand with the same comfort"
NOTES ON SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS:
Our Premium Account is offered as option with monthly based subscription as per below:
- Subscription is optional with a single monthly price of $0.99 which will be charged in a currency of your Apple ID account.
- The length of subscription is 1 month from the date of purchase. 
- The subscription will upgrade your current account to Premium Account status and give you the following benefits: Extra Game Features, Hand Strength Meter, Unique Table Themes, Access to All Duels and Monthly Bonus of 3,000 upcoins. 
- You will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- You may manage the subscription and may turn it off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00073063:ios.summary:
Introducing the Metal Weight Calculator App: Your Ultimate Tool for Accurate and Efficient Metal Weight Calculations!
Description:
The Metal Weight Calculator App is a cutting-edge and user-friendly mobile application designed to simplify
bluejetty:00073063:ios.description:
Introducing the Metal Weight Calculator App: Your Ultimate Tool for Accurate and Efficient Metal Weight Calculations!
Description:
The Metal Weight Calculator App is a cutting-edge and user-friendly mobile application designed to simplify and streamline the process of calculating the weight of various metal shapes and forms. Whether you are a professional engineer, metalworker, or simply a DIY enthusiast, this app is a must-have in your toolkit.
Designed with engineers, architects, metalworkers, and hobbyists in mind, our app is a powerful and user-friendly tool that takes the hassle out of metal weight calculations. Whether you're working on construction projects, metal fabrication, or just need to know the weight of a specific metal object, this app is the perfect companion to help you get the job done.
Key Features:
1. Versatile Unit Options:
With support for multiple unit options, including centimeters, millimeters, feet, inches, meters, and yards, the Metal Weight Calculator App ensures that users from all around the world can perform measurements in their preferred units effortlessly. Seamlessly switch between units to meet your specific requirements.
2. Wide Range of Metal Densities:
The app boasts an extensive database of densities for various metals, including steel, aluminum, brass, copper, and many more. No matter the type of metal you are working with, the Metal Weight Calculator App has you covered. Choose from a comprehensive list of materials to ensure precise results every time.
3. Comprehensive Metal Shapes Library:
From round tubes and square tubes to rectangle tubes, round bars, square bars, rectangle bars, T-bars, channels, angles, beams, hexagon bars, flat bars, and sheets, the Metal Weight Calculator App caters to all your metal shaping needs. The app's vast library ensures that you can calculate the weight of any metal shape with ease.
4. Intuitive User Interface:
Designed with a clean and intuitive user interface, the Metal Weight Calculator App allows users to effortlessly navigate through various features. The app's user-friendly layout ensures that even those with minimal technical expertise can operate it seamlessly.
5. Precise Calculations:
Accuracy is at the heart of the Metal Weight Calculator App. The app employs advanced algorithms that guarantee precise weight calculations for different metal shapes and forms. No more manual calculations or uncertainties—rely on this app for accurate results every time.
6. Customizable Inputs:
Tailor the inputs to your specific needs. Whether you are calculating the weight of a single metal piece or planning a bulk metal project, the Metal Weight Calculator App can handle it all. Input the dimensions and quantity as per your requirements to get instant and accurate results.
7. Regular Updates: We're committed to providing you with the best experience. Our team continuously updates the app, adding new metal types and shapes, and enhancing its performance based on user feedback.
In conclusion, the Metal Weight Calculator App is a powerful and indispensable tool for professionals and hobbyists alike. Its support for various units, extensive metal density database, and diverse metal shapes library make it the go-to solution for all your metal weight calculation needs. With this app in hand, you can confidently tackle metal projects, estimate material requirements accurately, and optimize your metalworking endeavors. Download the Metal Weight Calculator App today and unlock the potential for enhanced precision and efficiency in your metal-related tasks!

Padre Pio, also known as Saint Pio of Pietrelcina (Italian: Pio da Pietrelcina), (25 May 1887 – 23 September 1968), was an Italian friar, priest, stigmatist and mystic, now venerated as a saint in the Catholic Church. Born Francesco Forgione, he was given the name of Pius (Italian: Pio) when he joined the Order of Friars Minor Capuchin.
Padre Pio became famous for exhibiting stigmata for most of his life, thereby generating much interest. He was both beatified (1999) and canonized (2002) by Pope John Paul II.

Want to know your fortune for 2025 through a 'fortune-telling' reading? How about getting a detailed 30-second diagnosis of what this year has in store for you? Whether you want to reflect on yourself after a break or you find yourself suddenly feeling down on a Sunday night, Palam is the app for you. Simply snap a photo of your palm and get a palm reading and personality analysis!
■ Personality Analysis
Acquired Personality (Dominant Hand):
Analyzes the thought and behavior patterns you have developed through growth and experience.
Innate Personality (Non-Dominant Hand):
Extracts your inherent tendencies and instinctive reactions that shape the foundation of your individuality.
By combining the information from both hands, we create a more multidimensional personality profile where your natural traits and acquired habits intersect.
■ 2025 Fortune Prediction
A thorough analysis of your future in 2025 with an unprecedented, multifaceted approach!
By combining multiple fortune-telling methods that have been praised on TV for their accuracy, we derive your unique fortune from approximately 25,000 pattern combinations, including Nine Star Ki, Animal Fortune-Telling, and Blood Type Analysis.
総合運：2025年の全体的な運気の流れを把握し、幸運期や注意が必要な時期を特定。
恋愛運：新たな出会い、運命の人との接点、恋愛がより充実する可能性を的確に予測。
仕事運：キャリアアップのチャンスや新規プロジェクト発足の好機、転職・起業のタイミングまで詳細に分析。
金運：財運線など手相の結果ともリンクさせ、貯蓄・投資・副業など、金銭面での好機を見極める指針を提供。
From these multi-layered fortune-telling results, we identify the turning points and opportunities that may arise in 2025, as well as the challenges and breakthroughs, guiding you toward a more assured mindset for the year ahead.
◆ About Palam’s Paid Subscription Plan
- The paid plan is a recurring-billing subscription. All payments are processed through your Apple ID.
- Enjoy unlimited access to fortune-telling results free for the first 3 days, then $59.99 per year.
◆ Renewal & Billing
- Premium Membership subscriptions renew automatically.
- Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends, your subscription will renew and you will be charged.
◆ Payment
The subscription fee is charged to your Apple account.
For auto-renewals, the charge is confirmed and billed within 24 hours before the current period ends.

Whether you want to reflect on yourself after a break or you find yourself suddenly feeling down on a Sunday night, Palam is the app for you. Simply snap a photo of your palm and get a palm reading and personality analysis!

■ Personality Analysis
Acquired Personality (Dominant Hand):
Analyzes the thought and behavior patterns you have developed through growth and experience.

Innate Personality (Non-Dominant Hand):
Extracts your inherent tendencies and instinctive reactions that shape the foundation of your individuality.

By combining the information from both hands, we create a more multidimensional personality profile where your natural traits and acquired habits intersect.

■ 2025 Fortune Prediction
A thorough analysis of your future in 2025 with an unprecedented, multifaceted approach!

By combining multiple fortune-telling methods that have been praised on TV for their accuracy, we derive your unique fortune from approximately 25,000 pattern combinations, including Nine Star Ki, Animal Fortune-Telling, and Blood Type Analysis.

総合運：2025年の全体的な運気の流れを把握し、幸運期や注意が必要な時期を特定。
恋愛運：新たな出会い、運命の人との接点、恋愛がより充実する可能性を的確に予測。
仕事運：キャリアアップのチャンスや新規プロジェクト発足の好機、転職・起業のタイミングまで詳細に分析。
金運：財運線など手相の結果ともリンクさせ、貯蓄・投資・副業など、金銭面での好機を見極める指針を提供。

From these multi-layered fortune-telling results, we identify the turning points and opportunities that may arise in 2025, as well as the challenges and breakthroughs, guiding you toward a more assured mindset for the year ahead.

◆ About Palam’s Paid Subscription Plan
- The paid plan is a recurring-billing subscription. All payments are processed through your Apple ID.
- Enjoy unlimited access to fortune-telling results free for the first 3 days, then $59.99 per year.

◆ Renewal & Billing
- Premium Membership subscriptions renew automatically.
- Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends, your subscription will renew and you will be charged.

◆ Payment
The subscription fee is charged to your Apple account.
For auto-renewals, the charge is confirmed and billed within 24 hours before the current period ends.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://palam.framer.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://palam.framer.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00159214:ios.name: QFC
bluejetty:00159214:ios.summary:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The QFC app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download
bluejetty:00159214:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The QFC app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the QFC grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Advantage Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track QFC Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest QFC store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.qfc.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.qfc.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the QFC app, you need a QFC digital account. You can create a digital account and link your QFC Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in QFC's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.qfc.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

bluejetty:00150380:ios.description:
Pay your rent, your way from anywhere with the RentPayment™ mobile app. RentPayment makes it easy to avoid late fees by helping you send payments, schedule reminders, edit autopayments, and view your payment history from any device.*
• Payments: Add payment methods and easily pay your rent and individual itemized fees
• Reminders: Configure a schedule of push notifications and text and email reminders to help you pay on time
• Autopayments & Prepayments: Schedule future payments, edit your autopayment schedule, add new payment methods, and make prepayments
• Payment Confirmation: Know in real-time that your payment was successful
• History: See all your past payments and payment details made using RentPayment
• Manage multiple leases: Switch between multiple leases in one place with a single log-in
*All features subject to property preferences
RentPayment allows you to pay by e-check and supports all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover).
Getting started with the RentPayment mobile app is simple:
• Login or create your account
• Search for your property
• Select or add your payment method
• Make a payment
The RentPayment mobile app is available to residents and tenants at any property that offers RentPayment. If you're not sure whether your property uses RentPayment, please contact your property manager.

Features:

bluejetty:00086342:ios.description:
HouseCurve is a multi-tool for audio systems. Use it for room correction, adjusting equalizers, setting subwoofer phase, choosing crossovers and more.
Features:
* Sine sweep and real time pink noise measurements
* Sweep measurements can be averaged as they are collected
* Alternatively, use real time tool to collect moving mic measurements (MMM)
* Compare measurements to a selected target curve
* Create and edit target curves
* Generate room correction filters (PEQ or FIR)
* Filters compatible with a variety of systems including Roon, Volumio, CamillaDSP, EqualizerAPO, miniDSP and Crestron DM NAX
* Display magnitude, phase and group delay
* Use with built-in or external microphones
* Connect with AirPlay, Bluetooth, headphone jack (analog) or use external stimulus
HouseCurve measures in-room frequency response by listening to your audio system play a sine sweep. Measurements are displayed on top of a target curve, making it easy to see where adjustment is needed. Multiple measurements can be averaged to fully capture how the system sounds in the listening area. With small changes and repeat measurements, you can manually tune your system to the target curve. If your audio system has a parametric equalizer or convolution engine, HouseCurve can automatically generate filter settings to match the target curve.
HouseCurve can help with home and car audio system tuning, from system equalization and room correction to subwoofer time alignment and speaker placement. Visit housecurve.com for more information on how HouseCurve works and how to use it.
HouseCurve will produce acceptable results with the built in iPhone/iPad microphone. Using calibrated external microphones will provide higher accuracy.
The free version of HouseCurve can measure your audio system and display a magnitude plot (aka "frequency response"). Additional features, such as room correction filter generation, advanced measurement tools and target curve editing can be obtained via in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00157600:ios.name: Don't Touch My Phone Alarm
bluejetty:00157600:ios.summary:
Someone reaching for your phone? Not today.
Don't Touch My Phone Alarm turns your iPhone into its own security guard. Arm it with one tap, set your phone down, and if anyone picks it up, moves it or unplugs it, a loud alarm goes off with a
bluejetty:00157600:ios.description:
Someone reaching for your phone? Not today.
Don't Touch My Phone Alarm turns your iPhone into its own security guard. Arm it with one tap, set your phone down, and if anyone picks it up, moves it or unplugs it, a loud alarm goes off with a flashing light until the right PIN is entered.
LOUD ALARM + FLASHING LIGHT
The moment your phone is touched, a loud siren plays and the flashlight blinks. Only your PIN stops it — hands off!
6 SMART ALARM MODES
• Motion alarm – rings when your phone is moved or picked up
• Pocket alarm – rings when someone slips it out of your pocket or bag
• Charger alarm – rings when your phone is unplugged
• Snooper photos – snaps the person who tries to stop the alarm
• Full-charge alert – lets you know when your battery is full
• Headphone alarm – rings when your headphones are pulled out
CATCH THE SNOOPER
Wrong PIN? The front camera takes a photo of whoever tried. Every snooper photo is saved with the date and time, so you know exactly who touched your phone.
CLAP TO FIND YOUR PHONE
Can't see where you left it? Just clap and your phone answers with a sound, so you can find it under a cushion, in a bag or around the house.
LOUD & FUNNY ALARM SOUNDS
Choose a loud siren or go playful with an air horn, hair dryer, hair clipper and more. Perfect for scaring off snoopers or pranking friends.
LEAVE IT ANYWHERE
At the library, in a café, at the gym or on your desk at work, keep the app open, arm it and step away with peace of mind.
PERFECT FOR
• Stopping friends, kids and coworkers from picking up your phone
• Keeping an eye on your phone while it charges in public
• Students, travelers and anyone who shares a space
• Finding a misplaced phone fast
Alarms and the clap finder work while the app is open on your screen.
Premium features are unlocked with a one-time purchase. No subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://minasonani.github.io/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00129112:ios.description:
Speech to text : Voice to text is the powerful, real-time dictation solution. Based on the latest artificial intelligence and using a powerful speech recognition engine, This Dictation app accurately transcribes your speech to text in real time. 
The clean elegant design, along with the non-stop voice recognition and other features means you can relax and focus on your thoughts and content.
Using our app , your words will be magically transcribed into text without your ever needing to touch a keyboard. Now you can use the power of your voice to create your words!
Easily share your text and files later! (Works with Evernote, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, WhatsApp and other iOS supported sharing apps.)
Whether you’re a professional writer, doctor, lawyer, disabled or somehow prevented from traditional typing, Speech to text : Voice to text app will swiftly solve your transcription problems and help you achieve your writing goals today!
This fantastic speech-to-text app will allow you to do more with your iPhone/ iPad :
・Longer Record time:
 -DICTATE CONTINUOUSLY up-to 1 HOUR.
・Unlimited save & edits
・Transcribed text can be edited directly.
・Ideal for both individual and group transcription
・Background support for voice recognition.
・On-device Speech Recognition.
• Voice recognition support for 59 languages and accents.
• Share your text on social networks.
• Copy your text to other apps.
• Send your text as an email or text message.
• Create PDF instantly with single click.
• Convert text your notes, reports, letters into PDF instantly
• Text Analysis using AI.
► Currently Supported Speech Recognition Languages: Arabic, Cantonese, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Shanghainese, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.
Technology:
New iOS 14 Speech framework having state of the art accuracy,
Faster ,Automatically adapts to the user
Super easy: Simply click the microphone and start dictating. No need to login or register
You can add new paragraphs, punctuation marks, smileys and other special characters using simple voice commands.
Who Should Use Speech to Text : Voice to Text ?
1. Reporters: Interviews, conversations and more are easily recorded and transcribed, preserving the original audio.
2. Writers: Novelists, Authors, can all write in their true voice, capturing their moments of inspiration anytime, anywhere.
3. Professionals: Doctors, lawyers, managers, etc. Easily transcribe your daily tasks, notes, conference calls, letters and more! Your voice makes it happen!
4. Elderly or Disabled: Eliminates slow typing, commonly misspelled words or embarrassing composition mistakes. This app makes it convenient and easy to send and share your words with those you love.
5. Language Students: Text analysis using AI , Easily learn and master new words and languages by practicing dictation with speech to text app !

bluejetty:00177979:ios.description:
THE BEST SPEECH COMPANION FOR KIDS
Sago Mini First Words is the most playful way to support your little one’s speech development! Discover thoughtfully designed learning games developed with the guidance of speech-language pathologists, child psychologists, and child development experts. Little ones practice articulation, pronunciation, and boost communication skills in English. 
LEARN TO SPEAK THROUGH TRIED-AND-TRUE METHODS
Science is our north star – that’s why Sago Mini First Words provides proven methods used in speech therapy with a fun twist. Since children learn to speak by mimicking others, First Words utilizes interactive videos as its core teaching method, strengthening articulation and comprehension.
HUNDREDS OF ACTIVITIES PLUS MONTHLY UPDATES
Little ones explore topics they’re naturally interested in while developing their vocabulary. Practice numbers, find out what rabbits like to eat, or even how a bear sounds while developing language skills! Discover carefully-curated stories, mini-games, and real-life scenarios that help your child connect what they’re learning to the world around them. Quench your kiddo’s curiosity with new content added monthly that keeps them engaged and eager to learn more. 
MIMIC, REPEAT, MASTER! 
Sago Mini First Words provides a supportive, curated learning experience for kids at varying developmental levels. As your child repeats the words they hear, the app listens and adjusts learning goals based on their progress and in-game behavior. 
FEATURES
• Personalized practice for a comprehensive speech development journey to fit the needs of all children aged 5 & under 
• Fun, engaging, & educational content designed to improve overall speech practices 
• New content released monthly, with fun games & surprises to look forward to
• 1 subscription across multiple devices for easy access
• Unlimited access to hundreds of learning games in 1 app
• Support for speech impediments and disorders 
• No third-party advertising or in-app purchases 
Sago Mini First Words is part of Piknik – one subscription, endless ways to play and learn! Get full access to the world's best preschool apps from Toca Boca and Sago Mini with an Unlimited Plan.
Try before you buy! Download to start your free trial, no strings attached.
Subscription Details
New subscribers will have access to a free trial at the time of sign-up! After your free trial, you can choose to subscribe on a monthly or annual basis. And if you change your mind at any point, cancellation is easy through your iTunes settings.
• When you confirm your purchase, payment will be charged through your iTunes account.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Don’t want to auto-renew? Manage your account and renewal settings in your user Account Settings.
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID. Like all Apple subscriptions, Sago Mini First Words can’t use family sharing to share subscriptions across different Apple IDs.
• Cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings, without cancellation fee.
• If you need help, have questions, or want to say hello, get in touch at firstwords@sagomini.com
Privacy Policy
Sago Mini is committed to protecting your privacy and the privacy of your children. We adhere to the strict guidelines set forth by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) & KidSAFE, which ensure the protection of your child’s information online. 
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://sagomini.link/termsofuse
About Sago Mini
Sago Mini is an award-winning company devoted to play. We make apps, games and toys for preschoolers worldwide. Toys that seed imagination and grow wonder. We bring thoughtful design to life. For kids. For parents. For giggles.
Find us on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok at @sagomini.

GoMoWorld is a travel eSIM that keeps you connected from the moment you land, with prepaid data plans in 200+ destinations. One eSIM, no commitment, no hidden fees, from $4.99.
Forget airport SIM counters and unexpected roaming charges. Install your eSIM before you leave, activate it when you choose, and have internet as soon as you arrive.
Try before you buy: Depending on your destination, you can test GoMoWorld with up to 1 GB free. No bank card required. Choose your destination and test your connection before you travel or after you arrive.
WHY CHOOSE GOMOWORLD
• High-speed 5G data — multiple partner operators in each country, so your eSIM can automatically connect to the best available network.
• Reliable network infrastructure — quality infrastructure designed for consistent coverage and performance.
• Hotspot included — share your data with your laptop or a travel companion.
• Scheduled activation — choose the date and time your eSIM activates, without using a day of data before your trip.

• 9 languages — English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese and Turkish.
• Prepaid plans for 200+ destinations, with dedicated offers for the USA, Europe and France.
• Free trial to test your connection before choosing a full plan.
• No physical SIM, no store visit — install in minutes while keeping your usual number active.

Is my phone compatible?
Most recent smartphones are compatible. Install your eSIM in minutes with no physical SIM required.
Can I keep my usual number?
Yes. Your main line stays active while you use your GoMoWorld data plan.
How many countries are covered?
More than 200, with multiple partner operators in each country.
Will I pay additional roaming fees?
No. You buy a prepaid data plan with no commitment and no hidden fees, from $4.99.
Can I prepare my eSIM before travelling?
Yes. Install it in advance and schedule activation for the exact date and time you arrive.
Which currencies can I use?
You can pay in 9 currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, CAD and AUD.
WHO IS IT FOR?
Frequent travelers, digital nomads, business travelers and anyone tired of expensive roaming charges or unreliable airport SIM and eSIM options.
Download GoMoWorld and stay connected wherever you go.

1. Pick a video template, slideshow, collage or reels template
2. Add pictures, captions and music
3. Export your HD slideshow, video collage or short reel
【AI Story - AI Slideshow Maker】
Back from a trip? Party photos piling up? AI Story scans your camera roll, groups photos and videos by trip, party or event, matches a theme template and turns them into a movie automatically. One tap, and the AI slideshow maker builds your story with music.

Save-the-date? Wedding album slideshow? Bridal shower or engagement party? Use the movie creator to build a wedding video from your photos, with wedding invitation cards, save-the-date videos and anniversary movies.
【Video Collage & Picture Collage】
Picture collage? Video collage maker? Combine photos into a collage video, birthday collage or family slideshow. Add transitions, captions and music.
【1000+ Video Templates】
Browse 1000+ video templates - birthday, party invitation, wedding, holiday and reels templates. Pick a template, add your photos and music, and your video is ready.
【Baby & Family Photo Album】

bluejetty:00151681:ios.description:
Everyday Grids: Logic Puzzles
A fun daily brain boost — no pressure, just pure logic
Looking for a quick brain workout that actually feels good to play?
Everyday Grids is your daily dose of smart fun — packed with short, clever logic puzzles that keep your mind active without the stress.
From the creators of Everyday Puzzles, this new experience is all about logic — no words, no guesswork. Just satisfying challenges that help sharpen your focus, memory, and problem-solving skills. 
Packed with clever mini-games, daily challenges, and streak-based rewards, it's your perfect go-to for smart, relaxing gameplay.
Play it while you sip your coffee, take a break, or wind down. A chill, satisfying way to give your brain a daily workout. 
Unique Mini-Games – 1 Brilliant Puzzle Hub
Every day brings a fresh set of puzzles designed to stretch your thinking in fun, bite-sized ways.
Each puzzle mode brings its own twist, charm, and logic challenge. 
Lotus
Inspired by Star Battle and Queens puzzles. Place one Lotus Flower in each color zone — no overlaps. Clean, strategic, and super satisfying.
Panda
Match each panda to its bamboo in this playful twist on Tents and Trees. Light-hearted logic at its finest.
Libra
Balance Fire and Ice icons evenly across the grid. Inspired by clever games like Binairo and Tango.
Zip
Trace a single path across the entire grid, visiting every cell. A satisfying journey where every step matters and every seed blossoms into a flower.
Sums
Fill the grid so every row, column, and color region hits the right total. A number-crunching challenge that adds up to pure fun.
Hashi
Link each sushi by building connections based on their numbers. A tasty twist on the classic Bridges that link the whole grid together.
New Puzzles Every Day
Play a fresh puzzle in each game mode daily! Solve them to:
-Keep your streak alive
-Unlock rewards and achievements
-Track your progress and grow your skills
Missed a day? No sweat — use the calendar to catch up anytime.
Even More Features to Unlock
Missions
Complete events and earn XP to unlock special puzzle badges.
XP Levels
Level up by earning XP as you play. The more you solve, the more you earn!
Badges
Collect unique badges from events and challenges to show off your puzzle skills.
VIP Membership
Go VIP to play ad-free and get access to exclusive perks and extras.
Why You’ll Love Everyday Grids:
-Addictive logic puzzles you can play every day
-Unique puzzle types — more coming soon!
-Fun, focused gameplay that fits your schedule
-Daily streaks, XP, and rewards to chase
-Free to play — no pressure, just good vibes
From the Makers of Fan Favorites
Created by Fanatee, the team behind CodyCross, Everyday Puzzles, Word Lanes, LunaCross, Stop, and Stop 2.
If you love brain games, this one’s for you.
Download Everyday Grids: Logic Puzzles now
Jump into the puzzle party, keep your streak going, and give your brain a daily treat — one clever grid at a time.

bluejetty:00021929:ios.name: Celestia - Space Simulator
bluejetty:00021929:ios.summary:
Celestia — real-time 3D visualization of space
3D Space Simulator | Celestia lets you explore our universe in three dimensions.
Celestia simulates many different types of celestial objects. From planets and moons to star clusters and gala
bluejetty:00021929:ios.description:
Celestia — real-time 3D visualization of space
3D Space Simulator | Celestia lets you explore our universe in three dimensions.
Celestia simulates many different types of celestial objects. From planets and moons to star clusters and galaxies, you can visit every object in the expandable database and view it from any point in space and time. The position and movement of solar system objects is calculated accurately in real time at any rate desired.
Interactive Planetarium | Celestia serves as a planetarium – for an observer on any celestial object.
You can easily navigate to any world and land on its surface. When used as a planetarium, Celestia shows accurate positions of solar system objects in the sky. You can switch labels and other supporting features on and off with hotkeys, or zoom in and out on an object of interest, for example Jupiter’s system of moons.
Expandable Content | Customize Celestia according to your needs.
Celestia’s catalogues can be easily expanded. There are many different add-ons available containing new objects like comets or stars, high-resolution textures of Earth and other well mapped solar system bodies, as well as 3D models for asteroids and spacecraft on precise trajectories. Even fictional objects from well-known sci-fi franchises can be found.
EULA(End User License Agreement): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014766:ios.description:
Do you want to landlord smarter? Stessa helps you run your rental property business...like a business. With online rent collection, tenant screening, purpose-built real estate banking, and smart money management, rental owners can easily track rental income, expenses, and overall portfolio performance from anywhere, anytime. Join the hundreds of thousands of real estate investors who use Stessa to maximize their rental profits every month. 
Stessa is a simple-yet-powerful accounting tool that saves landlords time and money by automating the manual work previously required for bookkeeping. Our intuitive platform simplifies rental property finances by bringing all of your transactions together in one place, automating all your reporting, and serving up alerts and insights so you know how your portfolio assets are performing in real-time. 
Access your key metrics on a personalized dashboard to track your monthly income, net cash flow, utility bills, asset appreciation, debt and more—at home or on the go. Make smarter decisions and drive stronger results with better data. 
Streamline your real estate finances with an FDIC-insured checking account that seamlessly integrates with all Stessa has to offer. Both businesses and sole proprietors can enjoy competitive annual percentage yield (APY) rates, no account maintenance fees, and no other hidden fees. 
Ditch the shoebox of receipts and manual spreadsheets and let Stessa’s smart tech do the work instead: Every single transaction is auto-categorized into tax-friendly fields—making financial reporting and tax prep easier than ever before.
ONLINE RENT COLLECTION 
Imagine not having to send rent reminders or deposit rent checks anymore. Let Stessa onboard your tenants, send reminders when rent is due, give you real-time updates when rent is paid, while avoiding the hassles of third-party apps. It’s like getting a rent collection easy button. 
RENTAL APPLICATIONS 
You spent time finding the perfect rental, now fill it with a reliable tenant for free. Skip the hassle of manual screening or having to use third party services. Easily generate applications and track their status, all without leaving Stessa and backed by best-in-industry tenant screening. 
AUTOMATE YOUR FINANCES 
Stessa brings all of your property financials together in one place so there’s no need to log into multiple sites and manually log each transaction. 
TAKE ADVANTAGE OF ONE-CLICK, SMART RECEIPT SCANNING 
Use the Stessa app to easily scan and track property-related receipts on the go in a few clicks. 
SIMPLE SETUP IN SECONDS 
Getting started on Stessa is fast, easy, and free to get started. Add your properties, link your financial accounts and watch your metrics dashboard come to life—accessible on both desktop and mobile. 
SEE HOW YOUR PROPERTIES ARE PERFORMING 
Stessa’s powerful metrics dashboard gives you a clear picture of how your investments are performing, including cash flow, rent roll, net operating income and more. 
EASY PREP FOR TAX SEASON 
Maximize your deductions with better bookkeeping, and make tax time a breeze by running tax-ready financial reports for all of your properties in seconds. 
SAFE & SECURE 
Stessa was designed from the ground up by real estate investors for real estate investors—with security top of mind. With our bank grade security, you can confidently link your financial and property management accounts and securely store important documents. Learn more: https://www.stessa.com/security/ 
“Prior to Stessa, we were doing everything manually, working with different bookkeepers and property managers, attempting to organize everything across multiple spreadsheets. Now we have everything in one place.” - Aaron McDaniel of GrowScale, Forbes

bluejetty:00046738:ios.description:
Select a transit stop, a public place, an address or tap directly on the map to set your pickup/drop-off points.
Set your departure date and time and let Transcollines provide you with the best route for your destination.
On-demand transport: 
In-app notifications will keep you posted on the exact time of pickup. 
You will be able to track the vehicle in real-time on the map and see the remaining time before pickup.
Once onboard, sit back and relax. Transcollines will send you the exact duration of your trip.
Since Transcollines On Demand (TOD) is a transit rideshare service, you could share your trip with fellow riders.
From your phone you can easily: book multiple rides at a time, change or cancel a ride, schedule them in advance and save them to your phone's calendar.
You will also have access to useful information about our on-demand service and tips on how to use it efficiently.
Fixed route bus transport: 
Consult the timetables and routes of bus lines, add your stops and favorite lines to stay informed of any disruptions.
Ticketing: 
Buy your tickets on the app, validate your titles. The titles are valid on fixed route bus line and for the on-demand service. For more details, consult the titles and fares on the Transcollines website: (https://transcollines.ca/en/getting-around/public-transportation/#3)
Like it? Rate it!
A question? Send us an email at support@transcollines.ca

Learn while playing

• Letters from A to Z
• Numbers and counting
• Vowels recognition
• Letter and number tracing
• Pronunciation and listening
• Reading and writing basics
• Uppercase and lowercase matching
Multilingual learning
Includes text and voices in multiple languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese. Kids can also improve pronunciation and vocabulary while learning new languages.
Designed for focused learning
A special distraction-free Focus Mode helps reduce visual overload by removing unnecessary elements, making it easier for some learners to stay engaged and concentrate on letters, vowels and numbers.
Why parents love it
• Easy and intuitive for young children
• Perfect for preschool and early learning
• Supports memory, logic and attention
• Encourages independent play and learning
• Free educational activities for everyday use

• Encourages independent play and learning

bluejetty:00138102:ios.description:
Welcome to Restaurant Tycoon: Simulator — a strategic restaurant management game where your dream of building a culinary empire becomes reality.
Play as a rising tycoon starting from a single café. Make smart business decisions, analyze markets, hire top talent, and grow your brand across cities, hotels, malls, and cruise ports. This is more than just a cooking game — it’s a full-scale food business simulator where every choice shapes your success.
What You’ll Do:
1. Grow your restaurant empire
Scout high-potential locations, unlock new districts, and expand from a cozy diner to a world-class restaurant chain.
2. Define your culinary style
Pick from popular cuisines like European, Mediterranean, or Continental. Adapt your concept to match customer preferences and maximize popularity.
3. Hire the right staff
From chefs to floor managers, your team’s performance impacts your reputation. Train them well and watch your ratings soar.
4. Customize your restaurant design
Choose interior layouts, décor themes, and exterior styles that attract the right audience and leave a lasting impression.
5. Manage daily operations
Balance speed, service, and strategy to keep customers happy and business booming. Whether you’re actively playing or earning offline, your restaurant keeps growing.
Features:
- Full restaurant simulator with engaging tycoon mechanics
- A rich blend of cooking, restaurant, and business management gameplay
- Multiple cuisine options: pizza, sushi, burgers, European and more
- Expand your brand across cafés, hotels, cruise ships, and shopping malls
- Perfect for fans of idle games, offline simulators, and food tycoon games
Build your brand, outsmart the competition, and rise to the top of the global restaurant business in Restaurant Tycoon: Simulator.
Download now and take the first step toward becoming a legendary restaurant tycoon.

独创声纹级识别技术，精准捕捉音素级发音瑕疵，支持中英文双向流畅交互，中文随时提问解惑，彻底告别发音尴尬与开口焦虑，大胆畅说零压力。更搭载超自然拟人音色，美式、英式口音自由切换，自带真实人类情绪温度，摒弃机械冰冷的AI对话，如同挚友相伴，交流自然无隔阂。
产品深度适配个性化学习需求，智能调节对话难度与语速；搭载专属长期记忆能力，时刻牢记你的学习进度；依据科学记忆曲线，在交流中潜移默化巩固薄弱点，像专属私教一样贴心提醒复习。
还有火花日历，支持7天、14天、30天学习打卡挑战，同步配备学霸榜，包含连续打卡排名、今日时长排名、等级排名，学习成果一目了然，成就感满满。
全场景无死角覆盖，精准适配各类学习需求
咕噜口语彻底打破“学用脱节”的传统痛点，构建从基础入门到高阶进阶、覆盖全生命周期的口语体系，无论是日常交流、应试考级，还是职场商务、学术专业，均能精准匹配需求，实现“学即所用、用即精准”。
一、基础入门场景
筑牢语言核心基石，覆盖日常交流全场景：
• 日常打招呼问候、问路指路、简单寒暄等基础对话，从零起步无压力，快速建立口语表达自信。
二、应试考级全系列
一站式搞定各类考试口语难点，针对性突破高分瓶颈：
• 覆盖KET/PET、托福口语、考研面试/复试、雅思Part1-3、剑桥阅读CPRA、人教版PEP同步口语等全品类应试场景，精准匹配考试题型与评分标准，助力稳步提分。
三、职场商务场景
贴合职场实战需求，覆盖全流程沟通与专业场景：
1. 通用职场：求职面试、合同签订、工作请示汇报、客户拜访洽谈、职场日常沟通等核心场景，精准锤炼职场表达能力，助力职场进阶。
2. 外贸专项：精通完税后交货、运输保险协商、外贸业务全流程等专业场景，适配外贸行业口语需求，打通跨境业务沟通壁垒。
四、日常生活场景
覆盖高频生活场景，实现“走到哪、用到哪”的实用口语：
• 餐厅点餐、便利店购物、药房买药、服饰选购、医院看病、运动健身、校园生活、旅游出行等日常场景，随学随用，解决生活口语刚需。
五、高阶学术场景
适配专业学术场景，支撑高端交流与研究需求：
• 学术会议交流、专业领域研讨等高阶场景，精准匹配学术表达逻辑，助力专业领域深度沟通。
除核心全场景覆盖外，更搭载多项实用功能：
• AI情景练习：还原各类真实对话场景，沉浸式实战演练；

bluejetty:00061231:ios.name: Focus Matrix – Task Manager
bluejetty:00061231:ios.summary: Focus Matrix is a smart personal organizer based on the so-called Eisenhower box, a personal productivity strategy created by Dwight Eisenhower, the 34th President of the United States. The principle uses a special priority matrix that help
bluejetty:00061231:ios.description:
Focus Matrix is a smart personal organizer based on the so-called Eisenhower box, a personal productivity strategy created by Dwight Eisenhower, the 34th President of the United States. The principle uses a special priority matrix that helps break your tasks into several groups depending on their urgency and importance, and work your way through your daily agenda in the most efficient way possible. This app will help you focus on what really matters, and get rid of the things that can be painlessly delegated to others or postponed indefinitely until you have time for them.
Task Organization
• Two views: Matrix and List of Sections
• “Unsorted” section to hold incoming tasks until you categorize them
• Move tasks between sections using drag-and-drop
• Maximize sections to focus on specific content
Task Scheduling and Reminders
• Assign due dates to tasks
• Set “All day task” for whole-day planning
• Create recurring tasks with customizable repeat options
• Set reminders to never miss an important deadline
Advanced Task Features
• Automatically move a task to 'Urgent' as its deadline approaches, with timely notifications
• Automatically move a task to 'Urgent' when a linked task is completed
• Track task creation and completion dates for detailed management
• Paste multiline text as individual tasks to speed up input
Sorting, Filtering, and Tags
• Sort tasks by title, due date, or manually
• Use tags to organize tasks effectively
• Filter tasks by tags and statuses (completed/uncompleted)
• Save and quickly apply custom filter presets for easy navigation
Synchronization and Integration
• Sync data across all your devices
• Sync tasks with Calendar
• Integrate with Be Focused*: Sync tasks between apps and start timer in Be Focused directly from Focus Matrix
Exporting and Reporting
• Export task lists to PDF or print them for offline use
• Configurable statistics and reports for completed tasks
Security and Privacy
• Password and Face ID protection for secure task management
Platform Compatibility
• Fully available for Mac and iOS
Pro Version Features
• Cross-device synchronization
• Synchronization of tasks with Calendar
• Integration with Be Focused*: Sync tasks between apps and start timer in Be Focused directly from Focus Matrix
Focus Matrix is free to download and use forever. However, if you want to access the Pro features on all your iPhones, iPads, and Macs, you can upgrade to the Pro version. The Pro subscription comes in three different options: Monthly, Yearly with a 7-day trial, and Lifetime (one-time payment).
Payment will be charged to your App Store account and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://xwavesoft.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://xwavesoft.com/terms-of-use.html
* Be Focused helps you get things done by breaking up individual tasks among discrete intervals. It’s available for Mac and iOS devices in App Store. Integration with Be Focused requires the Pro version of Be Focused, sold separately.

bluejetty:00080548:ios.description:
With Medely, nurses and allied healthcare professionals build flexibility and freedom into their lives. Use Medely’s all-in-one on-demand platform to book per diem, local assignments and travel assignments that work with your schedule. It’s easy to use and once approved, you can find work, book per diem shifts and assignments, get automated request alerts to your phone or email so you never miss an opportunity, and track your earnings all within the app.
FLEXIBILITY AND TECHNOLOGY
Work when you want, earn what you want. Medely empowers nurses and allied health professionals to work on their schedules, earn more, and get paid fast. Once you have been accepted into the Medely platform, you can use the app to manage all of your daily needs with just the click of a button.
WORK BASED ON YOUR SCHEDULE AND LIFESTYLE
Looking for a few shifts to fill the gaps in your schedule or want something longer-term, join Medely today! Medely provides you with the opportunity to create your own per diem, travel, or local assignments dream schedule whether that’s working part time or full time. Browse through the shifts available within your area or search for shifts in a city you have always wanted to visit, all available within our app.
SUPPORT TEAM OF YOUR PEERS
We know that the healthcare industry has its own nuances and we want to make sure we can answer questions throughout your entire journey. That’s why Medely did something unique. Not only do we have a support team, but our support team is made up of RNs with an average tenure of 16 years of providing medical care so throughout your screening process you will always be connected to someone who understands the business and types of positions offered through Medely.
Why download the app?
Did you know that Medely has over 7,000 facilities that are currently posting positions on Medely? That’s right! Over 1 million shifts have been booked since 2016 through Medely. Not only is our app easy-to-use but it also gives you access to a network of healthcare facilities that let you choose the lifestyle you want to live.

The intuitive, user-friendly interface makes it easy to get mor
bluejetty:00016892:ios.description:
Onkyo Controller is the official Onkyo remote control application that allows users to conveniently operate compatible Onkyo network products from their iPhone/iPod touch/iPad.
The intuitive, user-friendly interface makes it easy to get more from your AV home entertainment experience.
Main functions that can be operated through this application.
(1) Play music in each room or every room
- Lets you play music from music streaming services such as Pandora, Spotify, DEEZER and TIDAL, your music library on your smart device, or your NAS drive on compatible products.
- You can play your music via radio, Bluetooth and USB.
(2) Remote control functions
- You can operate general control functions (play/stop, control the volume, select the input source, etc.) from your smartphone.
(3) Operation of connected product（home theater product such as AV amplifier）
- Lets you control a Blu-Ray Disc player or TV that is connected to an AV amplifier or home theater product via HDMI.
(4) Dirac Live-enabled products measure automatic sound field correction. In addition, filters can be edited.
(5) Audio/Video formats of input and output can also be checked.
*By setting the “Network Standby” menu item in the unit’s initial settings to ON, you can use this application to turn on the power of the unit.
Compatible models
Network AV Receivers/Network Audio Player/Home Theater/Wireless Speaker in April 2016 or later
■ Please note
・To use Application it needs to read and agree Terms of Service.
・All models require a firmware update to use Onkyo Controller.
・Available Service depends on regions.
・Why Device's location is needed? Answer: In order to set-up your wireless devices which are located around you, SSID and Access Point info is needed. There is no other purpose to use the information of Device’s Location.

• Change the look of your cards and background for a customized experience
• Easy tap to move interactions for quick gameplay

• Customize settings to suit your taste
• Adjust difficulty with 1-4 suit games
• Use the Unrestricted Deal setting to deal new cards, even with empty slots

bluejetty:00161135:ios.summary:
Change the settings of your JBD / Xiaoxiang smart BMS without an account and without waiting for an approval. Reading all values is free; Pro, a one-time purchase, unlocks configuration, calibration, ports, alarms and the charge limit.
Blu
bluejetty:00161135:ios.description:
Change the settings of your JBD / Xiaoxiang smart BMS without an account and without waiting for an approval. Reading all values is free; Pro, a one-time purchase, unlocks configuration, calibration, ports, alarms and the charge limit.
Bluetooth password: the newest JBD Bluetooth modules support a password. This app unlocks such a module, sets or changes its password and removes a forgotten one (in-app purchase). Older modules without this function have no password and connect as before.
New in 2.0:
- Password of the newest JBD Bluetooth modules (those that support it): unlock, set or change it; a forgotten password can be removed (in-app purchase)
- Charge limit: stop charging at a level you choose, for a longer battery life
- Alarms with minimum duration, hysteresis and reminders
- All settings in one clear list, no more PIN screens
Free:
- Charge, voltage, current and power, with the time until full or empty
- Every cell voltage, the cell difference and balancing
- Temperatures, protection counters and BMS alarms
- History of charge, power and cells, energy per day
- Widgets and an app for the Apple Watch
Pro, a one-time purchase without subscription:
- Read and write all BMS settings, keep them as files
- Switch charging and discharging on and off
- Calibrate the current and the cell voltages
- Alarms on iPhone and Apple Watch
- Charge limit
- No ads
Give your BMS its own name: change the Bluetooth name that every phone and app sees, or set a name used only in this app. The app clears the hardware PIN of a locked BMS, as the official JBD app does.
For Xiaoxiang / JBD (jiabaida) smart BMS such as JBD-SP15S001 and JBD-SP05S002 in Li-ion and LiFePO4 batteries of campers, boats, solar systems and e-bikes. Runs on iPhones from iOS 15 and on the Apple Watch from watchOS 9.
Please note: I am not the manufacturer of the BMS. For questions about the hardware or to buy one, contact a manufacturer, for example https://www.lithiumbatterypcb.com/
Missing a feature or found a problem? Open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/smagicld/xiaoxiangBMS/issues
Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Ukrainian and Chinese.

bluejetty:00015109:ios.description:
THIS APP REQUIRES A CL-150 ACCOUNT TO USE.
If you have a CL-150 account, simply enter the username and password on the log in screen.
This app is designed to allow you to take your language learning on-the-go, with all the latest features that the CL-150 platform has to offer.
CL-150 (Latest Version) Features:
• 100+ Languages (and Growing!): From Afrikaans to Zulu, the number of languages available to learners is constantly growing.
• Alphabet Lessons: You can't learn to read or write if you don't know the alphabet. Get started on the right foot with our Alphabet course.
• Supplemental Vocabulary: Build proficiency by learning thousands of useful words and phrases categorized by topic and presented in an engaging, memory-building format complete with native speaker pronunciation. 
• Core Skill-Building Activities: Work your way through activities that build all four core skills; listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
• Smart Insight and Review: Learned Vocab Items tell you how much you’ve learned and when it's time to review.
Privacy Details:
We take your privacy seriously. Please refer to our App Privacy label below. Some detail:
• “Email” - Your email address is used for password recovery or to send you messages such as Daily Refreshers and other notifications that you ask to receive. If you are working with an instructor, you may also receive messages from your instructor via email as well as in the program. We do not view or access any of your other emails or messages. 
• “User Content” – Some versions of this program offer the ability to create your own learning lessons and share them with the community. This is entirely optional.

bluejetty:00021715:ios.summary:
