After your chats are imported in this app the backup gets completed and
bluejetty:00021715:ios.description:
Your secrets are safe with WhatsApp Backup!
WhatsApp Backup makes it simple to back up your important and private WhatsApp conversations, media, links, and documents.
After your chats are imported in this app the backup gets completed and now if the same chat is deleted from your WhatsApp, this app allows you to access deleted chats, media and documents with a WhatsApp-like preview. 
WhatsApp Backup allows you to view your chat privately and securely, while you can delete it from WhatsApp.
Furthermore, WhatsApp Chat Backup secures the backup of your private chat in a simple and secure manner by adding a passcode to the app.
Other Features :
Import chats from any platform
With WA Backup, you can import chats not only from WhatsApp but from other platforms like WhatsApp Business, Google Drive, File Manager, or anywhere where you have saved your exported chat.
View chats just like WhatsApp
Get your chats, photos, videos, audios, documents, and links just as you would get them in WhatsApp, with perfect timestamps.
Click to chat for WhatsApp
You can chat with unknown people or one-time contacts and keep the conversation going without saving the contact. 
Export to drive or other storage option
WhatsApp chats, media, and documents can all be simply exported to your hard drive or other storage alternatives from this app (in case you need your chat somewhere else too).
Text to speech
With just one click, you can hear the messages from your backed up chat loud and clear with this feature. It comes in very handy when chats are in a different language than your native language.
Move to the first or last message with one click
Just click on the arrow, and you can move to the first or last message of the chat.
Secure the backup of your private chat
Passcode, Touch ID, or Face ID can also be used to protect the backup. The WA Backup app will keep your WhatsApp backup safe and secure.
How do I use the WhatsApp Chat Backup app?
Simply follow these easy steps :
1. Tap on the chat you want to backup
2. Go to contact info
3. Select export chat
4. Choose if you want to attach media or not
5. Select WA Backup App
The chat will be exported to the WA backup now.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
In-App Purchase:
Weekly Subscription : USD $ 01.99
Monthly Subscription : USD $ 02.99
Yearly Subscription : USD $ 19.99
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Please read our Terms and Service & Privacy Policy
Privacy : https://docs.google.com/document/d/17JxuThbymRGTn0J-AQ5n0IFqtI6y3SlexcVKmPD24Uc/edit?usp=sharing
Terms: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yAYwPDY7xL6oiqOiwkyXH1Rm3ny7nQTbwp2WJbN2Pto/edit?usp=sharing

Dive into the thrilling world of Armored Robots, the ultimate mobile battle game where you compete against other players in intense PvP robot battles. This arena-based shooter game lets you control and customize your own powerful mech, upgrading it with various parts and pieces to dominate the battlefield.

Choose from a vast array of robots and customize your mech with different weapons, armor, and special abilities. Whether you prefer long-range shooting or close-quarters combat, there's a setup for every playstyle.

Armored Robots isn't just a shooter game; it's a dynamic and immersive experience that keeps you coming back for more. The stunning graphics, realistic physics, and explosive sound effects make every robot fight feel incredibly intense and satisfying.
Join the robot battle and prove your skills in the ultimate battle royale. Grab your weapons, gear up your robot, and step into the arena for the fight of your life.
Dominate the mech arena, conquer your foes, and become the champion of Armored Robots!

bluejetty:00120716:ios.description:
With over 10 million users and co-designed by professional singing teachers, Voice Training is one of the most popular singing apps.
• Follow the singing exercises and the app tells you whether you sing in tune.
• You can enjoy a singing class environment where teachers use a piano as a guide for pitch.
• The piano keys highlight showing which note you should sing and which pitch you are correctly singing. 
• Keep track of progress and gain stars for great singing.
• Designed in collaboration with professional singing teachers.
• A full singing work out where you efficiently learn to sing with perfect pitch, quickly expand your vocal range and fun exercises to sing in different styles.
*** sing the note game ***
An ideal ideal for beginners where you can train your voice to sing in tune quickly. Ideal for advanced singers too as effective pitch detection shows you exactly how close to perfect pitch you are.
*** vocal range ***
Series of exercises structured from easy to advanced levels to expand your vocal range by relaxing your voice.
*** free sing ***
Sing and the keyboard will highlight the appropriate pitches.
Record and save your singing and play back at a later date, seeing how quickly you are improving.
Improvise with rhythm as you select backing track (mp3, wav) from your own music collection.
*** sing the phrase game ***
Series of levels and exercises to increase range and perfection. The pitch analyses shows whether singers can perfectly sing intervals.
*** hold the pitch challenge ***
Enjoy a fun exercise by see how long you can hold a pitch. Keep track of your progress as the scores are stored for future reference.
*** interval test ***
Practice and be well prepared for your music grade exams. The app will give immediate feedback on whether singers can sing specified intervals at various levels.
*** harmony ***
Learn quickly how to sing harmonies with instant feedback and appropriate levels.
*** vocal agility ***
Quickly develop confidence to perform singing riffs and runs. Follow the suggested famous singing riffs from all styles or program your own exercises. Helps with improvisation.

bluejetty:00128368:ios.name: Sudoku by MobilityWare+
bluejetty:00128368:ios.summary: Sudoku by MobilityWare is a vibrant and timeless rendition of the classic puzzle game – a game that blends iconic puzzle-solving that you know and love with a burst of color! Whether you're a seasoned Sudoku enthusiast or just beginning you
bluejetty:00128368:ios.description:
Sudoku by MobilityWare is a vibrant and timeless rendition of the classic puzzle game – a game that blends iconic puzzle-solving that you know and love with a burst of color! Whether you're a seasoned Sudoku enthusiast or just beginning your journey, our colorful Sudoku game offers an engaging approach to mastering the art of Sudoku solving.
Designed with approachability in mind, this Sudoku adventure infuses the traditional challenge with a colorful twist. Delve into the world of logic and strategy as you immerse yourself in this delightful puzzle experience. And guess what? If you're feeling nostalgic for the simplicity of the classic black and white gameplay, you can still customize your gameplay to fit the Black & White classic look and experience. Unravel the mysteries of the grid with ease and embark on a colorful journey to become a Sudoku master!
Just start easy! Truly train your brain to understand new sudoku puzzle logic without complication or the strain of looking at black and white grids. Start training by playing smaller sudoku puzzles and harness the power of color and your brain will make more logical decisions! And as you become a sudoku puzzle solving master, adjust your difficulty to hard for a break from the now too-easy sudoku puzzles from your sudoku infancy!
-Color Helps Your Eyes and Brain
Black and white sudoku puzzle grids can be stark and hurt those eyes. Our gentler color grid puzzles are easy on the eyes, and help your brain strategize faster!
-Smaller Puzzles Give You a Big Boost
A largely blank 9x9 classic sudoku grid can be a scary thing. We start you out on smaller puzzles until you get the hang of logic and can start to formulate strategy!
-Difficulty Levels Keep You Training
Your brain will soon become a sudoku color master and while you can continue to enjoy solving sampler sudoku puzzles, you can always check Settings for Hard mode! We believe in you, but we like to play to just relax too ;)
-Weekly Events Bring Unique Challenges
Complete unique holiday puzzles, travel to 53 unique destinations in our new Travel Events, and complete puzzles to earn watering cans and water your Garden—all while discovering new ways to play Sudoku! 
-Sudoku Veterans Welcome
If you don’t want your hand held or you prefer a classic black and white sudoku grid, you can always access good old fashioned original sudoku from the play menu.
If we don’t make Sudoku the easiest game to learn or better understand, color us confused :P

bluejetty:00063268:ios.description:
How much does my crush like me is the ultimate app for anyone who's ever wondered about the level of attraction from their crush. With just 10 simple questions, this app can give you an accurate calculation of how much your crush likes you.
Have you ever spent hours analyzing every little interaction between you and your crush, trying to determine if they're into you or not? Have you ever wished there was a way to know for sure without having to ask them directly? Well, now you can, thanks to "How much does my crush like me."
The app features 30 different quizzes to try, each with its own unique set of questions designed to measure the level of interest your crush has in you.
Once you've completed a quiz, the app will provide you with a score. This information can help you make more informed decisions about your relationship and can give you the confidence you need to take things to the next level.
You can take a quiz whenever and wherever you want, making it perfect for those moments when you're feeling unsure about your crush's feelings. And with 30 different quizzes, you can try out different combinations of questions to get a more nuanced understanding of your crush's level of interest.
Please note this app/game has been developed only for entertainment purposes and has no intention to hurt the user's feelings. The application uses a numerical algorithm to calculate the love match and should be used only for fun.
This app contains an auto-renewing subscription for $2.99 per week. You can try out the subscription first, with a 3 day free trial. Once subscribed, you can cancel your subscription at any point.

bluejetty:00140025:ios.description:
Want to learn English but don’t have anyone to practice with? Your AI English tutor is always ready to help you learn to speak English anytime, anywhere.
Fluentika makes learning English practical with 400+ lessons and 60+ real-life topics, from ordering coffee to nailing a job interview. Master grammar, vocabulary, and English speaking all in one app. Join 600K+ learners turning practice into fluency.
WHY LEARN ENGLISH WITH FLUENTIKA?
• Expert-crafted lessons: 400+ courses designed by professional teachers, so you can learn English with a program designed for real results.
• Topics that match your life: Practice everyday conversations, and English for business, travel, interviews, and specialized scenarios, so you can speak English where it matters most.
• Your ideal AI English tutor: Choose from different accents, voices, and personalities to make learning English feel natural and engaging.
• Unlimited 24/7 access: Your AI English tutor is always ready for English speaking practice. No scheduling, no time limits, no waiting.
WHAT'S INSIDE THE APP?
◆ A Tutor You Choose ◆
Browse a variety of AI English tutors with unique accents, voices, and personalities. Pick the one that feels right and start learning English in a way that suits you. 
◆ Tailored Study Plan ◆
Start where you are, and get to where you want to be. 400+ lessons crafted by experts match your level and goals, adjusting as you improve. Learn English your way with an AI English tutor guiding every step.
◆ Rich Lesson Library ◆
Choose from three lesson types to make learning English work for you:
• Grammar: Clear explanations and practice with your AI English tutor.
• Vocabulary: Themed word packs and exercises to grow your language skills.
• Role-play: Speak English through real-life conversations and everyday scenarios.
Learning English becomes practical when your AI English tutor highlights your progress after every session.
◆ Smart Vocabulary Builder ◆
Save new words as you learn English and revisit them anytime. Every word comes with context and examples. Memorize faster by seeing vocabulary in action.
◆ Instant Feedback ◆
Get better with every answer. Your AI English tutor checks responses in real time, explains mistakes, and shows you how to improve. Learn English faster when you know what to fix and why.
Ready to speak English fluently? Download Fluentika and start learning English with an AI English tutor who's always by your side.

Subscribe for unlimited access to everything the app has to offer for learning English. 
Subscriptions are billed automatically based on the rate of the selected plan.

bluejetty:00161959:ios.summary:

After 10 years of good sales all over the world, we are glad to see that iAnalyzer has gradually become the industry standard in a
bluejetty:00161959:ios.description:
iAnalyzer is a FFT based professional software to analyze the audio signals for iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad. 
After 10 years of good sales all over the world, we are glad to see that iAnalyzer has gradually become the industry standard in audio analyze field, due to it's very high quality of course. This is definitely a Must Have app for every musician or sound engineer.
We also released the Mac version, you can download it from "Mac App Store".
Features:
-High performance software design for Real Time Analyzing(RTA) and complex graph displaying.
-Works on 44K sample rate, 20~20k Hz frequency output.
-FFT spectrum, Octave and 1/3 Octave result display.
-Colored curve depend on the dB value.
-Flex FFT size, 4K, 8K, or 16K.
-Reference Pressure configurable.
-2D or 3D or Mix 2D&3D display.
-History result display while in 3D mode.
-High precision peak frequency computation, average-error lower than 0.1%.
-Auto peak frequency tracing, up to 3 peaks can be displayed simultaneously and each one be linked from text to the graph clearly.
-Frequency to music scale converter, you can use iAnalyzer as a professional instrument tuner, or to test if any sound is tuneful. 
-Powerful synthesizer to allow you replay the audio with different speed, from 1/8 to 4x. With this feature, you can listen to your recoding very slowly. (Require iPhone 4S and later, iPad 2 and later which shipped with multiple cores processor.)
-VGA output support. Sync display on your device and extern screen. (iPhone 4, iPod touch 4 and iPad required)
-Current waveform display and summary waveform display.
-Record at any position and red color to mark the latest recording, unlimited recording time.
-Play back the recording.
-Oscope Auto-Scale: Enable you to view more details for low level signal.
-Snap to Peak: Find peak more easily while using measure line.
-File Manager: Recording in wave format, create new files, delete exist files, etc.
-Wifi Transfer and Data exporting: Download wav files with your browser, including screen shot, FFT result in txt file.
-Touch in the result area to use the measure line, bordered label means where is a peak.
-Move in the waveform area or touch on the bottom of the area to change the current position, iAnalyzer re-compute and update graph automatically. You can also change the position while playing.
Note:
-The internal mic of iPhone first generation can only works on 8K sample rate, you need head-set to achieve 44k. 
-Press "File" button to see the HTTP address, it is in the bottom of the window.
-For more information, Please visit http://phyar.cn .
How to Use:
-Touch and move in the result area with one finger to use the measure line.
-Touch and move in the result area with 3 fingers to rotate the 3D graph.
-Touch and move in the summary waveform area to move the current position.
-Tap in the scroll bar area(bottom of screen) to re-seek the current position.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: http://phyar.cn/pp/

bluejetty:00179749:ios.description:

This app will set up a schedule of water consumption according to personal parameters and also take into account your lifestyle and climate. Easily schedule reminders to drink water. And get in the habit of being healthy! The app "Water Tracker Pro" will help you master this important skill.
Time to drink water!
* Medical calculation of the rate of water consumption per day
How much water to drink per day depends on the characteristics of the body. The application will determine a rate based on your parameters.
* Customized settings for your lifestyle
In the hotter seasons and during physical activity you especially need to monitor your body’s water balance.
* It makes it easier to lose weight
Getting started on drinking water for weight loss is your step on the path to slimness and well-being!
* Convenient scheduled reminders to drink water
Reminders to drink water will always come right on time. Create your ideal schedule, select pleasant notification sounds to remember to drink water easily and happily.
* Quick access to your favorite drinks
Mark the water you have drank with one touch of the widget or immediately in the reminder message, add your own unique drinks, easily track your progress and the balance of water in the body.
* Get your body adjusted to healthy habits - for one course!
A scientifically based method will help you gain a stable habit not only to drink water properly, but also to monitor your health.
Get started now! Install the app, drink the first glass of water - you are on your way to a better state of health!
NOTE: Water Tracker is not a medical app. the recommended water intake goal is simply an estimate based on your weight and gender. Please consult with your doctor if you want to use it for medical purposes or have specific hydration needs

bluejetty:00015011:ios.summary: Welcome to Farm Games for Kids, the ultimate animal farm game for toddlers and kids! Experience the joys of living a farm life and harvesting fresh fruits and vegetables, tending to cute farm animals, building a farm barn, and more! Immerse
bluejetty:00015011:ios.description:
Welcome to Farm Games for Kids, the ultimate animal farm game for toddlers and kids! Experience the joys of living a farm life and harvesting fresh fruits and vegetables, tending to cute farm animals, building a farm barn, and more! Immerse yourself in the beautiful world of farming as you plant and grow various crops and enjoy living the little farmer life in your farmhouse.
Once you've grown your crops, it's time to harvest them with these farming games! But watch out for pesky worms and other insects that can damage your fruits and vegetables. You'll need to remove them carefully so your crops stay healthy and ready to sell at the market. Once you've harvested your crops, it's time to add them to your basket. You can drag and drop vegetables one by one into your basket. Perfect learning for toddlers!
Next, you need to send your vegetables to the market. The truck will collect the vegetables one by one on the way to the market, so make sure they're organized properly! Once the truck arrives at the market, you can drag and drop your vegetables into the shop. Try to match the vegetable crates to their corresponding shadows for bonus points!
In addition to growing crops, you can also take care of your cute farm animals in these farming games for toddlers. In the animal farming games, you'll need to remove spikes from animals in the farm by tapping and holding to grab a cutter. Apply cream on pimples and healing cream on cuts. Apply a bandage to the affected area and place an ice pack on any swollen areas. After caring for your cute farm animals, you can feed them and even give them a bath! Wash them with soap, clean the foam with water, and use a hairdryer to dry them off.
You can also play mini-games, such as farming with animals. In our shadow-matching game, you can add animals to their matching shadows. You can also play the little farmer color sorting fruit game by dragging and dropping the same-colored fruit into the corresponding baskets. Match animal babies to their parents, catch the animals hiding in the bushes, or play our whack-a-mole game by tapping on each animal to catch them!
Lastly, you can collect fruits from plants, place them in their respective baskets, add them to the juicer, and fill the bottles with fresh fruit juice! It's a fun way to enjoy the fruits of your labor (pun intended).
Here's why little farmers love Farm Games for Kids:
Fun and interactive gameplay:
The farm game lets kids learn about farm barn, farming with animals, and agriculture in a fun and interactive way. With the different mini-games, kids can do things like plant and grow vegetables, take care of animals, and more.
Vivid graphics:
Cute, colorful, and fun graphics in this animal farm game will keep kids engaged for hours.
Learning through play:
Our animal farm game for toddlers features games like shadow matching, puzzles, and tracing that help kids build skills like hand-eye coordination, focus, concentration, and fine motor skills.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.timpygames.com/privacypolicy.php 
Terms of Service: https://www.idzdigital.com/terms_of_service.php
Get Farm Games for Kids and play the ultimate animal farm game today! Build your farmhouse, and start growing and harvesting. Enjoy farming with animals! With endless possibilities and hours of fun, these animal farming games are perfect for anyone who loves farming, animals, and living country life.

bluejetty:00137344:ios.description:
Welcome to 'Nuts and Bolts Puzzle: Screw' – the ultimate brain-teasing adventure that will twist and turn your mind!
Are you ready to dive into a world of mechanical marvels and intricate puzzles? 'Nuts and Bolts Puzzle: Screw' offers a unique and captivating gaming experience that challenges your problem-solving skills in a fun and engaging way.
Embark on a journey through a series of challenging levels where you'll encounter a variety of nuts, bolts, and screws scattered across the game board. Your task is to strategically manipulate these components to disassemble them correctly. With each level presenting new obstacles and complexities, you'll need to think critically and plan your moves carefully to solve the puzzles efficiently.
Featuring intuitive controls and stunning visuals, 'Nuts and Bolts Puzzle: Screw' provides hours of addictive gameplay for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a relaxing challenge or a seasoned puzzler seeking a new test of wit, this game offers something for everyone.
Exciting Features of Wood Nuts & Bolts, Screw Puzzle:
• Freely twisted, unscrew and screw pin to solve Bolts, Screw Puzzle
• No time limit, relax and play whenever you want.
• Unlimited levels! A lot of Wood Nuts & Bolts, Screw pin strategies await you.
Your objective in Nuts and Bolts Puzzle is to dismantle the wooden plates from the puzzle board by deciphering the correct unlocking sequence:
1. Examine the wooden nuts and bolts that require precise twisting.
2. Rearrange the nuts and bolts into the correct positions to eliminate all wooden plates.
3. Experiment with methods to efficiently manipulate and align the bolts. Discover the optimal solution.
4. Successfully complete each puzzle to unlock new difficulty levels.
Nuts & Bolts, Screw Puzzle is perfect for those who:
• Want to challenge new obstacles
• Love hard puzzle levels and wood materials
• Enjoy the ASMR sound of woods
So, are you up for the challenge? Download 'Nuts and Bolts Puzzle: Screw' now and start unraveling the mechanical mysteries today!

bluejetty:00033195:ios.description:
Dive into an exciting adventure in a world full of animals, where you can see life through the eyes of a cute kitten or a playful puppy! In this pet simulator, you can have up to 5 pets, creating your dream team of dogs and cats. Whether you’re exploring bustling city streets, playing on a sunny beach, or relaxing at home, this cat and dog simulator offers a vibrant world of possibilities!
Game Features:
Create and Customize Your Pets
Start by creating your perfect kitten or puppy! Choose from a variety of collars, costumes, magical wings, and even vehicles. Make each pet unique and let them reflect your style in this delightful pet life simulator.
Explore a Huge World
Your pets can roam around a large city, parks, and beaches, where they can swim, play, and meet other animals. The open world lets you explore every corner—visit friends, discover new areas, or even buy an apartment!
Online & Offline Modes
Play your way! Jump into online pet adventures to interact with other players, battle, team up for fun, and go on exciting quests. Or play offline, completing tasks in the kitten and puppy simulator without an internet connection.
Battle Mode
Unleash your inner warrior cat or brave dog! Take part in thrilling battles with other players. Show off your skills and test your strength!
Fun Activities
Earn rewards and experience points by completing tasks that help you level up and unlock even more customization options.
Build Your Pet’s Dream Life
Buy a cozy apartment where your cats and dogs can relax. Watch your animal world come to life in this virtual world!
Hundreds of Accessories
Express yourself with a wide range of costumes, collars, hats, wings, and vehicles! From funny hats and cool glasses to wings and superhero cars—your kitten and puppy will always look their best.
Beach & Nature Adventures
Take your adorable cat or dog to the beach for a swim and some sun, or head to the park to play with other animals. The large open spaces let your pets enjoy true freedom. Whether it’s a sunbathing kitten or a puppy romping in the grass, there’s plenty of fun and exploration outdoors.
Play with Friends Online
Meet other pet lovers in online pet games. Team up for missions or compete for the title of the most stylish pet. Make friends with players worldwide who love dogs and cats just like you!
Why You’ll Love This Game:
Have up to 5 pets—dogs and cats
Customize each kitten and puppy with costumes, wings, collars, and vehicles
Explore a huge city, visit the beach, and buy your own apartment
Join online and offline pet games
Enjoy battles and quests to earn rewards
Meet friends and play in a lively online world
Ready for Your Pet Adventure?
Download now and join the animal world adventures with your very own team of adorable, playful pets. Whether you love kitten simulator challenges, dog games, or just creating the most stylish pet, endless fun awaits you in this delightful world!

bluejetty:00074143:ios.description:
A safe messenger for kids and families. Secure chats, video calls, mini games, stickers and more—all in a COPPA-certified app designed for family connection.
SCREEN TIME WELL SPENT
* Technology designed around our Three C's: connection, creativity and cultivation
* Interactive stories, podcasts and activities in the Paths Center enhance your messaging experience
* Buy in-chat mini games, photo and video filters and sticker packs in the Marketplace to make messaging even more engaging and fun
* Make memories during video calls with family and friends in Kinzoo Messenger 
AGE-INCLUSIVE DESIGN
* Safer self-expression: free from the pressures of likes, comments and follower counts
* Text, emoji, picture, audio and video: many ways to communicate for all ages
* No phone number or data plan necessary: all that's required is a device and WiFi connection
SAFE AND PRIVATE
* Your data belongs to you: Kinzoo is not an advertising engine and will never sell your data
* Control family contacts: parents approve all connections before anyone can exchange messages
* Unique invitation system: profiles are not publicly searchable, keeping information private
MADE FOR FAMILIES
* Works on iPhone and other smartphones: include family and friends on different devices
* No scheduling required: easily share one-on-one or group messages at your convenience
* Easy-to-use interface: made for the whole family—cousins, aunts, uncles and great-grandparents!
HOW KINZOO IS DIFFERENT
We believe that everyone deserves to experience the best of technology—without exposure to the worst of it. Instead of prioritizing growth at all costs, we're avoiding manipulative design and building Kinzoo from the ground up with ethical principles. We want families to feel confident and excited about their technology, so we're building experiences that spark connection and bring families together. If you'd like to learn more, visit us at kinzoo.com.
We'd love to hear feedback from families to help us refine the app! And, if you have any questions or concerns, we're always happy to help at:
hello@kinzoo.com

A safe messenger for kids and families. Secure chats, video calls, mini games, stickers and more—all in a COPPA-certified app designed for family connection.

SCREEN TIME WELL SPENT

* Technology designed around our Three C's: connection, creativity and cultivation

* Interactive stories, podcasts and activities in the Paths Center enhance your messaging experience

* Buy in-chat mini games, photo and video filters and sticker packs in the Marketplace to make messaging even more engaging and fun

* Make memories during video calls with family and friends in Kinzoo Messenger 


AGE-INCLUSIVE DESIGN

* Safer self-expression: free from the pressures of likes, comments and follower counts

* Text, emoji, picture, audio and video: many ways to communicate for all ages

* No phone number or data plan necessary: all that's required is a device and WiFi connection


SAFE AND PRIVATE

* Your data belongs to you: Kinzoo is not an advertising engine and will never sell your data

* Control family contacts: parents approve all connections before anyone can exchange messages

* Unique invitation system: profiles are not publicly searchable, keeping information private


MADE FOR FAMILIES

* Works on iPhone and other smartphones: include family and friends on different devices

* No scheduling required: easily share one-on-one or group messages at your convenience

* Easy-to-use interface: made for the whole family—cousins, aunts, uncles and great-grandparents!


HOW KINZOO IS DIFFERENT

We believe that everyone deserves to experience the best of technology—without exposure to the worst of it. Instead of prioritizing growth at all costs, we're avoiding manipulative design and building Kinzoo from the ground up with ethical principles. We want families to feel confident and excited about their technology, so we're building experiences that spark connection and bring families together. If you'd like to learn more, visit us at kinzoo.com.




We'd love to hear feedback from families to help us refine the app! And, if you have any questions or concerns, we're always happy to help at:
hello@kinzoo.com

bluejetty:00089168:ios.description:
"BestNote" is a memo pad application aimed at the highest.
As a characteristic feature of "BestNote", the memo creation page is divided into three tabs.
It is "memo" "remarks" "history".
"Memo" tab is the same function as normal memo pad.
"Remarks" "History" is a feature of this application's commitment.
In the "Remarks" tab, there is another character input field in addition to the memo, so you can use it in various ways, such as writing a simple draft when writing a note or using it as a remarks column.
In addition, it is also possible to attach images on the "Remarks" tab, and it is possible to use it beyond the frame of Notepad depending on the ingenuity.
Although it is the "history" tab, contents written in the "memo" tab are accumulated in the history as the name does. (It will be written to the history when you press save button on memo page)
With this function, it is possible to recover promptly even in unforeseen circumstances such as mistakenly editing important information accidentally.
In addition to the security lock password function.
Various functions such as folder division function to make memo easier to manage are carried.
Please try downloading it once by all means.

bluejetty:00129610:ios.description:

CLUSTERDUCK is about hatching as many ducks as possible. As more ducks hatch, the more strange things happen. The ducks begin to genetically mutate! •Mutations come in common, rare, epic, and legendary rarities!
•Witty duck descriptions introduce you to the personality quirks of each duck
•Discover the secrets of *the hole*
•Appease the duck gods by competing in Duck-Off talent contests

bluejetty:00068251:ios.description:
Dogs are our best friends, they bring so much fun, happiness and even moving stories to us in our daily life. 
Dog Buddy is a must have app for dog owners, which is available for iPhone/iPod Touch, you can write your dogs’ diaries, record the milestones of your dog and add the picture as souvenir, track your dogs’ weight, save your dog pictures, and track your dog’s veterinary, medications, vaccinations, allergies and other information relevant with your dogs. ⁃ Write dairies for your dog.
⁃ Record milestones of your dog, birth, grow new teeth, fall in love etc, and you can also add photo on this module as souvenir. 
⁃ Track your dog’s weight (kg or lbs).
⁃ Store your dogs’ photos as her personal album.

⁃ Track your dogs’ vaccine info.
⁃ Track your dogs’ allergies info. 
⁃ Edit other info you wish to store to your dog.
⁃ Dog first aid instruction lists.
⁃ Adds reminders for vaccine. 
⁃ Supports WiFi Backup & Restore. 
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup & restore.
⁃ Supports export data by email. 
⁃ Supports both iPhone and iPad.

Kivvi: Your AI Companion for Emotional Growth
Meet Kivvi, your 3D AI companion — a bunny with a big heart, ready to guide you through your emotional journey. She’s not just a horoscope bot. Kivvi is a unique, character-driven companion who offers real-time conversations, personalized insights, and emotional support.
Whether you’re looking for guidance in relationships, exploring your emotions, or just need someone to talk to, Kivvi is here to listen, reflect, and help you grow — as a friend, not just a source of information.
Key Features:
- Personalized Daily Letters from Kivvi
 Receive a heartwarming letter from Kivvi each day, offering insights and connect with you emotionally to create meaningful reflections.
- Real-Time AI Chat & Video Conversations
 Engage with Kivvi anytime through text or live video chat. Share your thoughts, ask for advice, or simply enjoy a warm conversation with your AI companion who’s always there to listen.
- Emotional Compatibility Insights
 Explore your connections with others through Kivvi’s emotional and intuitive compatibility readings. She compares multiple features and traits to help you understand your relationships better, but with a focus on emotional connection and growth.
- Personal Growth & Reflection
 Kivvi is more than just an AI — she’s a compassionate friend who helps you explore your emotions and discover your strengths. Through gentle, judgment-free conversations, Kivvi helps you better understand your inner world and guide your personal development.
How It Works:
1. Start chatting with Kivvi — via text or video.
2. Share your thoughts or ask for guidance on love, life, or compatibility.
3. Receive your personalized daily letter and emotional insights.
4. Build a deep emotional connection with Kivvi over time, supporting your growth and reflection.
Use Kivvi to:
- Reflect on your feelings and daily life with your AI companion.
- Get personalized emotional insights and guidance.
- Explore compatibility with friends, family, or potential partners.
- Experience a deep emotional connection with Kivvi — your AI companion who helps you grow.

 - Features of your deep conscious to enhance emotional insights

bluejetty:00084749:ios.name: Truck Transport Simulator !
bluejetty:00084749:ios.summary:
Welcome to Truck Transport Simulator, the ultimate trucking adventure where you’re not just driving a truck—you’re building your very own transport empire! 
Start Small, Dream Big Begin your journey as a rookie truck driver with a single f
bluejetty:00084749:ios.description:
Welcome to Truck Transport Simulator, the ultimate trucking adventure where you’re not just driving a truck—you’re building your very own transport empire! 
Start Small, Dream Big Begin your journey as a rookie truck driver with a single flatbed trailer, hauling shiny new cars from point A to point B. Feel the thrill of the open road and the satisfaction of a job well done as you make your first earnings.
Expand Your Fleet With each successful delivery, your wallet grows, allowing you to purchase additional trailers. Soon, you'll be juggling multiple loads of everything from sleek cars to hefty barrels of wood, stacks of supermarket goods, piles of sand, and much more. The more trailers you own, the more diverse your cargo becomes!
Upgrade and Dominate As your fleet expands, so does the need for a more powerful truck. Upgrade your vehicle to handle the increasing weight and complexity of your shipments. Enhance your earnings with strategic upgrades, ensuring that every delivery is more profitable than the last. It’s all about balancing your fleet’s power with your expanding cargo!
Beautifully Crafted Levels Immerse yourself in stunning, meticulously designed landscapes that make every level a visual treat. Whether you're cruising through bustling cityscapes, serene countryside, or rugged mountain roads, each environment is crafted to provide a relaxing and enjoyable experience.
Relax and Unwind At Truck Transport Simulator, we believe in making gameplay a soothing escape. Enjoy the calming scenery, smooth driving mechanics, and the gentle hum of your engine as you navigate through increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or enjoying a leisurely gaming session.
Level Up Your Transport Game Complete deliveries to advance through levels, each introducing new challenges and exciting transport missions. From simple hauls to complex logistics puzzles, keep your trucking skills sharp and your strategy on point.
Key Features:
- Manage and Expand Your Fleet: Start with one trailer and grow to a vast collection of specialized trailers.
- Upgrade Your Truck: Boost your truck’s power and efficiency to handle bigger and better loads.
- Diverse Cargo: Transport a wide variety of goods, each requiring different strategies and trailers.
- Stunning Visuals: Enjoy beautifully designed levels that provide a relaxing and immersive experience.
- Strategic Earnings: Invest in upgrades that increase your profits and optimize your transport operations.
- Progressive Levels: Tackle increasingly challenging missions as you advance through the game.
Whether you’re a seasoned simulator fan or new to the genre, Truck Transport Simulator offers a perfect blend of strategy, management, and relaxing gameplay. Hit the road, deliver those goods, and watch your trucking empire grow!
Download now and start your journey to becoming the ultimate truck transport tycoon!

bluejetty:00152294:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00152294:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Poke Pet Farm, a relaxing and heartwarming pet farming simulation game where you can collect, raise, and care for hundreds of cute pets.
Start your adventure on a mysterious island, build your dream farm, and create a thriving paradise for your adorable companions!
Build Your Dream Pet Farm
Your journey begins on a lush, deserted island full of possibilities.
Use your creativity to design and expand your own pet farm from the ground up.
Gather natural materials, grow crops, and build homes for your pets — from simple shelters to beautiful cottages.
Upgrade buildings, unlock new areas, and create a balanced ecosystem where pets and nature thrive together.
Harvest crops, process materials, and craft tools to improve your farm.
Decorate freely and customize your farm to reflect your unique style.
Your pets will live, work, and grow in the environment you create, making your farm a lively and productive paradise.
Collect and Raise Adorable Pets
Explore every corner of your island to discover dozens of unique pets — each with its own personality, abilities, and behaviors.
Catch wild pets, hatch eggs, and welcome new friends to your farm family.
Feed them, train them, and evolve them into stronger and cuter forms.
Some pets are hardworking gatherers, others are explorers, and a few are natural-born fighters ready for adventure.
Build strong bonds with your pets and watch them grow as loyal companions throughout your journey.
Resource Gathering and Production
Your pets aren’t just companions — they’re your helpers!
Send them to forests, caves, lakes, and mountains to gather wood, minerals, herbs, and other resources.
Process raw materials in workshops to create building supplies, food, and medicine.
Upgrade production chains to improve efficiency and automate your farm’s workflow.
Even when offline, your farm continues to produce resources and generate rewards.
Battle and Compete with Other Players
Some pets are born to battle!
Train your strongest pets and challenge other players in arenas, tournaments, or global events.
Strategically deploy your pets’ skills to climb the rankings and earn exclusive rewards.
Show off your island, share resources, and compete with players around the world.
Relax, Create, and Enjoy
Enjoy peaceful island life with beautiful visuals, soothing music, and endless creativity.
Whether you love idle games, pet care simulators, or farming adventures, Idle Pocket Pet Farm offers a perfect mix of fun and relaxation.
Customize your farm, decorate freely, and watch your pets thrive in a magical paradise.
Offline mode lets you continue progressing even when you’re away, so your island never stops growing.
Start Your Adventure Today
Enter the world of Idle Poke Pet Farm and become the ultimate Pet Farm Master!
Build your island, raise adorable pets, gather resources, and create a paradise full of joy and life.
Your pets are waiting — start your new adventure now!

bluejetty:00149288:ios.name: Watcher of Realms - US
bluejetty:00149288:ios.summary: Embark on an unparalleled Next-Gen Fantasy RPG adventure with Watcher of Realms. In the fabled Land of Tya, collect over 170 heroes from 10 different factions, strengthen and build out your own dedicated lineup, power through a vast array o
bluejetty:00149288:ios.description:
Embark on an unparalleled Next-Gen Fantasy RPG adventure with Watcher of Realms. In the fabled Land of Tya, collect over 170 heroes from 10 different factions, strengthen and build out your own dedicated lineup, power through a vast array of levels and stages, and leave behind your own legacy along the way.
Enjoy some of your favorite RPG elements in Watcher of Realms!
1. Experience 170+ heroes to collect and upgrade! 
Unlock and upgrade 170+ heroes from 10 factions, assemble your own powerful lineup, and combat the onslaught of monsters and demons!
You'll also find rare Lord Heroes with exclusive Lord Skills. Collect these to buff the entire faction!
2. More exciting BOSS battles.
Epic Dragons, Mighty Golems, The Undying Bull, The Lord of Styx, The Conquerer, and many Bosses are ready to throw down the gauntlet! Take on these formidable foes in Guild Boss, Void Rift, Immortal Codex and other modes to claim your stake of Tya's finest treasure.
3. Refreshingly diverse RPG elements.
Obtain rare resources from dungeon levels where gruesome monsters await. Strengthen and improve your hero’s attributes by collecting gear, artifacts, and legendary skill dust to get the edge.
Reinforce your camp and explore multiple game modes while leading your heroes to ultimate victory on the grandest battlefield of all.
4. User friendly and deeply strategic gameplay. 
The diverse continent of Tya includes vast deserts, chilling dungeons, colossal mountains and more. With each stage posing new challenges, commanders must choose the best faction and hero combinations to survive. Charge into battle with your fearless heroes and activate their ultimate skills, AOE/magic damage, and healing spells with precision timing to defend your position!
5. High-quality audio-visual effects. Incredibly immersive.
Realistically magical 3D models of heroes fleshed with exquisite details. Top-tier motion and facial capture technologies make your heroes incredibly vivid and lifelike.
With premium CG and character designs in 360°, players will fall in love with customized animations which bring each hero to life.
6. Massive multiplayer PvP battles.
Original tower defense PvP mode will showcase your skills. With multiple PvP themes, you can climb player rankings and fight your way straight to the top!
7. Grand worldview, rich storylines.
Explore a range of chapters, maps, and levels. Epic faction and hero lore will provide you an immersive experience into the world of Tya’s magic. Each hero has a unique backstory waiting for you to discover!
Please Note:
*Watcher of Realms supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, and Russian. We understand that RPGs are always more immersive to players in their native languages, so we are working hard on adding more languages to the game!
Official Website: https://us.skystone.games/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WatcherofRealms/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Vn8UpGF
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@WatcherofRealmsOfficial
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/WatcherofRealmsGame/

bluejetty:00094209:ios.name: Outdoor Afro
bluejetty:00094209:ios.summary:
We are all connected to nature in cultural, spiritual, social, and biological ways. The Outdoor Afro App provides connection between Black nature leaders and nature lovers—and
everyone who loves connecting with people who love nature.
Much
bluejetty:00094209:ios.description:
We are all connected to nature in cultural, spiritual, social, and biological ways. The Outdoor Afro App provides connection between Black nature leaders and nature lovers—and
everyone who loves connecting with people who love nature.
Much more than a trails app, Outdoor Afro lets you discover vetted, local nature spots, trails, and destinations for all of your favorite sports, play, lifestyle, wellness, and exercise activities.
Our mission is to inspire and support Black connection, leadership, and wellness in nature, so we’ve made it easy to find your fit in outdoor activities—on your own or with expert guides
and enthusiasts who share their recommended spots and expertise, lead guided experiences, and become part of your community.
Outdoor Afro rewards its most active users with gear, badges and even old school patches and badges, free and discounted gear and other goodies. Use Outdoor Afro to:
• Join expert-guided adventures and experiences near you
• Discover and navigate new trails, campsites, and other destinations with GPS maps
• Explore fun, safe, vetted spots for any activity—for you, friends, family, and pets
• Follow your favorite guides to get their latest recommended spots—and share your own
• Plan and build adventures and trips of your own
• Connect with people who love the activities/interests you love
• Earn patches and badges—and discounted and free gear and goodies
• Learn from the experts and get certified
• Track your outdoor adventures and time outside
And because we’re committed to strengthening Black connections to nature and protecting the nature spaces you love, you’ll also find:
• Videos and other content about Black pioneers and innovators who’ve “walked the trails" before you
• Civic leaders and organizations that can help preserve and conserve your local public lands, waterways, and wildlife

bluejetty:00024206:ios.name: Call Ranger: Phone Blocker
bluejetty:00024206:ios.summary:
Block entire area codes, country codes, or any phone number range with Call Ranger!
Instead of blocking spam numbers one by one, create a single rule that covers a whole range. Choose how many of the last digits to replace with X, and ever
bluejetty:00024206:ios.description:
Block entire area codes, country codes, or any phone number range with Call Ranger!
Instead of blocking spam numbers one by one, create a single rule that covers a whole range. Choose how many of the last digits to replace with X, and every matching call and message is blocked. One rule can cover up to 10 billion numbers!
GLOBAL EXAMPLES:
• US: "+1 415 XXX XXXX" → blocks +1 415 000 0000 to +1 415 999 9999
• China: "+86 10 XXXX XXXX" → blocks +86 10 0000 0000 to +86 10 9999 9999
• Japan: "+81 3 XXXX XXXX" → blocks +81 3 0000 0000 to +81 3 9999 9999
• South Korea: "+82 70 XXXX XXXX" → blocks +82 70 0000 0000 to +82 70 9999 9999
+ Works with all countries worldwide
KEY FEATURES:
• NO registration
• NO subscription
• NO extra fees
• Blocks both phone calls and text messages
• Create unlimited blocking rules
• Privacy assured - all data stays on your device
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Enable Call Ranger in iOS Settings: Phone → Call Blocking & Identification
2. Enable Call Ranger in iOS Settings → Messages → Text Message Filter
3. Tap the "i" button next to a missed call → "Share Contact" → "Block similar numbers" → Select how many digits to block (up to 10 digits!) and you're all set!
PRIVACY ASSURED:
All data and blocking rules stay on your device. Call Ranger does not access or store your personal information.

bluejetty:00096681:ios.description:
Step into a doomsday survival shooting adventure across the wasteland, where endless ravenous waves of zombies await covetously. Defend your homeland, fight your way through a post-apocalyptic nightmare, and hone your zombie-slaying and booming skills. Upgrade powerful weapons, unlock survivor abilities, and face the undead zombies with precise shooting and clever strategy to stop the zombie invasion. 
Stand as the last beacon of hope for humanity in this ultimate zombie game.
▼Fun Features of This Roguelike Zombie Shooting Game▼
Diverse Battlefields
 -- Filled with thrilling zombie encounters, the immersive battlefields and varied stages bring you nonstop zombie shooting thrills. 
Flexible Combinations
 -- With rich skills, ultimate abilities, and roguelike skill synergy, combine weapons, heroes, drones, and gears. 
Hands-free Battles
 -- Enjoy effortless one-handed controls and smooth auto-aim precision. Whether in short quick play sessions or idle gameplay with AFK mechanics.
▼Strategy Tips For Survivors▼
Choose the Right Zombie Shooting Skills
-- Each weapon comes with unique traits. Arm up with the right gun, mow down zombie hordes, and strengthen your arsenal for dominance.
Equip Weapons with Suitable Attachments
-- Each attachment offers different attributes. Maximize strengths, cover weaknesses, and use clever combat strategies to crush the undead zombies.
Deploy Drones and Robot Companions
-- Equip drones or robot sidekicks to unleash heavy firepower, suppress enemies, and achieve spectacular combat effects like full-screen eliminations.
Collect Diverse Heroes
-- Unity is strength. Recruit and unite unique heroes in your squad and embrace survival as a team.
Our Community:

Facebook Fan Group: @Zombie Roguebie
Discord: https://discord.gg/7eEZ3BSY6K
Customer Service: zombieroguebie@metajoy.io
If you need any help during gaming, you can also email us at help@metajoy.io or contact us through the in-game support channel.

bluejetty:00017286:ios.name: Tile Craft - Triple Crush
bluejetty:00017286:ios.summary:
Looking for a relaxing game to unwind and train your brain? Welcome to your new zen puzzle escape!
This is a classic tile-matching game that perfectly blends the strategic fun of Mahjong with the satisfying mechanics of Match-3. Take a bre
bluejetty:00017286:ios.description:
Looking for a relaxing game to unwind and train your brain? Welcome to your new zen puzzle escape!
This is a classic tile-matching game that perfectly blends the strategic fun of Mahjong with the satisfying mechanics of Match-3. Take a break from your busy day, clear your mind, and immerse yourself in the calming world of tile pairing. Whether you want to kill time on your commute or relax before bed, this game has you covered.
How to Play:
The rules are incredibly simple but require a sharp mind:
Tap the tiles on the board to move them into the collection box at the bottom of the screen.
Whenever you collect three identical tiles in the box, they will automatically match and disappear.
Clear all the tiles on the board to complete the level and win rewards!
Be careful: the collection box can only hold a maximum of 7 tiles. If it fills up completely without a match, the game is over. Plan your moves wisely and think one step ahead.
Key Features:
Zen and Relaxing Experience: Beautiful graphics and soothing background music create a stress-free environment for you to truly relax.
Train Your Brain: Thousands of well-designed levels that gradually increase in difficulty, perfect for boosting your logic, memory, and focus.
Customize Your Journey: Progress through the game to unlock stunning new landscape backgrounds and unique tile sets to personalize your experience.
Play Anytime, Anywhere: 100% offline support! No Wi-Fi or internet connection is required. Enjoy your daily puzzle break wherever you go.
For All Ages: Easy to learn but hard to master, making it a great brain teaser for puzzle lovers of all ages.
Take a few minutes every day to boost your brainpower and find your inner peace. Download now, match the tiles, and become the ultimate tile craft master!

bluejetty:00035462:ios.description:
SimplyWise Cost Estimator is a mobile construction estimating app that turns job site photos into detailed, professional estimates in seconds. Powered by AI, it breaks down every project into material and labor costs, generates polished bids you can send on the spot, and even suggests upsells to increase your revenue. Trusted by 10,000+ contractors with a 4.8-star rating.
Stop guessing on project costs. Whether you need a construction estimate for a kitchen renovation, a roofing job, or a full home remodel, SimplyWise is the fastest way to create accurate contractor estimates and send them to clients right from the job site.
KEY FEATURES
 • AI-Powered Estimates — Snap a photo and get a detailed cost breakdown with materials and labor in seconds
 • Before & After Visualization — Show clients exactly what their renovation will look like with AI-generated renderings
 • 3D Room Scanning — Use your phone's LIDAR to capture accurate room measurements
 • Professional Bid Creation — Generate and send polished, branded estimates as PDF
 • Smart Upsell Suggestions — AI recommends upgrades and add-ons to increase your job value and profit margins
 • Built-In Markups — Automatically apply your profit margins and overhead to every estimate
 • Invoicing — Bill clients directly from the app once the job is done
 • Work Order Management — Track every project from estimate to completion
 • Project Organization — Keep estimates organized by room, job type, or client in custom folders
WHO IS SIMPLYWISE COST ESTIMATOR BEST FOR?
SimplyWise is the best construction estimating app for professionals who need fast, accurate estimates without complex enterprise software:
 • General Contractors managing renovation and building projects
 • Roofers and Siding Contractors pricing jobs on-site
 • Remodeling Contractors estimating kitchen, bath, and home renovation work
 • Painters and Flooring Specialists creating material and labor breakdowns
 • Plumbers quoting residential and commercial jobs
 • Small Construction Business Owners who want professional bids without the overhead
WHY CONTRACTORS CHOOSE SIMPLYWISE
Unlike spreadsheets or desktop construction estimating software that takes weeks to learn, SimplyWise lets you create professional estimates in minutes right from your phone:
 • Photo to Estimate: No manual data entry. Point, shoot, get your cost estimate
 • Win More Jobs: Before/after visualizations help clients say yes faster
 • Increase Revenue: AI-powered upsell suggestions find add-on opportunities you might miss
 • Work From Anywhere: Create and send estimates from the job site, no office required
 • Save Hours Every Week: Automate the estimating process so you can focus on the work that pays
WHAT YOU CAN ESTIMATE
SimplyWise handles cost estimation for all types of construction and renovation projects:
 • Kitchen and bathroom renovations
 • Roofing and siding
 • Interior and exterior painting
 • Flooring installation and repair
 • Plumbing work
 • Fencing and decking
 • General home remodeling and renovation
 • New construction and building projects
 • Demolition and cleanup
WHAT CONTRACTORS ARE SAYING
"SimplyWise has transformed the way I manage my construction projects. It's even helped me improve my profit margins by automating markups. I love how easy it is to generate
professional bids — honestly, I couldn't run my business without it." — Jennifer M., General Contractor
"As a small business owner, SimplyWise has been a lifesaver! I can instantly generate estimates and bids on-site and send them to clients in minutes. It's made managing multiple
projects so much easier and saved me countless hours." — Alex R., Roofer
To learn more, visit our Terms of Service at https://www.simplywise.com/terms.

bluejetty:00040504:ios.description:
Discover a personal journey to motherhood with Femia and become a confident and happy mother at any age. 
GET PREGNANT FASTER
• Femia helps you get pregnant as soon as naturally possible for you.
• Receive daily recommendations to optimize your body for pregnancy. 
• Our plans are designed to help you remove fertility blocks in less than 3 months. 
• Suitable for women with irregular cycles and perimenopause.
FOLLOW YOU BABY DEVELOPMENT IN 3D
• Stay connected to every exciting milestone of your baby development.
• Explore baby’s new abilities & size changes with beautifully crafted interactive 3D model.
• Track your health & moods to understand your body changes. 
• Get credible expert advice for every pregnancy week.
TRACK YOUR HEALTH AND STAY IN CONTROL
• Femia health tracking gives you full control of your wellbeing at any stage of your life. 
• Advanced algorithms detect your unique cycle-related rhythms and body patterns. 
• Daily health tips tailored to your personal health profile. 
• Get access to you monthly health reports with cycle charts and symptoms patterns. 
YOUR PERSONAL HEALTH ASSISTANT AVAILABLE 24/7
• A virtual health dialog will get you covered with proactive health information based our your health logs. 
• A huge set of medically validated topics to discuss and expand your knowledge of yourself. 
• Ask your questions and get answers 24/7. 
• Femia content is created and peer-reviewed by 20+ medical experts
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
You can download the app for free and use limited functionality without payment. If you’d like to have a personalised experience and unlimited experience with the app, you will need a subscription.  Please note that:
• When opting for a subscription, you pay the fixed price for your country, which is displayed in the app.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account upon confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews and free trial automatically converts into subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
• When canceling a subscription or a free trial, your subscription/free trial will stay active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
• In addition to the purchased subscription, we may offer you add-on items (e.g. well-being guides) for an additional fee, either one-off or recurrent. This purchase is optional: your subscription is not conditional on such a purchase. All such offers will be displayed in the app.
Privacy Policy: https://femia.io/policy/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https: //femia.io/policy/terms-of-use.html
The app is not a diagnostic tool and should not be used as a form of contraception. We strongly advise you to seek a doctor’s consultation before making any medical decisions.
Contact us via support@femia.io

bluejetty:00015099:ios.name: Chinese Writer by trainchinese
bluejetty:00015099:ios.summary:
Learn to write thousands of Chinese characters — it's educational, fun, and addictive!
The characters fall from the top of the screen — touch them and draw them correctly to score points. But don't let them reach the bottom, or else — boom
bluejetty:00015099:ios.description:
Learn to write thousands of Chinese characters — it's educational, fun, and addictive!
The characters fall from the top of the screen — touch them and draw them correctly to score points. But don't let them reach the bottom, or else — boom! Three mistakes and the game is over, but the learning continues: you can review everything you've seen, with stroke order diagrams, and practise at your own pace. The characters you made the most mistakes on are highlighted at the top of the list.
» It's much more than a game!
- trainchinese Chinese Writer can test you on over 5,000 simplified and traditional Chinese characters, and offers stroke order diagrams, English explanations, and high quality audio recordings for every pronunciation of every character.
- The app remembers which characters you struggled to write and prioritises them in following games.
» It's for everyone!
- Characters are grouped into packs by difficulty level according to the official HSK standard. Hundreds are included in this free download.
- Create your own packs by searching for characters by Pinyin. You can even combine Pinyin, English and Chinese characters in a single search to get maximum results, and add them all to your custom pack with a single swipe.
- Your children can play. Your grandparents can too. Everyone can now enjoy the fun of learning this beautiful writing system.
- Whatever your level, you'll make progress with trainchinese Chinese Writer. Beginners can start with simpler characters at a slower pace, while experienced students will be blazing through HSK 4 characters at full speed!
» It's connected!
- Create your own character packs and share them with your friends by email.
- Proud of your score? Share it with your friends on Twitter and Facebook.
- Already a trainchinese user? Download the characters you're learning in trainchinese Chinese Writer for free!
Learn to write Chinese characters with trainchinese Chinese Writer. It's educational, fun — and addictive!
» We'd love to hear your feedback about Chinese Writer. Contact us any time at cs@trainchinese.com!

bluejetty:00186660:ios.summary:
Flashcards by NKO is an engaging educational solution for students and teachers worldwide.
Looking for a powerful and easy-to-use flashcards app to help you study? This app allows you to create rich text formatted flashcards with pictures
bluejetty:00186660:ios.description:
Flashcards by NKO is an engaging educational solution for students and teachers worldwide.
Looking for a powerful and easy-to-use flashcards app to help you study? This app allows you to create rich text formatted flashcards with pictures and download millions of flashcards on hundreds of subjects created by both experts and novices.
Matching, True/False, Memory, Spelling, Q-Battle, Word Search, Flow, Flappy Dog, Dig It Up, 2048, Ninja, Bingo, Q-Battle LMP, Blocks, and Letters games add more fun to your studying. Don't be surprised to find yourself playing games, getting badges and beating highscores of your friends or classmates rather than simply flipping flash cards... :) Not enough? Loci will turn your cards into a 3D Memory Palace that exploits a memory technique of ancient Greeks and memory champions. Moreover you will immerse ing an augment reality realm in Defender game
All tools and games are connected to a sophisticated Spaced Repetition System (SRS) that tracks your progress and keep you organized.
- 2.5 millions downloads
- used in classrooms and schools worldwide.
FROM TEACHERS:
"I saw a big improvement in the most recent test scores which, I believe, can be partially attributed to their use of the Flashcards app."
"everything you ever wanted to do with flashcards and then some. Supports individualized and differentiated learning in the classroom."
"I'm a high school English teacher who loves your app! I kept seeing my students using it, and I checked the app store a couple of times looking for it. I finally took a good look, and I realized they were creating fabulous decks beyond what I was seeing in the bare apps available. The features of your app are rich and so intuitive!"
APP FEATURES
- Create your own flash cards with rich text formatting and images
- Download millions of flashcards made by other users
- Organize your cards into folders
- Share your decks with friends using shared (automatically synchronized) folders, email or iTunes.
- Keep track of your progress for each deck and each card
- Spaced Repetition System
- Manual and Slide show modes
- Linear/Adaptive/Shuffle mode to enhance retention
- 5 tools (Review, Explore, Quiz, Listen, and Collage).
- 16 studying/testing games (Matching, Memory, True/False, Spelling, Words, Q-Battle, Flow, Flappy, Dig It Up, Ninja, 2048, Bingo, Q-Battle MP, Blocks, Letters, Loci)
- 6 built-in keyboards (rich text formatting, fast edit, maths symbols, chemistry symbols, Fonts, and Greek letters) and support of custom keyboards.
- Combine or split decks
- Sorting flashcards
- Import decks in txt, csv, or tsv formats
- a drawing tool
- 36 built-in text-to-speech voices that work offline + 40+ additional voices from iSpeech.
- color coding
- no distracting ads
FOR TEACHERS:
- the only flashcard app with a full-fledged class management system
- classes, leaderboards, a lot of games!
- students' folders for personalized learning
- teacher's messages
- statistics in detail: who reviewed what, when, for how long, what tools and games are used. Printable reports.
- multiplayer games
---------------------
In addition to the life-time Individual Edition, Teacher Pro, and Educational Editions, the application also offers Individual Edition auto-renewal Subscriptions for 1 month ($1.99/month in the U.S. App Store) and 1 year ($9.99/year in the U.S. App Store). Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal Subscriptions automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. You can read about our Privacy Policy (http://nkoapps.com/privacy) and Terms of Use (https://nkoapps.com/terms_of_use) on our website.

bluejetty:00131405:ios.description:
Vestiaire Collective: Buy, Sell & Consign Designer Fashion
Join the global community redefining luxury resale. With Vestiaire Collective, you can buy, sell, or consign authenticated designer pieces — from iconic bags and footwear to rare vintage finds, clothing, accessories, and watches.
Each week we list thousands of new items from top labels like Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Dior, Burberry, Fendi, Balenciaga, Saint Laurent, and more — including exclusive collaborations via our Brand Partner program.
Why buy with Vestiaire Collective?
- Discover unique fashion and vintage finds you won’t see elsewhere.
- Shop authenticated designer bags, clothing, shoes, and accessories — every piece is verified through our multi-step digital + human authentication process.
- Browse Brand Approved listings: items jointly approved with luxury brands for added trust and provenance.
- Negotiate directly with sellers or choose interest-free payment options.
- Support circular fashion and sustainable style.
Why sell or consign on Vestiaire Collective?
- Reach a curated global audience of fashion lovers ready to buy designer and vintage pieces.
- Consignment service: we manage everything — from photos and descriptions to pricing, storage, and shipping — so you can sell hands-free.
- Get up to 80-85 % of the final price on consigned items, with no upfront fees.
- List directly too: upload your item, ship for free, and we authenticate before shipping to buyer.
- Free prepaid shipping labels, secure transactions, and fast payment once your item passes authentication.
- Even luxury brands partner with us: Brand Approved allows brands to authorize resale of their pieces via Vestiaire, enhancing trust and resale value.
- Our authentication team trains with major brands and receives support from them to ensure rigorous standards.
A trusted, sustainable fashion movement
Vestiaire Collective is more than a marketplace — it’s a movement built on trust, curation, and circular fashion. We’re pioneers in authentication, verifying via digital and expert human checks to stay ahead of counterfeiters.
Whether you’re browsing for that statement vintage Hermès bag or consigning a Saint Laurent jacket, join millions of fashion activists shaping the future of style.
Download Vestiaire Collective and start buying, selling, or consigning designer fashion with confidence — your next luxury item or sale is just a tap away.
From vintage treasures to modern designers — experience the smarter way to shop and sell luxury.

The Belleville News Democrat local newspaper is your trusted source for local, daily journalism serving the Belleville area. Our newsroom delivers reporting on local government, public safety, education, courts, business, and community issues affecting residents across Belleville and nearby Illinois communities, alongside statewide coverage and national headline news.
LOCAL NEWS
• Daily local news and stories from Belleville, Fairview Heights, and the East St. Louis area

• The Belleville News Democrat local newspaper opinions, editorials and columns you love

• View stunning photos and videos of local news and community events
LOCAL SPORTS
• Full coverage reporting on local, pro and college sports teams
• Stay connected to your favorite teams and favorite sports writers
PERSONALIZATION
• Stay informed on the topics and articles that matter to you
• Favorite topics to get personalized feeds. • Search for news articles, videos, games and more

Other Features
• Browse articles by category
• Share articles on Facebook, X Twitter or by email
• Comment on news articles
• Access and download previous issues of our newspaper
• Recharge and unwind with our puzzles and games

Linkage control, easy to use
We want you to experience a smarter and more portable lifestyle. The app is simple to operate and you can quickly add a variety of home appliances while performing linkage operations to interconnect smart devices.

Share your joy with just one-click 
We want to add more fun to your life. With simple one-click sharing, you can share your device with family and friends, manage it remotely, experience convenience, and enjoy the fun of science and technology together.

Connect to the Internet in no time
After connecting to your smart device, you can
(1) Start and pause your robot remotely
(2) View the cleaning map and understand the robot cleaning area
(3) Set the cleaning mode you want to track cleaning tasks

Download now and experience this house cleaning "beast" by Proscenic.

bluejetty:00014639:ios.name: Audio Recorder: Play & Cleaner
bluejetty:00014639:ios.summary:
Let's talk beyond recording—let's talk sound, clarity, and time!
Audio Recorder App is your all-in-one studio for capturing, enhancing, editing, and scheduling every important audio moment. Record podcasts, voice memos, concerts, meetings,
bluejetty:00014639:ios.description:
Let's talk beyond recording—let's talk sound, clarity, and time!
Audio Recorder App is your all-in-one studio for capturing, enhancing, editing, and scheduling every important audio moment. Record podcasts, voice memos, concerts, meetings, and lectures in crystal clarity. Remove background noise instantly, perfect each file with precise editing tools, and never miss a moment with built-in recording and playback reminders. Save to the cloud or transfer over Wi-Fi/FTP—the choice is yours.
# Record
* Unlimited length—tested up to 20 hours.
* Auto-resume after calls or interruptions.
* Continue into an existing file or start fresh.
* Silence detection with auto-pause and auto-resume.
* Adjustable input gain; Bluetooth mic support.
* One-tap restart or redo.
# Voice Enhancer — Instant Noise Removal
* Tap once to remove background noise. Tap again to hear the original. No processing. No waiting. It's instant.
* Perfect for noisy recordings — crowds, wind, hum, or echo — cleaned up in real time.
* Works directly during playback, so you hear the difference immediately.
# Reminders
* Recording Reminders – Schedule recordings ahead of time with flexible repeat options.
* Playback Reminders – Get reminded to review any file exactly when you need it.
* Manage, edit, or delete reminders anytime.
# Trim & Edit
* Trim – Keep only the parts you want.
* Erase – Remove unwanted sections instantly.
# Amplify
* Boost quiet recordings for louder, clearer playback.
# Transcribe (Offline)
* Convert speech to text using our free companion app "PDF Export" — no internet required.
# Formats & Quality
* Record in AIFF, WAV, CAF, or M4A.
* Low, Medium, High (CD), or Max (HD) quality.
* Bit depth: 16-bit, 24-bit, or 32-bit.
# Input & Output
* Works with built-in, Bluetooth, or external mics (Tascam iM2 supported).
* Quick switching between input and output devices.
# Recording Intervals
* Auto-stop after a preset time: 15, 30, 60 minutes, and more.
# Player
* Fast forward and rewind controls.
* Adjustable playback speed.
* Trim directly within the player.
* Continuous playback and stop timer.
* Works with Apple EarPods and Bluetooth devices.
# File Manager
* iCloud sync support.
* Copy, move, rename, delete, zip, and search files.
* Email multiple recordings at once.
* View detailed file info and sort by name, date, or size.
# Private & Secure
* Password-protected folder for sensitive recordings.
* App lock with passcode.
# Trash Management
* Deleted recordings go to Trash and can be restored anytime.
# Cloud Storage
* Upload to Dropbox, OneDrive, Box.net, SugarSync, Evernote, or WebDAV.
* Import from supported cloud services.
# Wi-Fi & FTP Sharing
* Access recordings from any browser on the same Wi-Fi network.
* Map a network drive for wireless file access via FTP.
# Themes
* Dark or Light mode — your pick.
# More Highlights
* Find recordings via iPhone Spotlight search.
* Quick actions with 3D Touch support.
Enjoying the app? A quick rating on the App Store means the world to us — it helps us keep improving for you. Thank you!

Learn American Sign Language (ASL) Anytime, Anywhere – Free and Easy!
ASLingo offers personalized beginner-friendly learning plans and interactive lessons, providing a comprehensive ASL curriculum tailored for all levels of learners. Learning ASL has never been more enjoyable and effective with ASLingo. Let’s dive into bite-sized, interactive lessons tailored for all levels of learners, and enhance your fluency in American Sign Language.
Features;
1. Personalized Learning Experience:
Dive into bite-sized, interactive lessons tailored for all levels of learners. Our immersive curriculum ensures practical conversation skills that you can apply in real-life scenarios.
2. Comprehensive ASL Curriculum:
- 23 in-depth units
- Over 103 video lessons
- More than 2000 signs and sentences
3. Interactive Learning Tools:
Reinforce your memory and refine your signing technique with our vocabulary trainer and sign mirror. Practice quizzes and skill retention activities make learning ASL enjoyable and effective.
4. Comprehensive ASL Dictionary:
Access a vast collection of signs and sentences through our user-friendly ASL dictionary. From basic gestures to complex expressions, ASLingo has you covered.
5. Enhance Your ASL Vocabulary:
Expand your vocabulary, improve daily communication, and break down language barriers with our robust dictionary and translation features.
6. Accessible Anytime, Anywhere:
Learn on your terms with easy accessibility from multiple devices. Our user-friendly interface requires no extensive prior knowledge, making ASLingo the perfect companion for learning on the go.
7. Subscription Benefits:
- Full access to all premium content
- Regular content updates
- Flexible subscription plans
All of the teachers at ASLingo are experts and passionate about teaching Sign Languages.
Our mission is to help you connect with Deaf family members, friends, colleagues, and neighbors. Start learning American Sign Language (ASL) with ASLingo today.

bluejetty:00062300:ios.description:
Little Thinking Minds is an award-winning and leading pioneer in the field of Arabic language learning for children ranging from PreK to 9. Our platforms provide learners and teachers with online engaging tools that assist learners in achieving expected learning outcomes. They contain large libraries of interactive content ranging from books, audiobooks, videos, and flashcards, to worksheets and games. Our platforms have been built in collaboration with leading academic experts in the field of Arabic language learning, and alignment with ACTFL (American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages).
We offer learners worldwide engaging, trusted, and proven tools to line up, provide teachers and parents with detailed reporting on each learner's activity and progress in learning Arabic on levels, allow teachers to assign homework and communicate with students, and measure learning outcomes acquisition throughout their usage.
I Start Arabic
An online platform designed to help non-native speakers master the Arabic language. The platform offers several levels divided into sub-levels that deal with practical daily issues and increase the cultural awareness of the learner. The platform contains attractive books, worksheets, and educational videos that are necessary for daily communication and interaction with cultural reality.
