bluejetty:00084607:ios.description:
Define your beauty with LOOX.
LOOX is a cool retouching tool that combines face shape finder, color analysis, AI video, hairstyle changer, trendy makeup and cool photo effects. Just unleash your imagination and create your unique works with LOOX!
What's hot in LOOX:
#Face Shape Finder: Discover Your Face Shape & Glow Up!
1) Snap a selfie.
2) Get a detailed analysis of your face shape, eyebrows, nose, skin tone, animal face type, celebrity lookalikes, and more.
3) Find your perfect hairstyles! Try on AI-recommended styles based on your face shape in real time.
4) Get expert glow-up tips: outfit suggestions, makeup advice, and grooming routines to level up your look.
#Color Analysis: Find Your Best Colors & Elevate Your Style!
1) Take or upload a photo in natural lighting.
2) AI analyzes your skin tone, hair, and eye color to determine your color season.
3) Discover your best and toxique color palettes to enhance your style. Try on 300+ colors across various clothing styles to see what truly suits you.
4) Get personalized makeup product, jewelry & accessory recommendations.
#FitCheck: Rate Your Outfit & Dress Smarter! 
Post your fit, get real-time AI style scores—color, silhouette, layering & more. Track your looks and get fresh tips to level up your vibe.
#Magic AI Video: Turn Your Photos into Stunning AI Videos!
Experience trending effects like superhero transformation, squish effect, curly haircut effect, photo dancing, aging transformation, anime styles, and more!
Animate any photo and create videos with one tap—effortless, fun, and magical!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Key features:
HAIR SALON
Explore 100+ trendy hairstyles filters and vibrant hair colors—transform your look instantly with just a few taps.
CARTOON PORTRAIT
Turn your photos into dreamy AI-generated cartoon art—whether it’s classic Ghibli-style magic or bold animation vibes. One tap and your ordinary pic becomes an eye-catching, animated masterpiece.
VIRTUAL MAKEUP
Try on daily and themed makeup looks like animal styles or festive vibes. Just a tap to glam up your look without the fuss.
AI PHOTO
The new AI photo function is launched, allowing you to easily take photo blockbusters without leaving home. There are many styles to choose from, including retro 90s yearbook, old money style, headshots, gym selfie, fashion street photography, snow scenes etc.
AI TRANSFORM
Ever wanted to make a change to a photo simply by describing it? Now you can. Highlight the area you want to modify, describe the change, then watch it happens! AI transform empowers you to change outfits, remove objects, and add elements with just a description.
Repair old/blurry/scratched photo
Make old photos reviving with just one click. AI-powered technology help you recolor black and white photos, turn blurred photos into high definition, and remove photo cracks with one click.
AGING PREDICTION
Don't you curious about how are you look like when you 80? Come and have a try.
Hope you enjoy it.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Subscription terms:
- Weekly subscription.
- Monthly subscription.
- Yearly subscription.
*Paid: After the free trial period ends, the iTunes account will be charged.
*Renewal: iTunes account will be deducted 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription period. After the renewal deduction
is successful, the subscription service will be extended by one subscription period.
*Cancel renewal: If you need to cancel the renewal after the purchase is successful, you need to manually turn off the automatic renewal
function in the iTunes/Apple ID setting management 24 hours before the current subscription expires. If the subscription is not closed at
least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, the subscription will be automatically renewed.
Terms of Use: http://resource.ifancybeauty.com/loox_ios/service.html
Privacy Policy: http://resource.ifancybeauty.com/loox_ios/privacy.html

bluejetty:00093863:ios.description:
O Urkout promove uma experiência com foco exclusivo na interação dos alunos através de um aplicativo completo e intuitivo que irá revolucionar o seu negócio fitness, seja ele academia, estúdio ou personal trainer.
- Retenção: Diminua a rotatividade de alunos através de um app focado na experiência do usuário.
- Engajamento: Mantenha os alunos cativados com notificações, pontuação, metas, personalização, etc.
- Interação: Tenha sua própria rede social, crie postagens e garanta que 100% dos alunos as verão.
- Atração: Divulgue-se instantaneamente para milhares de usuários do aplicativo e atraia novos alunos.
- Fidelidade: Retenha os alunos através de um sistema automático de pontuação e premiação.
- Notificação: Avise sobre novidades, resgate alunos inativos e chame a atenção através de notificações push.
- Independência: Fichas, treinos, exercícios, evolução, avaliações, motivação e muito mais na palma da mão dos alunos.
- Produtividade: Crie treinos predefinidos, calcule metas automaticamente, importe fichas e economize tempo.
- Avaliação: Faça anamneses, avaliações posturais e avaliações físicas através de diversos protocolos disponíveis.
- Exercícios: Cadastre quantos exercícios desejar e inclua suas próprias fotos e vídeos ou escolha vídeos demonstrativos da nossa base de dados.
- Agendamento: Possibilite agendamentos e check-ins e tenha controle total do histórico de presença nas aulas.
- Suporte: Qualquer dia, a qualquer hora. Time de suporte pronto para auxiliar no que for necessário 24 horas por dia.
- E muito mais: Satisfeitos sempre. Conformados jamais! Sempre buscando melhorias e lançando novidades.

bluejetty:00145455:ios.name: Paulmark
bluejetty:00145455:ios.summary:
Kadın, Erkek, Kız Çocuk, Erkek Çocuk ve Bebek Giyim modasına ulaşmak artık son derece kolay. Modayı sınırsız seçeneklerle ve erişilebilir fiyatlarla sunan Paulmark, güncellenen mobil uygulamasıyla sezon trendlerini cebinize taşıyor.
Paulmar
bluejetty:00145455:ios.description:
Kadın, Erkek, Kız Çocuk, Erkek Çocuk ve Bebek Giyim modasına ulaşmak artık son derece kolay. Modayı sınırsız seçeneklerle ve erişilebilir fiyatlarla sunan Paulmark, güncellenen mobil uygulamasıyla sezon trendlerini cebinize taşıyor.
Paulmark mobil uygulaması, her ihtiyaca hitap eden binlerce ürüne dilediğiniz mobil cihazdan kolayca erişim sağlamanıza ve güvenilir online alışveriş yapmanıza imkân tanır.
En yeni koleksiyonlar: Uygulama, Paulmark’ın en yeni koleksiyonlarını anında keşfetmenizi sağlar. Her mevsim için yeni kıyafetler ve aksesuarlar bulabilirsiniz.
Alışveriş, Paulmark uygulamasıyla çok daha kolay!
Güvenli, hızlı alışveriş ve hızlı teslimat, güncellenen Paulmark uygulamasının birinci önceliğidir.
 • Kredi Kartı ve banka kartı ile yapılan ödemelerde iyileştirmeler yaparak, farklı ve güvenli ödeme seçenekleri sunuyoruz, böylece alışverişlerinizi güvenle gerçekleştirebilirsiniz.
 • Anlaşılır, basit ve net bir kategori yapısı sayesinde aradığınız ürünlere hızlıca ulaşabilirsiniz.
 • Kullanıcı deneyimini artıran ve güçlendiren kadın, erkek, çocuk ve bebekler için özel sayfa tasarımları ile Paulmark modası parmaklarınızın ucunda. Sayfalar arasında kolayca geçiş yaparak koleksiyonları inceleyebilirsiniz.
 • Uygulama bildirimlerini açarak özel indirimler, koleksiyonlar ve özel fırsatlardan yararlanabilirsiniz.
 • Sezonun en yeni trendlerini keşfedebilirsiniz.
 • Aradığınız ürünü beden, renk, fiyat ve genişletilmiş filtreleme seçenekleri ile kolayca bulabilirsiniz.
 • Sipariş ve ürün iade durumunuzu uygulama üzerinden kolayca takip edebilirsiniz.
 • Favori ürünlerinizi kaydedebilir ve daha sonra uygulama üzerinden satın alabilirsiniz.
Paulmark, erkek giyim, kadın giyim, çocuk giyim, bebek giyim gibi ana kategorilerde binlerce ürün sunmaktadır. Yeni bebek giyim koleksiyonları, erkek çocuk giyim, kız çocuk giyim gibi farklı yaş gruplarına özel ürünlerimiz bulunmaktadır. 
Başlıca popüler kategorilerimiz:
Elbise, gömlek, mont, kaban, ceket, bluz, ayakkabı, tişört, kazak, hırka, tunik, pantolon, jean pantolon, takım elbise
En uygun fiyatlı erkek giyim ve kadın giyim ürünleri, Paulmark'ta kolay alışveriş deneyimi ile sizleri bekliyor.
Uygulama, alışveriş sürecini kolaylaştırır. Hemen satın alma, favori listeleri oluşturma ve beğendiğiniz ürünleri arkadaşlarınızla paylaşma gibi özelliklerle ihtiyacınız olan her şeye tek dokunuşla ulaşabilirsiniz.
Paulmark uygulaması, sade ve kullanışlı arayüzü, moda tutkunlarının ihtiyaçlarını kolayca karşılayabiliyor. Uygulama, Paulmark'ın en yeni koleksiyonlarını anında keşfetmenize ve kolayca satın almanıza olanak tanıyor.
Paulmark Uygulaması, kadın ve erkek giyim koleksiyonlarını keşfetmenize olanak tanır. Bu koleksiyon, her türlü stille uyumlu, şık ve trend parçaları içerir.
Paulmark Uygulaması, kız çocuk giyim koleksiyonunu keşfetmenize olanak tanır. Bu koleksiyon, kız çocuklarının hayal gücünü ve yaratıcılığını yansıtan, renkli ve eğlenceli parçaları içerir.
Paulmark Uygulaması, erkek çocuk giyim koleksiyonunu keşfetmenize olanak tanır. Bu koleksiyon, erkek çocukların hareketli yaşam tarzına uygun, rahat ve şık parçaları içerir.
Paulmark Uygulaması, bebek giyim koleksiyonunu keşfetmenize olanak tanır. Bu koleksiyon, bebeklerin hassas cildini koruyan, yumuşak ve rahat parçaları içerir.
Paulmark uygulaması moda tutkunları için mükemmel bir araçtır. Uygulamayı hemen indirin ve Paulmark’ın en yeni trendlerini keşfedin.

bluejetty:00085642:ios.description:
Learn Korean by speaking, not just studying.
Seyo is a Korean learning app designed to help you turn the Korean you understand into Korean you can actually speak. Learn useful expressions, practice real-life conversations, and build speaking confidence step by step with AI-powered feedback.
With guided lessons, Scenario Chat, and Seyo Call, you can move beyond memorizing words and grammar and practice speaking Korean in realistic situations.
FROM LEARNING TO SPEAKING
Seyo guides you through a structured learning flow that connects understanding with real conversation.
- Listen: Hear natural Korean dialogues and expressions used in real life.
- Understand: Grasp key expressions, grammar, and how Korean is actually used.
- Practice: Speak sentences aloud and get instant pronunciation feedback.
- Speak: Use what you learned in realistic conversations and speaking practice.
- Review: Revisit useful phrases and build a consistent Korean speaking routine.
MAIN FEATURES
- Seyo Call: Choose a topic and practice responding in Korean through call-style speaking exercises.
- Scenario Chat: Practice Korean conversations based on realistic situations, with guidance that helps you know what to say next.
- AI Speaking Feedback: Get instant pronunciation and speaking feedback to help you sound more natural and confident.
- Structured Learning Path: Follow step-by-step lessons designed to help you progress from understanding Korean to speaking it.
- Personalized Learning: Start with a level check and practice Korean at a level that fits you.
- Monthly Speaking Challenge: Spend at least 3 minutes a day practicing with Seyo. Track your progress and earn badges as you reach 3, 7, and 15 learning days each month.
SEYO IS FOR YOU IF
- You understand Korean but struggle to speak it.
- You want more Korean speaking practice without the pressure of talking to another person.
- You want structured practice instead of open-ended AI conversation.
- You want to improve your Korean pronunciation, fluency, and conversation skills.
BUILT BY TALK TO ME IN KOREAN
Seyo is created by the team behind Talk To Me In Korean, trusted by more than 1.5 million Korean learners across 190 countries.
Backed by 14 years of Korean teaching expertise, 45 published textbooks, and over 1,700 expert video lessons, Seyo combines this proven teaching expertise with AI-powered speaking practice. The result is an experience that helps you move beyond understanding Korean and start using it in real conversations.
Download Seyo and start your 7-day free trial to practice speaking Korean today.

bluejetty:00115247:ios.description:
This application is designed to help you explore the unknown world of paranormal activity in an engaging and entertaining way. Unlike traditional equipment, which can often be confused by ordinary fluctuations, this tool applies advanced algorithms to filter out noise and highlight only the most intriguing signals. One of the key features is its ability to interpret raw data into different forms that are easier to understand. Readings can be transformed into words, symbols, or visual indicators on a radar-like display, allowing you to experience the results in multiple ways. For those who are curious about detailed analysis, the app can also log activity, helping you track when and where unusual events occur. The system does more than simply display signals — it evaluates patterns and may even provide an impression of whether the detected presence carries positive or negative energy. This opens the possibility for both casual exploration and more immersive entertainment sessions, whether you want to observe haunted locations, follow potential movements of entities, or simply surprise your friends with spooky findings. Please remember that no one can scientifically guarantee the accuracy of such results. Paranormal phenomena remain a mystery, and this tool is provided strictly for fun and entertainment purposes.
Enjoy better tools:
-Advanced interpretation of energy signals.
-Conversion of readings into words, values, and graphical elements.
-Detailed activity logs with management options.
-Customizable settings for personalized exploration.
-Multi-language support for global users.
-Voice notifications when notable patterns are detected.
Pro Subscription: Week Pass. Every subscription includes a 3-day free trial. Charges to your iTunes account will apply after purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00089415:ios.description:
Record any in-person conversation and get a transcript, summary, and action items when you're done. Read AI turns your iPhone into an AI notetaker for client meetings, interviews, lectures, and brainstorms.

Live Transcription and Summaries
Follow along with a real-time transcript and get a concise summary at the end, so you never have to ask what was decided.
Speaker Detection
Read AI tells speakers apart, so you can see who said what.
Built for In-Person Meetings
Record face-to-face meetings, classes, and brainstorming sessions without opening a laptop.
Easy Sharing
Send your notes to Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Teams, and your CRM to share and review them.
Sync Across Devices
Access your notes and summaries on any device, alongside your Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings.
Meeting Reminders
Get notified before upcoming meetings, when a new report is ready, and with a recap before recurring meetings, so you never forget to record.

bluejetty:00087649:ios.summary:

Quickly layer loops and beats to create
bluejetty:00087649:ios.description:
Endlesss is a collaborative music studio with built in drums, synths, fx and much more. Easy to get started for the novice electronic musician with boundless opportunities for the seasoned creative.
Quickly layer loops and beats to create ever evolving soundscapes. Intuitive workflow fine-tuned to keep you locked in the groove and express your musical creativity - alone or together with others.
- Make amazing beats & music alone or together using a unique creative workflow
- Dive into community jams or create your own jams and invite friends
- Share your creations in the community and take part in weekly charts
- Watch, listen and chat with featured artists and the Endlesss community
- Easily share your creations with the world
SIMPLE AND FUN TO PLAY
- Simple, powerful pads, sounds and FX help you make pro-quality music instantly
- Create, share and remix loops in seconds - build tracks worth of content in minutes
- Play a growing library of sound packs & instruments
GO DEEP QUICKLY
- Remix your own and other people's loops with powerful DJ-style performance FX
- Layer up vocals or real-world instruments using your mic
- Creatively re-sample your own and others layers with the Sampler instrument
CONNECT TO YOUR PRO WORKFLOW
- Plug in external synths, guitars, vocal mics, drum machines or eurorack
- Use AUv3 plugins and effects to add your favourite sounds
- Use Ableton Link to sync up with other apps, DAWs and Link-enabled devices
- Connect your midi controller for maximum expression
FEATURES
- 8-channel retrospective looper with intuitive interface for making loops of various sizes and optimised for speed and creativity
- No limit on loops or jams created - create as much as you want alone or together with your friends
- Multiple high quality synth, bass and drum packs to get you started
- FX pack with 12 core effects such as reverb, delay, distortion and low/high-pass filters
- Input from microphone or external instruments
- AUv3 plugin support with macro mapping and preset saving
- Extensive key / scale, tempo, time signature and quantisation settings
- Connect to DAWs and Link-enabled devices
- Export to movie or to stems for editing and processing outside Endlesss
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
https://endlesss.fm/terms

bluejetty:00138475:ios.name: Soccer Club Management 2025
bluejetty:00138475:ios.summary:
Manage a Soccer Club from either the dug-out or the boardroom in this fast-past Soccer Management Game!
Soccer Club Management 2025 Is the ONLY game that lets you take on the role of a Chairman, Director, Head Coach or Manager!
Handle
bluejetty:00138475:ios.description:
Manage a Soccer Club from either the dug-out or the boardroom in this fast-past Soccer Management Game!
Soccer Club Management 2025 Is the ONLY game that lets you take on the role of a Chairman, Director, Head Coach or Manager!
Handle transfer negotiations, hire staff and establish your philosophy as you build your title winning squad!
Deal with media and interact with players and staff like no other soccer manager game!
Built from the Team who developed the successful Club Soccer Director franchise, Football Club Management 2025 has been developed by real football coaches and managers, giving you a realistic football management experience.
Are you ready for season 24/25?
NEW 3D Match Highlights
NEW Replays and Camera Angles
NEW European and World Cup Competitions
NEW Leagues added inc Rest Of Europe League
NEW Countries added
NEW User Interface
NEW Academy/Youth System
NEW Pre-Match Team Talks
NEW Post Match Team Talks
NEW Fans Area
NEW Rewards System
NEW Rating/XP System
and Much More!
BE A CHAMPIONSHIP MANAGER
Now you can take on the role of Manager or Head Coach and handle first team training, tactics and selection as you attempt to take your team to the top
NEW 24/25 SEASON DATA
Accurate player, club and staff data from 24/25 season.
CHOOSE FROM HUNDREDS OF FOOTBALL CLUBS
Choose from 880 Football clubs in 40 leagues from 16 different countries across the world. Create your legacy and build your own team from scratch including home country, club, stadium name, and kit design and take them to the top!
MANAGE THE CLUB IN DIFFERENT ROLES
Choose to take on a career as a Director of Football, a Football Manager, a Head Coach or buy the club and be the Chairman. No other game allows you to manage a club in so many different ways!
UNRIVALLED CLUB-LEVEL SOCCER MANAGEMENT
Manage every aspect of your club’s development and how you invest funds. Develop & upgrade your club's facilities, inc the stadium, fitness centre, medical, training ground, & youth Academy. Increase revenues by negotiating sponsorships. Hire & fire your management team and build your dream squad by negotiating transfers & offers with player agents as well as handling contract negotiations with players and staff alike.
EVERY DECISION COUNTS
Just like in real life, your decisions affect the attitude of the board, team morale, & even the fans. How you engage with press and media, ticket prices, the quality of your squad & the potential of your Academy prospects all have a bearing.
LIFELIKE STATS ENGINE
Comprehensive live-action stats engine mirrors real-life player behaviour and match outcomes, processing over 1000 decisions per game & generates real-time statistics for both individual players and teams.
DEVELOP THE CLUB
Create your own area for the club & develop your stadium, training ground, academy, facilities, fitness centre & medical facilities.
MATCH HIGHLIGHTS
FCM25 shows key match highlights during the game so you can see those key goals and misses!
COMPREHENSIVE PLAYER DATABASE
Buy or loan players from a database of over 30,000 players, each with their own unique play styles, stats, personalities and behaviours. FCM25 continuously generates new players on a regular basis, ensuring you have plenty of talent to choose from whether you’ve been in the hot seat for 1 season or 10! Player cycles continue beyond the pitch as some retiring players go into staff roles just as they do in real life!
FULL EDITOR
FCM25 has a Full in-game editor that allows you to edit Football team names, ground, kits, players avatars, staff avatars and share them with other players

bluejetty:00129600:ios.description:
Why don’t you travel to a sentimental and beautiful story hidden in the puzzle? 
This is a story that has come down since long ago. 
It is said a cursed moon keeper was keeping the flower and tree alone that bloomed in a blue crescent moon that emerged in the night sky from time to time.
As if he was looking forward to something eagerly for a very long time…. 
The fact there was a beautiful castle called ‘Nobilrunia’ here longer ago has now become a forgotten story only the moon keeper remembers. 
Then one day, the flowers in the moon began withering. 
Please help the moon keeper. 
Please find the abundant figure that used to be. 
Nonograms are also well-known as griddlers, hanjie, picross, pictocross or kakuro. These are classic Japanese crosswords with hidden pictures. Those who have ever heard about them usually know the rules.

bluejetty:00095654:ios.description:
Outbreak Alert! Welcome to Safe Zone The Check Point Game!
The city has fallen into chaos as a deadly virus spreads like wildfire. With the streets overrun by panic, the government has constructed a heavily guarded **Safe Zone**, the last hope for humanity. 
Citizens are rushing to its gates, desperate to escape the horrors outside. But not everyone is who they seem.
As an elite Safe Zone Security Officer your mission is critical: screen every survivor, detect infected individuals, uncover hidden threats, and stop doppelgangers from sneaking in. The survival of the entire zone depends on your sharp eyes, fast decisions, and unbreakable nerve.
Inspect ID papers.
Scan for zombie bite marks.
Search bags for contraband.
Spot impostors.
Protect the zone.
"You are the last line of defense."
Features:
- Paper Checking
Every survivor must present documents. Validate identity, match faces, spot forgeries, and deny entry to suspicious individuals. Your judgment will decide who lives behind the walls.
- Body Scan for Infection
Use futuristic scanning tools to detect zombie infections. Watch for subtle signs, bite marks, unusual behavior, or sudden aggression.
- Bag Inspection
Open bags and search for illegal items: weapons, toxins, or banned tech. Smugglers and saboteurs will try to sneak in, stay alert!
- Doppelganger Detection
Some infected can mimic humans. Use deduction, clues, and your instincts to reveal impostors. Trust no one.
- Upgrade & Customize
Enhance your scanners, speed, and defense protocols. Customize your checkpoint to handle crowds faster and smarter.
Are you ready to guard the gate and protect what’s left of humanity?
Download **Safe Zone The Check Point Game** now and prove you have what it takes to stop the outbreak at the gate!

bluejetty:00152170:ios.description:
Cryptical is a full-featured password generator for end users and system administrators who need safe, random passwords or passphrases.
Features:
• Cryptographically secure random passwords, up to 999 characters
• Choose the character sets to use (lowercase, uppercase, numbers, symbols), and always include or exclude specific characters
• Passwords can be fully random or pronounceable, and can be generated with no repeated characters
• Random passphrases of up to 99 words from lists of tens of thousands of words. Word lists in seven languages (English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Swedish) can be used individually or combined. For added security, capitalize words or substitute random letters with numbers, and pick the separator – which can be a random symbol
• Password strength meter that shows the actual strength of a generated password
• Copy passwords to the pasteboard or share them with other apps. Copied passwords can expire automatically and never leave your device via Universal Clipboard
• Bulk generator: create a large number of passwords or passphrases at once
• Interactive home-screen widgets: generate, reveal, copy, and save passwords, and switch mode, character sets, and length right on the widget
• Home-screen quick actions: generate & copy, generate & add, or generate & print with a long press on the app icon
• Password List with unlimited entries, notes, user name, and website, plus search
• Bulk operations: copy, share, print, or delete several passwords at once (printing requires AirPrint)
• Backup & restore your list as CSV – compatible with exports from other password managers
• Everything you store is encrypted, and Cryptical can be locked with a passcode or Face ID / Touch ID, including auto-lock
• App icon, theme, and font selection: customize Cryptical to your liking
Cryptical is completely free, has no ads or tracking, and never connects to the internet – it doesn't make a single network request.
Note: Cryptical is not a password manager. Please use it in addition to your existing password management solution.

bluejetty:00032747:ios.description:
The Budgeting App is a manual-first budget planner and expense tracker for people who want to feel in control of their money, not just watch an automatic dashboard.
When you log spending yourself, you stay aware of every purchase, notice your habits, and make calmer decisions about where your money goes.
- Flexible budgets that fit your life: create weekly, fortnightly, or monthly budgets and see at a glance whether you're on track.
- Fast expense logging: add income and spending in seconds, with a built-in calculator so you can do the maths before you save.
- Custom categories: organise your spending with categories and icons you choose, so your budget reflects how you actually live.
- Insightful analytics: spot patterns in your spending and make informed decisions about credit cards, savings, and your emergency fund.
- Recurring transactions: keep track of regular bills and subscriptions, from insurance to streaming, so nothing catches you by surprise.
- Savings and loan trackers: set savings goals and follow loan repayments in one place to stay focused on what matters.
- Multiple accounts and currencies: manage separate accounts, each with its own budgets, goals, and currency.
- Automatic bank sync (Australia, United States, and Canada): connect your bank to import transactions automatically, then review and categorise them yourself. Bank connections are provided by Fiskil in Australia and Plaid in the United States and Canada. Everywhere else, The Budgeting App is manual by design.
- Sync across devices: pick up your budget on any device and stay on top of your spending wherever you are.
Budgeting works best when you're part of it. The Budgeting App keeps you close to your money so good habits actually stick.
Download The Budgeting App and start budgeting with intention today.

bluejetty:00061932:ios.name: Surfing Games for Kids
bluejetty:00061932:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00061932:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SKIDOS Surf Fun:
Escape the mighty wave, how long can you go, leaping from wave to wave in this completely unique physics arcade adventure.
Beat your friends and surf the furthest in this fun and simple game that's easy to play but difficult to Master!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00179905:ios.description:
Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox: A fun, game-based algebra tutor that fits in your pocket.
**REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION**
Access to the contents and functionality of this app requires a subscription to Kahoot! Kids. The subscription starts with a 7 day free trial and can be cancelled at any time before the end of the trial.
The Kahoot! Kids subscription gives your family access to premium Kahoot! features and several award-winning learning apps for math and reading.
Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox is a must-have tool for students to gain confidence in algebra and math and improve their grades. It is based on the award-winning game Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox but covers more advanced topics in math and algebra:
* Parentheses
* Positive and Negative signs
* Addition of Fractions (Common Denominators)
* Collection of Like Terms
* Factorization
* Substitution
Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox gives players a deeper understanding of what math is all about: objects and the relationships between objects.
This educational game targets children from the ages of 12 to 17 but learners of all ages (including adults) can enjoy it. Playing doesn’t require any supervision, although parents can enjoy playing along with their children and maybe even brush up their own math skills.
Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox introduces all these elements in a playful and colorful world appealing to players all ages.
The player learns at his/her own pace by experimenting with rules that are introduced gradually. Progress is illustrated with the birth and growth of a dragon for each new chapter. 
Dr. Patrick Marchal, Ph.D. in cognitive science, and Jean-Baptiste Huynh, a high school teacher, created Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox as an intuitive, interative and efficient way to learn algebra. 
Kahoot! Algebra 2 by DragonBox is based on a novel pedagogical method developed in Norway that focuses on discovery and experimentation. Players receive instant feedback which differs from a traditional classroom setting where receiving feedback might take a long time. Kahoot! DragonBox Algebra 12+ creates an environment for kids where they can learn, enjoy and appreciate math. 
"Our previous educational game, Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox has received many distinctions including the Gold Medal of the 2012 Serious Play Award (USA), the Best Serious game at Bilbao´s Fun and Serious Game Festival and the Best Serious Game at the 2013 International Mobile Gaming Awards. It is also recommended by Common Sense Media where it won the Learn ON award.
FEATURES
* 20 progressive chapters (10 learning, 10 training) 
* 357 puzzles 
* Basic algebraic rules with which the child can experiment
* A focus on minimal instruction encourages creativity and experimentation from the player 
* Multiple profiles for easy progress control 
* Dedicated graphics and music for each chapter 
Privacy Policy: https://kahoot.com/privacy
Terms and conditions: https://kahoot.com/terms

T-REX VPN is a privacy-focused VPN client that routes your internet traffic through an encrypted tunnel, keeping your data safe on public Wi-Fi and untrusted networks.
KEY FEATURES:
1. Server Scanner
Test all available VPN servers directly from the app. The scanner checks each location for availability and measures latency, so you can pick the fastest server before connecting.
2. Location Selection
Browse VPN servers organized by country and city. Select a specific location or let the app automatically choose the best available server. Save your preferred locations to Favorites for quick access.
3. Connection Reliability
Built-in connection verification confirms your traffic is routed through the VPN after each connect. If a server becomes unreachable, auto-reconnect seamlessly switches to another available server. Continuous ping monitoring detects connection issues early and triggers recovery automatically.
4. Network Statistics
View real-time download and upload speeds, latency, and total data transferred while connected.
5. Privacy & Security
All traffic is encrypted using industry-standard protocols (TLS 1.3, AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305). The app uses a TUN interface to create a system-wide VPN tunnel via Apple's Network Extension framework.
6. Subscription Plans
Choose from Basic, Premium, or Family plans with monthly or yearly billing. Subscribe directly through the App Store with in-app purchase.
7. Account & Devices
Create an account with email or sign in with Apple. View and manage all your connected devices from within the app.
8. Localization
Available in 21 languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, and more.

Search prophetic hadiths in Arabic and read their explanations, sources, and scholars' authenticity assessments from Dorar al-Saniyyah.
• Search by any word, all words, or an exact phrase, and exclude words or phrases.
• Filter by authenticity grade, scholar, book, or narrator.
• View narrators, source references, original narrations, and similar hadiths.
• Save hadiths for offline reading.
• Adjust fonts, text size, and app colors.
Search and new explanations require an internet connection to the hosted Dorar Hadith API. Saved hadiths remain available offline. The interface supports Arabic and English, with Arabic as the default. Hadith content is in Arabic.
Crash reporting through Sentry and usage analytics through PostHog are optional. Both options are preselected on first launch; uncheck either to decline. They start only after Continue and can be disabled in Settings. See the privacy policy for details.
The F-Droid build does not include Shorebird code updates or Google Play's update library. The app automatically checks GitHub and F-Droid for updates once a day. You can disable automatic checks in Settings or check manually from About.
